source: Guide prose pinned to the income snapshot; area travel/access sections collected via api.php. Complete sentences selected and markup removed; not full boss strategies.

routes: There is no direct path to the mine; the fastest method to reach the entrance is to use a Games necklace or Drakan's medallion to teleport to Burgh de Rott and run west. Otherwise, players must travel through Mort Myre Swamp.
The dungeon entrance is inside the Brimhaven dungeon, in the room between the fire giants and the black demons, in the south part of the dungeon.
Teleport using the Dungeoneering cape or a charged hoardstalker ring to the Brimhaven metal dragon dungeon.
House Teleport if the player-owned house is on Karamja or a Brimhaven tablet if the player has completed Love Story.
Teleport to the Karamja lodestone, which is located directly south-east of the dungeon.
Break an air altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
Use a skills necklace to teleport to the Cooking Guild, then go south-west to the altar.
Use the skull sceptre to teleport to Barbarian Village, then go east across the bridge to the altar.

Aminishi teleport - Players may break this teletab to teleport to The Assassin on Aminishi. It can be purchased at Boni's Waiko Reward Shop for 5 chimes, or from Bryll Thoksdottir's Elite Dungeon Reward Shop for 1000 dungeoneering tokens.
Players can travel to Aminishi by talking to Quartermaster Gully located in Port Sarim or Menaphos, after the player has completed the quest Impressing the Locals.
Players can travel to the temple by using the teleport chest from the Shadow Reef and Dragonkin Laboratory.
For a first visit, board The Stormbreaker on the river east of the Varrock Dig Site and complete the arrival tutorial.
Use After the tutorial, build and activate the Anachronia lodestone at Base Camp for future visits.
The quickest way to get to the start of the course is by teleporting to the Anachronia lodestone.
If this lodestone has not been unlocked, then the player has to travel to Anachronia via the Stormbreaker in Archaeology Campus.
All methods require having visited Anachronia at least once to use them.
Use Grace of the elves teleport attuned via a Max Guild skill portal (after purchasing the Max guild portal attunement from the Anachronia Farmers' Market).
Use Anachronia Dinosaur Farm teleport to Prehistoric Potterington after completing Extinction and then purchasing it with beans.
Mystical tree on the west coast of Anachronia next to the campfire (where the broken compass can be found).
Boss portal at War's Retreat - Requires killing Nex at least once.
Boss portal at Max Guild - Requires killing Nex at least once and access to the guild.

Travelling via Daero at the floor 1 above ground of the Grand Tree (east next to Blurberry), then talking to Waydar who will take you to Crash Island, and then sailing to Ape Atoll by talking to Lumdo.
Use the teleportation spell Ape Atoll Teleport, requiring level 64 Magic (after completing the King Awowogei part of Recipe for Disaster).

Teleporting to the Agility course using the fairy ring code CLR (after completing A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift). A small ninja monkey greegree is required to get through the log shortcut to the agility course and the rest of the island.
Superior locator Special log teleport (1/8 chance, requires visiting Ape Atoll once, during Monkey Madness).
Walk to the east from Varrock lodestone.
Use Ancient Magicks player can teleport to the entrance of the Senntisten Temple.
Dig Site pendant can teleport player to various locations around the Campus.
Archaeology teleport and Master archaeologist's outfit can both teleport the user to Campus.
The Ardougne lodestone is located just north of the city, directly southwest of Manor Farm.
The Ardougne Teleport spell teleports the player to the centre of Ardougne market, requiring completion of the Plague City quest.
The Ardougne cloak 1 can be used to teleport to the Ardougne Monastery, just south of the city.
Once per day, the Ardougne cloak 2/3 can be used to teleport to Manor Farm, just north of the city.
The Ardougne Teleport spell teleports the caster into the centre of the Ardougne Market.
Teleport to Ardougne lodestone and proceed south.
Three times a day, players can use the modified blacksmith's helmet to teleport directly to the Artisans' Workshop.
Teleport to the Mining Guild using the skills necklace, then go east.
Teleport to the Mining Guild resource dungeon using the dungeoneering cape, climb up any of the 4 ladders, and go east.
Teleport to the Falador Mole Lair using a boss portal attuned to the giant mole in War's Retreat, then go south-east.
Use the Oo'glog lodestone and head west into the Feldip Hills to the Monastery of Ascension.
When walking, go to Port Sarim and head south from the Port Sarim Jail, past a grove of willow trees. Go up the small hill and you will arrive at the trapdoor.
Use a Dungeoneering cape (0,8) to instantly teleport right into the dungeon, just outside the resource dungeon's entrance.
Fairy ring code AIQ , which goes to Mudskipper Point.
A Home Teleport, to teleport to Port Sarim lodestone, which is located in the central Port Sarim.

Unlike most altars, the astral altar is not located within an extra-planar temple, and resides instead on the same plane of existence as Gielinor. As such, a talisman, talisman staff, tiara, or the wicked hood is not needed. Players should take caution for the suqah that are on the way to the altar.

The fastest way to get there is to use the wicked hood's teleport, which can only be used twice, or three times if full wicked robe outfit has been purchased from the Wizard Finix's Runecrafting Shop. In order to use the wicked hood's teleport to the astral altar, players must have completed Lunar Diplomacy and also have fed an omni-talisman to the hood.
The second fastest way is to break an astral altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.

The third fastest way is to use the Moonclan Teleport Lunar spell or to break a teleport tablet, either of which will take players next to the small obelisk north of the altar, right outside the Lunar Isle bank. This is the quickest method without access to wicked hood teleports.
Break a blood altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
Use Drakan's medallion to teleport to the Meiyerditch Laboratories, then go through the tunnels to the ruins.

To save a charge on Drakan's medallion, the player may teleport to Morytania with the ectophial first. The medallion can be used to bank at Burgh de Rott bank. Blood Rune Temple is considered to be outside of Morytania which means teleporting via the medallion within it will consume charges, so it is advised to either exit the altar first or recharge the medallion at Burgh de Rott. However, the cost of congealed blood used to charge the medallion is negligible and it is much easier to use charges and recharge the medallion later.

Without Drakan's medallion, the Blood Rune Temple can be accessed through the Meiyerditch laboratory from its various entrances, the easiest access coming from the trapdoor behind the Hair of the Dog tavern in Canifis. Enter the cavern containing the tomb of Ivandis and take the other exit. This route is not commonly used by runecrafters as it is much slower than the other options.
Teleport to the Wilderness lodestone or use Carrallangar Teleport and run east.
Teleport to the Fort Forinthry lodestone and run north.

Players with level 57 woodcutting can make a waka canoe just outside the north-west corner of the Grand Exchange and ride it to the lake in level 35 wilderness. Run south-east around the volcano to reach the boneyard.
Teleport to Karamja via the Karamja lodestone.
Take the boat from Port Sarim to Karamja and walk.
Use an Amulet of glory to teleport to Musa Point and walk.
Take a boat from East Ardougne (30 coins) to Brimhaven.
The dungeon is located a short distance north-west of the Karamja lodestone.
It be reached by sailing from East Ardougne to Brimhaven, for a fee of 30 coins, 15 with Karamja gloves 1 or for free with the ring of charos.
Another sea route can be taken from Port Sarim to Musa Point, for the same price. However, it is a much longer walk to the dungeon entrance from Musa Point than from Brimhaven.
Teleportation is also practical.
The games necklace can be used to teleport to Burgh de Rott with the completion of The Darkness of Hallowvale quest and having 500 companion levels in Temple Trekking.
Drakan's medallion can be used to teleport to the Barrows or Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
A Swamp Boat can be taken nearby to Mort'ton from the Hollows in the Mort Myre Swamp.
Run south from Canifis (with a shortcut via the tunnel behind the Hair of the Dog tavern after In Search of the Myreque).
Teleport directly to the Burthorpe lodestone.
Teleport to the Taverley lodestone or use the House Teleport spell to the Taverley POH portal (if the player has a house there) and walk north.
Teleport to the Troll Invasion Distraction and Diversion by using the games necklace.
Teleport just outside the Warriors' Guild by using the combat bracelet.
Canifis may be accessed after completing the Priest in Peril quest or defeating the ghoul and passing through the holy barrier in the basement of Paterdomus for the first time.
Use Canifis lodestone just north-east of Canifis.
Use the Ancient Magicks spell Kharyrll Teleport.
Fairy Ring code CKS.
From Taverley, venture west across White Wolf Mountain or take the tunnel below (requires completion of the Fishing Contest quest).
Teleport to Catherby directly by using the Catherby lodestone.
Teleport to Seers' Village lodestone and walk south-east.
Cast Camelot Teleport or use a Camelot teleport tablet and walk south-east.
Underworld portal, just north of the Draynor lodestone. If it hasn't already been completed, the Necromancy! quest will begin upon doing this. The portal takes players to the ritual site in the city.

Teleporting to the Draynor lodestone and then using the Underworld portal is the fastest way to reach the ritual site via the Lodestone Network, for players who are interested in performing rituals efficiently.

Alternatively, for access to a bank while doing rituals, players can use War's Retreat Teleport to go to War's Retreat, exit to Draynor using the exit portal, then enter the ritual site using the Underworld portal.
City of Um lodestone located in the centre, near the bridge towards the ritual site, which can be activated after the introductory quest.

The Cooks' Guild is just west of Varrock; a skills necklace can teleport to its entrance. Entry requires 32 Cooking and a chef's hat or sous chef's toque; members can use a Cooking cape or max cape instead. Completing hard Varrock achievements also removes the headgear requirement.
Break a cosmic altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
Use any fairy ring or a portable fairy ring to teleport to Zanaris and go south to the ruins. There are jutting walls that can be traversed with level 46 or 66 Agility to get to the ruins faster.
A skills necklace or modified artisan's bandana can be used to teleport to the Crafting Guild.
Teleport to the Port Sarim lodestone and running north-west.
Teleport to the Rimmington player-owned house portal.
Members who have unlocked the Crafting Guild hot air balloon route after completing Enlightened Journey can take a hot air balloon to just north of the Crafting Guild for a fee of two charges.

The Croesus Front is located in the eastern section of Senntisten, which can be accessed by the ancient door north of the Archaeology Guild and directly east of Tolna's rift. After entering Senntisten the player needs to access the cathedral to the south of the entrance and then leave through the eastern cathedral door. Passing through the eastern door for the first time will trigger a cutscene.
Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door.
The Pontifex shadow ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral.

The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology or access to those items.
Darkmeyer is hard to reach and one is required to wear the full Darkmeyer disguise to not be caught and thrown out, or the House Drakan outfit, acquired part way through The Lord of Vampyrium.
Climb into a hole in the very north-east of Meiyerditch.
Use Drakan's medallion teleport to the Arboretum after Vanescula Drakan enchants it during The Branches of Darkmeyer.
Break a death altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
The Tirannwn quiver 3 or 4 can teleport to the ruins 5 times a day.
Entering the ruins by walking requires entering the Temple of Light and using the following directions.
Go up the stairs at the main entrance.
Teleport to the Draynor lodestone, then run north and interact with the green Death's Hourglass to the left of the mirror-like Underworld portal.
Teleport to War's Retreat using War's Retreat Teleport then exit through the floor portal to Death's office.
To get to the Deep Sea Fishing hub, choose the 'travel' option on Goomah south of the Fishing Guild bank. Reaching Goomah can be done through several ways.
Use a skills necklace to teleport directly outside the Guild door.
Use the Fishing Guild Teleport spell (found in the Lunar spellbook), or equivalently a Fishing guild teleport tablet.
Teleport to the Ardougne lodestone, then head north.
The Bandit Camp lodestone is a quick and free teleport, available after completing Desert Treasure. The quarry is a short run south west of the lodestone.

After completing Enakhra's Lament, players can use the Camulet to teleport to Enakhra's Temple, which is very near the quarry. The temple's western exit is perhaps the most convenient for granite mining. The Camulet is by a wide margin the quickest way to get to the quarry.
Players can use a Bandit Camp teleport scroll to teleport to the centre of the Bandit Camp and walk south to the quarry.
Players can use a Pharaoh's sceptre to teleport to Jaldraocht and walk west to the quarry.

Players may enter the crack in the eastern wall of the cellar of Lumbridge Castle, through which Kazgar waits to lead players through the Dorgesh-Kaan mine. The entrance to Dorgesh-Kaan is just to the south-east of where Kazgar leaves the player. To follow Kazgar through the mines, the player is required to bring a light source.
The city can be accessed from the Kalphite Hive through the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon to the south of the city, although a light source is required.

There is a fairy ring in the dungeon to the south with the code AJQ. This may only be used if players have completed A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen up to the point where the fairy ring network is unlocked. A light source is needed in the dungeon. To exit from the dungeon to the city, go east of the ring, then go north, west and again to north until a ladder. Climb up the ladder to the Dorgesh-Kaan course, and climb down the stairs to the north to reach the southern part of the city.

The Dorgesh-Kaan–Keldagrim train system may be used to travel to Dorgesh-Kaan from Keldagrim by rail (after Another Slice of H.A.M.), and vice versa. The tickets are free; a player need only wait less than a minute in the carriage for the departure. The train station in Keldagrim is located near the blast furnace in the south-east of the city, and the train station in Dorgesh-Kaan is on the floor 1 above ground in the south-west corner of the city.

Charter a ship to Port Phasmatys, or teleport using ectophial, then speak with the ghost captain standing next to a small row boat at the southern end of the docks. Ghostspeak amulet or completion of the hard Morytania achievements required. The Ghosts Ahoy quest does not have to be started for him to take the player there, but it is required for the ectophial.
Big Book o' Piracy teleport directly to the island (requires completion of Pieces of Hate).
Elder divination outfit can teleport its owner to the wisp colony three times each day.
Teleport using an amulet of glory to the Draynor Market.
Use Home Teleport to Draynor lodestone just north of the village (near the portal to Death's office).
Use War's Retreat Teleport and immediately exit via the ground portal to the north of the village.
Use an explorer's ring 3 to teleport to the Falador cabbage patch and then run south then east through the stone wall and then south will teleport to the Draynor Market.
Main entrance: In the foothills of the Ice Mountain, north of the Falador to Gunnarsgrunn road. Using a combat bracelet to teleport to the Edgeville Monastery is a quick way to get to this entrance.
Falador entrance: A building in the far northeast of Falador has stairs down to the south end of the mine. A Falador Teleport is a fast way to get here and to get to the next entrance.
South gate: Entrance to the Mining Guild, level 60 Mining required.

Mine cart: Members may use the Keldagrim minecart system to enter the mine in the north-west section. This two-way network allows players to travel between the Dwarven Mine and the bustling dwarven capital of Keldagrim. From the cart station in Keldagrim, it is also possible to travel to White Wolf Mountain and the Grand Exchange, provided that the quest Fishing Contest has been completed. One fast way to get to the mine is to take the carts from the Grand Exchange to Keldagrim and then to Ice Mountain. Also, the train station in Keldagrim is next to the carts and thus allows access from Dorgesh-Kaan, provided that the Another Slice of H.A.M. quest has been completed.
A Wilderness sword 1 or its higher variants can be used to arrive slightly north-west of the Edgeville bank.
Use an Amulet of glory to teleport slightly west of Edgeville bank.
Players with access to a slayer cape can teleport to Vannaka and arrive south of the Edgeville bank.
Players may use the Edgeville lodestone to arrive west of the General store or the Fairy ring code DKR to arrive east just across the river.
Use From Manor Farm, teleport to the Anachronia Dinosaur Farm using the mystical tree.
Use Anachronia Dinosaur Farm teleport.
Anachronia Teleport (if the Totem of the Abyss is placed on the west side and it is activated), then head south.
Teleport to the Anachronia lodestone, then run from the Anachronia base camp.
After completing Fate of the Gods, use the World Gate set to Freneskae to reach the Elder Halls. The elder divination outfit can also teleport to the elder wisp colony.
Use Dig Site pendant to teleport to Senntisten.
Use Archaeology Journal teleport option to Archaeology Guild.
Use Empty Throne Room teleport on the Quest Cape or master quest cape.
Falador lodestone - Teleports near the north gate.
Falador Teleport - Teleports to the city square near the north gate. Requires level 37 Magic and an air runes, a water rune, and a law rune. Falador teleport tablet may also be used.

Teleport to South Falador - Teleports to the south gate southern entrance. Unlocked at the Livid Farm, requires level 72 Magic, being on the Lunar Spellbook and two astral runes, a law rune, and two air runes.
Skills necklace - Teleports to the Mining Guild's entrance.
The fastest way is to utilise the Cabbageport function of the Explorer's ring 3 or 4, as this will teleport the user to the cabbage patch belonging to the farm.
If players have their house in Rimmington, they can teleport to house and run to the farm.
If players have a spirit tree grown in Port Sarim, they can teleport there and run north.
Use the Captain's Log to teleport to Port Sarim and go north.
Use TokKul-Zo teleport directly to the Fight Kiln.
Fairy ring BLP to TzHaar City, near the Fight Cave. Run east through the city to the Kiln.
Break a fire altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
Use a ring of duelling to teleport to Het's Oasis, then go north to the altar.
Use a dungeoneering cape to teleport to the Al Kharid scorpion mine, then go south to the altar.
Use a sand seed or mystical sand seed to teleport to the Garden of Kharid, then go south to the altar.
Use Games necklace or Drakan's medallion teleport to Burgh de Rott. Jump the gate out of Burgh de Rott, run north to Mort'ton, then northeast from the Mort'ton town centre to Flamtaer.
Use Drakan's medallion teleport to the Barrows. Run southwest to Mort'ton, then north to Flamtaer.
Fairy ring BKR to the Mort Myre Swamp, then run south past the Nature Grotto and down the winding path to Mort'ton.

Running south from Canifis lodestone through Mort Myre Swamp. Using the northwestern gate requires starting the Nature Spirit quest. Lower-levelled players should equip a snelm and bring a Druid pouch.

At level 17 Wilderness, east of the Bandit Camp and Dark Warriors' Fortress and west of the south-western Wilderness Crater steps. The Wilderness sword 2 (and higher variants) provides free infinite teleports here, and it is a short run west from the Wilderness Crater lodestone.
At level 31 Wilderness, north of the Bandit Camp, and east of the Forgotten Cemetery.
Teleport to the Fort Forinthry lodestone, located just south of the fort.
Teleport to the fort's courtyard using a Fort Forinthry Teleport scroll.
Use the Slayer cape to the Raptor, who's located in front of the fort's guardhouse.
Use the fairy ring BJP leading to the Woodcutters' Grove just outside the east wall, which requires building tier 2 Grove cabin.
Use the fairy rings, using the code AJR.
Use the ring of slaying or slayer mask teleport.
Teleport to their house (if in Rellekka) or using a Rellekka tablet.
Use the Fremennik Province lodestone teleport and running south-east.

Freneskae may be accessed after starting Fate of the Gods, by means of the World Gate, located north of the Arandar and south of the Eagles' Peak. Fate of the Gods takes place almost entirely on Freneskae, and after the quest is completed, Freneskae remains open for exploration. To access Freneskae through the world gate, it must be dialled to .
The world gate itself may be reached by.
Use Sixth-Age circuit teleport to World Gate (option 2).
Use Quest Cape or master quest cape teleport to World Gate (option 0).
Dungeoneering cape to the Al Kharid resource dungeon and run east.
Use Ring of duelling Het's Oasis teleport and run north.
Teleport to Al Kharid lodestone and run north.

Glacor Front is located in the southern section of Senntisten, which can be accessed by ancient door north of the Archaeology Guild (which can be quickly teleported to with Archaeology journal) and directly east of Tolna's rift. After entering Senntisten the player needs to access the cathedral to the south of the entrance and then leave through southern cathedral door. Passing through the western door for the first time triggers a cutscene.
The Master archaeologist's outfit will teleport to near the cathedral.
Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door.
The Pontifex shadow ring, awarded by City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral.
Navigating towards the dungeon requires having defeated Dad in the Troll Stronghold quest.
Boss portal at War's Retreat - Requires killing any generals at least once and access to War's Retreat, and at least 100 total boss kills.
Combat portal at Max Guild - Requires Max Cape achievement and killing any generals at least once.
God Wars Dungeon Teleport - Requires level 61 Magic and completion of The Mighty Fall.
Use a clan vexillum to teleport directly to the Grand Exchange.
Teleport to Varrock (either via the Varrock Teleport spell or the Varrock lodestone) and walk the rest of the way.
Teleport to the air altar using an air altar teleport, then walk north-east.
Use a canoe to travel to the Barbarian Village station, then walk north-east.
Use the Port Sarim lodestone, then go north-west and enter the eastern cave entrance. The Queen Black Dragon is at the bottom of the lair, behind a portal requiring 60 Summoning.
Use the "Guthix's shrine" teleport on the Sixth-Age circuit or the modified diviner's headwear.
Use the fairy ring BLR or cape of legends to the Legends' Guild and running west.
The combat bracelet can teleport the player to the Ranging Guild, north of the ruins.
The master archaeologist's outfit can teleport to the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site, north-west of the ruins.
Fairy ring ALQ is located in the middle of the Haunted Woods.
Use Ectophial teleport to the Ectofuntus. Run south along the western wall of Port Phasmatys and then head west into the Haunted Woods.
Use Canifis lodestone, head southeast into the woods.

Getting to Havenhythe for the first time requires starting and progressing through the quest Visions of Havenhythe, started at the Rusty Anchor Tavern in Port Sarim. If left prior to completing the quest, Captain Lorris is the only method to return to Havenhythe.
Use Wendlewick lodestone located in Wendlewick.
At level 28 Magic, Wendlewick Teleport can be cast on the standard spellbook, teleporting to the centre of the town.
Fairy ring BKS takes you to the Shrine of Inanna, south of Wendlewick.

Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
Use The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.

The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.

Regarding closest teleport possibilities, an amulet of nature may also be used. As this requires it to be bound to a single patch of the player's own choosing, it is omitted from the options listed below.
Use Witchdoctor mask teleport directly to Papa Mambo.
Use a Juju teleport spiritbag to teleport to Papa Mambo.
Remote access using Crop farmer outfit or Master farmer hat when worn and if witchdoctor mask or juju teleport spiritbag are owned in bank.
Use Karamja gloves 3 or 4 teleport to the Shilo Village mine. Exit Shilo Village via the south-east entrance and then run east.
To access the north side and start of the Agility course.
Teleport directly to Het's Oasis western entrance by using a ring of duelling.
Teleport to the fire altar using a fire altar teleport tablet.
Teleport to the Al Kharid mine or Garden of Kharid by using the dungeoneering cape, sand seed, or mystical sand seed and go south. To access the south side.
There are a variety of ways to travel to the entrance of the Infernal Source dig site.
Use Archaeology teleport, purchased for 250 chronotes from Ezreal at the Archaeology Guild Shop.
Use Archaeology journal, teleport to the Archaeology Campus then running west and use the dig sites map table to teleport to it directly.
Use Archaeology journal, teleport to the Archaeology Campus then running north-west.
A skill portal in the Max Guild garden can be attuned to the Invention Guild. It teleports the player inside. A grace of the elves will teleport the player to the portals' attuned locations.
Use a skills necklace to teleport directly outside the Guild door.
Teleport to the Falador lodestone and running north-east.
A games necklace can teleport the player to the Gamers' Grotto, by the exit. Upon exiting, the entrance to the Invention Guild will be to the north.
Partial completion of the quest Regicide is required to access Isafdar.
Tirannwn lodestone teleport is located in the south of Isafdar.
Use Tirannwn quiver 1, Crystal teleport seed, or Attuned crystal teleport seed to Lletya and then exit Lletya to the west into Isafdar.
Use Tirannwn quiver 2, 3, and 4 offer additional teleport locations around Isafdar — the Tyras Camp and the Elf Camp, respectively.
First time from the Keldagrim entrance tunnel east of Rellekka.
The Luck of the Dwarves or Hazelmere's signet ring provide unlimited teleports to the west side of the Palace ground floor.

Players with access to Keldagrim can use the Keldagrim trapdoor in the north-west of the Grand Exchange to arrive in East Keldagrim. A luck ring such as the Ring of Wealth or higher variants can also teleport a short distance from the trapdoor using the Grand Exchange teleport option.

The master camouflage outfit provides unlimited teleports to the Consortium (0, 1), the top floor of the palace in the centre of Keldagrim. This allows convenient access to both the east and west side of Keldagrim. Other variants of this outfit will also teleport players to this location five times per day.
Use Archaeology teleport, purchased for 250 chronotes from Ezreal at the Archaeology Guild Shop.
Use Archaeology journal: teleport to the Archaeology Campus then run west, inside the main building, and use the dig sites map table inside to teleport to it directly.
Use Al Kharid lodestone and run east.
Ring of duelling to Het's Oasis and run south-east.
The entrance to Kuradal's Dungeon is a cave near Kuradal in the Ancient Cavern. She is located in the back of the dungeon, on the opposite side of the whirlpool entrance, and up the stairs.
Use a ferocious ring to teleport to Kuradal.
Use a Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Kuradal.

Entering the Ancient Cavern via the lake above Baxtorian Falls, at the head of the River Dougne. To enter the cavern, players must jump off the dock on the north side of the lake into the whirlpool (followers such as pets or familiars cannot be out at this time). To be able to enter this way, players must have completed Barbarian Training up to the pyre ships part of barbarian Firemaking. One fast way to get to the dock is to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost using a games necklace or Barbarian Teleport (Lunar spellbook).
The obelisk in level 44 Wilderness is the closest, from there run a short distance to the southeast.
The obelisk in level 35 Wilderness is a bit further, the maze entrance is towards the northwest.
The obelisk in level 27 Wilderness is the furthest but still practical, run a little distance to the north.
Players can also teleport to the Lava Maze by way of a lava titan's special ability.
Break a law altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
Teleport to Port Sarim using the Port Sarim lodestone, Captain's Log, or Arc journal, then board the ship to Entrana.
Use Dungeoneering cape teleport to the Dwarven Mine resource dungeon and then running north and west to the cavern entrance.
Through a directed skill portal in the Max Guild of Prifddinas. Requires Plague's End and at least one 99 or a Quest Cape.

Use the Lassar Teleport from the Ancient Magicks spellbook, the Edgeville Monastery teleport from the combat bracelet, or the Body altar teleport all teleport close to this entrance of the Dwarven Mine. Then run south to the cavern entrance.
Through the entrance in the north-east corner of Falador or the Mining Guild and then run north and then west to the entrance to the Living Rock Caverns.

During Mourning's End Part I, Eluned will teleport you into the city for the first time and give you a crystal teleport seed with 8 charges that lets you teleport back to the city. She will also recharge it for a fee, though this amount goes down the more times you recharge the crystal with her, like with the crystal bow and crystal ward. Additional crystal teleport seeds can be obtained from killing the elves in the city, but they will only have three charges.

If a player chooses not to teleport into Lletya, there is an entrance from the forest of Isafdar, which is guarded by dire wolves. Trees surround the rest of the settlement, making it the only way out while walking or running.

Players who have completed The Prisoner of Glouphrie may take a safe path that begins near the Ourania Altar entrance, and takes them to the city itself. This path isn't really any shorter and due to the lack of maps of the area, may be more difficult than the other routes, but it can be used even if you have not yet begun the Mourning's End Part I quest. However, if you have not yet begun Mourning's End Part I, be careful who you talk to in the village. It is safe to talk to most of the elves, and to use the bank and shops, but if you speak to Arianwyn (and possibly some others), you will be transported out of the village because you don't belong there.
Players who have at least completed the easy Tirannwn achievements can use the Tirannwn quiver 1 to teleport to Lletya.
To enter Lumbridge, players can use the bridge to the east of the town over the River Lum.
From the south, there is a path from Lumbridge Swamp that players can use to enter the town.
From the north, players can cross the bridge leading out from the west of the Champions' Guild and through the Mill Road Mill, heading east along the road.
Players can also, from the west, enter the town through the path leading from Draynor Village passing by the pale wisp colony.
Use the Lumbridge lodestone, then go to the catacombs entrance in Lumbridge cemetery. Complete The Blood Pact to access the lower level.
Teleport to Lumbridge lodestone, then run north-west along the road.
Use Lumbridge Teleport, then run north-west along the road.

The main entrance to the caves is through the Lumbridge Swamp, located south of Lumbridge. It is located in the centre of the swamp with a icon on the minimap. A rope is required when using this entrance for the first time. The Water altar is near this entrance.

Another route is through the basement of Lumbridge Castle, as the tunnels between the castle and the Dorgesh-Kaan mine also deviate towards the Swamp Caves, directly south from the tunnel entrance in the castle basement. The route between the tunnels and the Swamp Caves is initially blocked and needs to be mined. The Lost Tribe is required to access the tunnels and thus access the Swamp Caves from this direction.
A final route is via teleporting to the Tears of Guthix cavern with a games necklace then heading north.
The Lunar Isle lodestone once they have activated.
Use the astral altar teleport.
Use the spells Moonclan Teleport and Tele-group Moonclan.
A Ring of Wealth's teleport to Miscellania and then travelling to Rellekka (requires Throne of Miscellania quest to be completed).
Players can access the iceberg by sailing the Fremennik ship from the Fremennik Province coastline pier, north-east of Rellekka and north of the Fremennik Province lodestone close to the Rock Crabs.
The Ardougne lodestone is located directly south-west of Manor Farm.
If the medium Ardougne achievements have been completed, the Manor farm Teleport or the Ardougne cloak 2/3 can be used to teleport to Manor Farm once per day.
If the elite Ardougne achievements have been completed, the Manor farm Teleport or the Ardougne cloak 4 can be used to teleport to Manor Farm without any daily limit.
Skills necklace can be used to travel directly there.
Run roughly northwest from the main gate of Menaphos and look for the desert goebie camp.
Casting the Mazcab Teleport spell (requires it to be unlocked).
The Menaphos lodestone teleports players directly to the centre of the city.
If the Menaphos lodestone hasn't been unlocked yet, players can teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone, then run south.
If Pharaoh's Folly is completed, Leela's favour may teleport players to various Menaphos destinations.
The magic carpet system can be used to travel to the gates of Menaphos.
Use the Merchant district teleport to teleport directly into the Merchant district.
Use the Menaphos lodestone and walking North.
Fairy ring BKR is located within the swamp.
Fairy ring ALQ is located in the Haunted Woods. Run southwest to enter the swamp area.
Fairy ring CKS is located just north of Mort Myre. Run south through the gate to enter the swamp.
Upon reaching a combined total level of 100 in Temple Trekking, the gate at the north end of Mort Myre may also be used to quick-travel to the Nature Grotto near the south end of the swamp.
A games necklace can be used to teleport to the nearby town of Burgh de Rott after unlocking the destination by playing Temple Trekking.
Drakan's medallion can be used to teleport to the Barrows or Burgh de Rott (requires partial completion of The Branches of Darkmeyer).
Teleport to the Barrows via a boss portal.
A Swamp Boat can be taken directly to Mort'ton from the Hollows in the Mort Myre Swamp.
Teleport using rum (red) or rum (blue) bought from Honest Jimmy's House of Stuff.
Accessing through the fairy ring DIP.

If using the fairy ring shortcut, the player must first complete A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift and repair the bridges connecting the fairy ring island to the Mos le'Harmless mainland. This will require a total of 8 regular planks and 16 nails of any kind. Each bridge must be repaired from a different side, meaning the player must fix it from the Mos Le'Harmless side as well as the fairy ring island side if it is the first time using the shortcut.
Teleport to Mos Le'Harmless using the Big Book o' Piracy, then use the stepping stone to the east to cross the river.
Use the World Gate after completing Ritual of the Mahjarrat and Fate of the Gods to access Mount Firewake on Kethsi.

The tunnels are under the Mourner Headquarters in north-east West Ardougne. Start Mourning's End Part I and wear a Mourner outfit to enter the first part. The dark-beast section requires starting Mourning's End Part II and obtaining the new key.
Break a nature altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
Use the Karamja gloves 3 or 4 to teleport to the gemstone cavern, take the ladder to the surface, exit Shilo Village by the shortcut to the north, and go north-east to the ruins.
Use fairy ring code CKR and run north-east to the ruins.

The Nodon Front is located in the western section of Senntisten, which can be accessed by the ancient door north of the Archaeology Guild and directly east of Tolna's rift. After entering Senntisten the player needs to access the cathedral to the south of the entrance and then leave through the western cathedral door. Passing through the western door for the first time triggers a cutscene.
Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door east of the Rift.
The Pontifex shadow ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral.

The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology or access to those items.
Use the Master archaeologist's outfit to teleport to Chief Tess directly inside Oo'glog (requires Archaeology Guildmaster Qualification).
Teleport to the Oo'glog lodestone to arrive north outside its walls.

Travel by Charter ship (requires completion of As a First Resort) from a relevant dock elsewhere. The charter trip costs up to 5,000 coins depending upon the port of departure. The price can be halved twice if the player has done the Cabin Fever quest and is wearing a Ring of charos (a).

Use the Volcanic trapper outfit (with 39 Hunter) teleport to Wimpy bird hunting area, just outside the entrance of Oo'glog. The teleport option is accessed by selecting the right-click option 'teleport' on the head while wearing the outfit, then 'bird snaring' in the susequent menu.
Reach Anachronia first. Raksha's lair is south-west of Laniakea in the south-eastern part of the island, beneath the Anachronia Swamp Fortress.
Teleport using the ability of the Mask of the Airut.
Take the rowboat near the Eagles' Peak lodestone, west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Use fairy ring AKQ - Kandarin: Piscatoris Hunter area - (requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen). The closest bank is northwest of the master fairy ring in Zanaris.
Teleport to the Piscatoris Hunter area using a spirit kyatt's ability (requires Summoning level 57 and a spirit kyatt pouch).
Use the Fairy ring AKQ teleport location.
Use a Phoenix lair teleport scroll from Treasure trails rewards.
Teleport to the Eagles' Peak lodestone and go north.
Use Memory strand teleport to Memorial to Guthix and go northeast.

Use a house portal you can access, the House Teleport spell at 40 Magic, or a teleport-to-house tablet. The current housing system starts with There's No Place Like Home... in Rimmington. This method also needs a usable larder setup in the house.
As part of Tirannwn, accessing the Poison Waste requires completion of the Underground Pass quest.
The system of islands can be accessed by jumping on rocks on the north-east side of the waste, south-west of Lletya. From Lletya, pass the tree and then run directly south to get to the rocks.
The Tirannwn lodestone is located directly north of the Poison Waste.
The Tirannwn quiver 3 and its upgrade can teleport the player to the Tirannwn mushroom patch, which is located nearby.
The dungeon is in a canyon west of Castle Wars. Although it is in Tirannwn, players cannot reach it by passing through the main parts of Tirannwn, Arandar and Isafdar.

The fastest method of reaching the dungeon is by using the Spirit tree teleport to the Poison Waste. It can also be accessed by using a crossbow and mithril grapple to cross the river from the incandescent wisp colony. The grapple location can be accessed by the Grace of the Elves incandescent wisp colony teleport (must be set in Max guild garden, or when first worn), fairy ring BKP (partial completion of the A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest is required), or by walking from Castle Wars.

A quick way of banking is using a tier 2 or better luck ring (ring of Wealth, ring of Fortune, luck of the Dwarves, or Hazelmere's signet ring) to teleport to the Grand Exchange in Varrock then using the spirit tree in the north east corner of the Exchange. Additionally, players who have completed the medium Tirannwn achievements can use the Tirannwn quiver 2 teleport to arrive within the first room of the dungeon).
The entrance to the dungeon is west of the spirit tree, along the edge of the poison waste.
The cave entrance to the Polypore Slayer Dungeon can be found on a small island located in the River Salve, between Mort Myre Swamp and Al Kharid. Players can access it by.
Using the fairy ring code BIP. This is the fastest way to get there if a player has died, assuming the player has a quick method to reach a fairy ring and does not need the dramen staff.
Use a Dig Site pendant and teleporting to the Exam Centre and running south-east.
Use the Archaeology journal teleport and running south-east.
Ectophial teleport to the Ectofuntus (requires Ghosts Ahoy).
Use Canifis lodestone, run east to the Ectofuntus.
Fairy ring ALQ to the Haunted Woods, run east.
Players can reach it quickly by using an ectophial or Charter ship to get to Port Phasmatys and then run south, or by going east from Canifis.
Players can teleport to Port Sarim using the Home Teleport spell once they have activated Port Sarim lodestone.
Port Sarim can be entered by land from Falador to the north/north-west, Draynor Village to the east, Rimmington to the west, or Thurgo's Peninsula to the south.
If a player has the explorer's ring 3 or 4 equipped or in their inventory, they can teleport to the Falador cabbage patch north of the area and walk south.
Players can also travel by ship from Karamja, Crandor, or Entrana, arriving at the dock.
Use Tirannwn lodestone teleport, then run north out of Isafdar forest, across the river, and into the southern entrance of the city.

Use From Arandar pass (accessible with the Sixth-Age circuit teleport to the World Gate, the Book of Char teleport, or the Eagles' Peak lodestone), run along the pass west to the eastern entrance of the city.
The Prifddinas lodestone is located in the Tower of Voices.
Players in a clan may use the clan vexillum to teleport to the Clan citadel portal in the Tower of Voices.

Random wheat fields may spawn a crop circle to teleport the player. Certain fields are favoured by players owing to their proximity to banks and skilling areas. Additionally, the Farmer's Affinity bonus can make it easier to catch imps, and generally speeds up the game. Perhaps the most popular wheat fields would be those in Catherby and Yanille.
Teleport to the Fremennik Province lodestone places players south of the Hunter area and east of Rellekka.
The Arctic bear, a familiar available at level 71 summoning, can teleport the player to the area.

Players can appear near Keldagrim via fairy ring DKS (called the Kandarin Snowy Hunter Area in the rings' network directory). The Rellekka Hunter area is north of the ring. Partial completion of the A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest is required to use the rings.

The enchanted lyre, House Teleport (if the destination is set to Rellekka), and Rellekka tablet teleport players south of Rellekka. The Rellekka Hunter area is north-east of the city. The lyre requires completion of The Fremennik Trials quest, while the tablet requires completion of Love Story.

Use By activating the teleportation device in the spirit grove, leave the Anachronia base camp by following the directions to the arena below, upon using the lodestone run all the way east until arriving at the Matriarch lair door.
Use By using an attuned boss portal in War's Retreat or the combat portal in the Max Guild, being teleported right in front of the Matriarch lair door.
Use By casting the Eastern Anachronia Teleport spell from the standard spellbook requiring level 78 Magic, then going west.
Use For Osseous, click to teleport with the Osseous teleportation device to the eastern part of the lair, then click to cross the roots.
The Pick and Lute, with the entrance to the Rogues' Den, is near the centre of Taverley.
The fastest way to get there is the Teleport to House spell or tablet. Alternatively, after completion of Love Story, one may use a Taverley tablet to get to the house portal.
Use Taverley Home Teleport, then walk straight east into the bar and enter the trapdoor in the northeast corner.
Accessing the Sanctum of Rebirth requires the completion of Soul Searching.
Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
Use the combat portal in the Max Guild (requires level 99 in every skill).

The Senntisten sewers can be entered in the northern section of Senntisten, which can be accessed by the ancient door north of the Archaeology Guild and directly east of Tolna's rift. In the middle of the TzekHaar Front there is a large chasm with chains enabling the player to climb down to sewers. Entering the sewers for the first time triggers a cutscene.
Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door.
The pontifex shadow ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral, south of the entrance.
The boss portal in War's Retreat (requiring at least one kill of TzKal-Zuk) or the boss portal in the Max Guild (not requiring the kill) can be attuned to teleport the player to TzKal-Zuk.
Use Skeletal horror Teleport.
Use Fort Forinthry Teleport, then run east.
Use Varrock teleport, then run to the site.
Fairy ring (code CKS) near the entrance to Mort Myre Swamp, then go through the underground or take the level 65 Agility shortcut.
The fastest way to get to the Slayer Tower is to use the Mask of the Abyss.
Other items offering teleports that lead relatively close to the site are ring of slaying, the Mask of Broken Fingers, the Mask of Stench, and the Mask of Mourning.
Teleport to Canifis lodestone and then run west.
Fairy rings can be used to access code CKS which leads to a spot just south of the tower.
Access to Sophanem requires partial completion of Icthlarin's Little Helper.
After starting Icthlarin's Little Helper, enter the small cave near the Wanderer's tent, north of the city.
Use Pharaoh's sceptre teleport to Jalsavrah Pyramid. Exit the pyramid.
Use Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport brings players just south of Sophanem.
The dungeon is accessed via the dungeon entrance south of the temple of Icthlarin.
The fastest method is to use a Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport tablet. The ability to craft them is gained upon reaching rank 4 with any of the Menaphos factions.
Leela's favour provides unlimited teleports to the dungeon entrance.
The Mask of dust (or its transformed variant) can provide two free teleports to the entrance each day, assuming that the player has level 97 Slayer.
Fairy ring CKQ teleports into the west side of the Menaphos Imperial district, near the fountain entrance.
Use Menaphos lodestone teleport and run west (along the southside of the pyramid).
Leela's favour to imperial district and run west (along the southside of the pyramid).

Players with tier 6 reputation in the Imperial district can access the bank chest near the entrance of the Grand Library. The Imperial district teleport tablet places the player close to the chest, allowing players to use the two in conjunction to charge the altar without the use of the Abyss or fairy rings.
Use the South Feldip Hills Teleport.
Teleport with a ring of duelling to the Warforge Dig Site.
Teleport by using the Archaeology Guild map, using the Archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit to teleport to the Warforge Dig Site.
Additionally the Elder divination outfit can be used to teleport to the vibrant wisp colony.
Use Archaeology teleport, purchased for 250 chronotes from Ezreal at the Archaeology Guild Shop.
Use Archaeology journal, teleport to the Archaeology Campus then running west, inside the main building, and use the dig sites map table inside to teleport to it directly.
Use Master archaeologist's outfit teleport function.
Use Ardougne lodestone then running north-east.
Teleport directly into the sunken pyramid using the Slayer Codex if they have captured at least 50 different monster souls.
Take a boat from Menaphos Port district by speaking to Portmaster Kags on the south-western dock in the district.

This port is a possible location of the player-owned house (requires completion of The Jack of Spades), so the fastest way to get here if their house is in Menaphos is using the House Teleport spell or a teleport to house tablet, or a chipped Menaphos tablet after completion of the Love Story quest.
Use a Port district teleport tablet and run west to the dock.
Walk south from Burthorpe.
If the Taverley lodestone has been activated, a player may teleport there via the Home Teleport spell.

Taverley may also be reached via the balloon transport system. This provides ready access to Taverley from Varrock (by the earth altar), Entrana (west side of the island), Crafting Guild, Castle Wars (to the east & north), or from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Reaching Taverley requires 1 set of logs after unlocking the route.

If a player's player-owned house is in Taverley they can teleport there with House Teleport. If the Love Story quest has been completed, players can use a Taverley tablet (made from a chipped Teleport to house tablet) to teleport to the Taverley house portal, even if their house is located elsewhere.

The Obelisk of Water on an island can only be reached by traversing the dungeon. The island is just off the coast near Catherby. There is a one-way mithril grapple shortcut from the island to the shore which requires 36 Agility, 39 Ranged, and 22 Strength.

Before repairing fairy ring BJS (requires five bittercap mushrooms), players can get to the Lost Grove by inspecting the standstone south of the Poison Waste, west of the incandescent wisp colony. Methods for getting there include.
Use the incandescent wisp colony teleport on the elder divination outfit or the Solak boss portal.
Create a group for fighting Solak, Guardian of the Grove and teleport there alone (the minimum player requirement is only one).
Use the fairy ring code BKP or a ring of duelling to go south of Castle Wars and run west.

As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss. The time rift requires the ruins to be anchored using the enchanted key from Making History or the enchanted key from Meeting History at the time altar.
The fastest way to get there is through the Abyss with the Nexus Mod relic power and teleporting to Edgeville using the Wilderness sword.
A second way to get there is to use the North-western Anachronia Teleport spell or tablet. Harnessing the Abyssal Link relic power causes the spell to no longer require runes.
A third way to get there is to cast Anachronia Teleport if the Totem of the Abyss is placed on the totem pedestal on the north side of Anachronia.
The Tower of Life is found south of East Ardougne. It can be easily accessed using.
Using Ardougne cloak or Kandarin monastery Teleport, you can teleport to the nearby Monastery which is a short walk from the tower.
Use Ardougne Teleport brings you to the East Ardougne marketplace, with the tower to the south.
Fairy ring DJP brings you right next to the tower. Use of fairy rings requires partial completion of the quest A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen.

The Spirit tree at the crossroads south of the Grand Tree can be accessed from the Tree Gnome Village — it is on the northwest side, near the small obelisk. The north-east Grand Exchange tree is the easiest access to the network, with the South Feldip Hills tree (use a ring of duelling) or the Port Sarim farming patch tree following in convenience. After the Grand Tree this tree can send the player outwards to any other tree in the network, but incoming players must still go through the Tree Gnome Village hub.
Seed pods from the Gnome Restaurant minigame will instantly summon transport to the Grand Tree. They are consumed after one use.
Hazelmere's signet ring provides an unlimited free teleport (next to Argento and Hazelmere's statue).
Walk through the front gate. The first time you enter there is a small dialogue with Femi.
Partial completion of Regicide is required in order to access the Tyras Camp.
Tirannwn quiver 2/3/4 can teleport user directly to the middle of Tyras Camp.

Use Tirannwn lodestone teleport, then go through the Dense forest to the west, over the tripwires to the north, through the dense forest to the north, run west to the clearing, and go through the dense forest to the south.
Use TokKul-Zo teleport directly to the Fight Cave, Fight Kiln, Fight Cauldron, Fight Pit, or city centre.
Fairy ring BLP is located near the Fight Cave.
Use Amulet of glory teleport to Karamja, then run west from the banana plantation to the main entrance atop the Karamja Volcano.
Use Karamja lodestone teleport, then run east from Brimhaven, through the members' gate, to the volcano.

The TzekHaar Front is located in the northern section of Senntisten, which can be accessed by the ancient door north of the Archaeology Guild and directly east of Tolna's rift. In the middle of the front there is a large chasm with chains enabling the player to climb down to Senntisten sewers. Interacting with the chains for the first time triggers a cutscene.
Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door.
The pontifex shadow ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, can teleport the player directly to the cathedral, south of the front.

The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, Archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just south-east of the front, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology or access to those items.
Use After completing Rune Mythos and Requiem for a Dragon, use Ungael Teleport to reach the ritual site. To use the site after the quest, speak to the Archivist while wearing Zorgoth's ring.
Varrock lodestone is located by the south gate.

Varrock Teleport or the teletab teleports to the main square. The destination can be changed to southern Grand Exchange entrance (requires Easy Varrock achievements) or north-east church (requires Elite Varrock achievements).
A Grand Exchange Teleport, ring of wealth, ring of fortune, or luck of the dwarves can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.
The Senntisten option in the north-east of the Dig Site near the winch.
The Exam Centre option south of the Dig Site inside the Exam Centre.
The Archaeology journal will teleport the player in front of the Archaeology Guild.
Players can use the earth altar teleport to teleport to the earth altar and run south-east.
Use Archaeology journal teleport, then run west.
Use Varrock lodestone, then run east.
Use Varrock Teleport deposits players directly in the Square.
Use Varrock lodestone teleport to the southern city gate. Run north, through the city, to the Square.
Use Ring of Wealth, Ring of Fortune, Luck of the Dwarves, or Hazelmere's signet ring teleport to the Grand Exchange. Run southeast to the Square.
Break a water altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
Use a 'Chipped' Lumbridge teleport tablet or Dave's spellbook to teleport to the Lumbridge Swamp, then go south to the altar.
Use an enlightened amulet to teleport to the Lumbridge Swamp, then go south-west to the altar.
Players may teleport to the island using the Lunar magic spells Waterbirth Teleport or Tele-group Waterbirth, requiring level 72 and 73 Magic, respectively.

After obtaining the Fremennik sea boots 3 (by completing all hard Fremennik Tasks), the player has the option of changing the teleport location of the enchanted lyre to Waterbirth Island by using the Operate action on the boots. It is not necessary to wear the boots to make use of this teleport.

Jarvald at the westernmost dock in Rellekka can sail the player to the island. Players who have not completed The Fremennik Trials can go to the island by paying Jarvald a fee of 1,000 coins through his right-click talk-to option. Players who have completed The Fremennik Trials may talk to him after the quest, to unlock his quick-travel option and travel for free.

Upon arriving at Waterbirth Island, snow will fall in front of the player's screen. As the player lands on the island, they may follow the path west and south to venture inside Waterbirth Island Dungeon.
Players can teleport to Edgeville and Fort Forinthry to enter the Wilderness.
The fastest way to access the crater is using the Wilderness Crater lodestone.
Take a canoe to the Wilderness pond then run south and use one of the northern entrances to the crater.
Teleport to the level 35 obelisk using the obelisk network or a portable obelisk.
Use the Earth altar teleport, Varrock Teleport spell or the Edgeville lodestone, running through the Wilderness and using the southeastern entrance of the crater.
Use Home Teleport to Yanille lodestone.
Use Watchtower Teleport, toggled to Yanille after completing the Ardougne Set Tasks - Hard.
Use Ring of duelling teleport to Castle Wars.
To the north lies the Fight Arena, the Tree Gnome Village, a Monastery, Port Khazard and (further north) East Ardougne.
Players must go to the Yanille area to reach the dungeon.
The Watchtower Teleport to the Watchtower, which is quite close to the dungeon's northern entrance. This teleport ability is a reward of the Watchtower quest.
The House Teleport to Yanille, if the player has a house and has located it in Yanille.
The Ring of duelling teleport to Castle Wars, which is west of Yanille.
The entrance to the dungeon is located east of the pulley, which is used to enter Senntisten behind the Ancient door just north of the Archaeology Guild.
Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
Use the Pontifex Shadow Ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, to teleport to Senntisten, run north to the Pulley.
The quest Lost City is required for any and all methods of accessing Zanaris.
Skill portal tuned to the Zanaris fairy ring (requires completion of A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift).
Grace of the elves teleport, with a tuned Max Guild portal (requires completion of A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift).
Enter the hut in Lumbridge Swamp while holding a Dramen staff or lunar staff.
The Yanille lodestone is the closest to the fairy ring network.
The Edgeville lodestone, however, is the closest to both a bank and a fairy ring.
The Al Kharid lodestone is closest to the gnome glider network.
The Port Sarim lodestone is closest to a charter ship port.

However, players who have completed Summer's End may use a games necklace to teleport directly into the first of the caverns, or use the Boss portal to bring them right outside the chamber it resides in. Attempting to leave the caverns back out into the Wilderness while opted into PvP will cause a Wilderness warning prompt to appear before the player can continue.

Though the caves' entrance is in the Wilderness, the caverns themselves and the Corporeal Beast's lair are not dangerous Wilderness territory, as PVP and Wilderness level are disabled here. Before entering its room, players may investigate the passage and select the "Peek in" option to see a zoomed-in view of the Corporeal Beast's spawn point, in order to determine whether any other players are currently fighting it in an uninstanced encounter.
Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
Use a Dragonkin Laboratory teleport, which can be purchased from the Daemonheim Rewards shop.
Walk east of the Demonic Ruins to the peninsula north of Daemonheim (requires travelling through the Wilderness).

Use the ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, or the Dungeoneering cape to teleport to the Daemonheim Peninsula Island. From there, run east down the mountain to the treasure chest located by the Fremennik ship. Use the teleport option on the chest and select Dragonkin Laboratory (requires completion of Impressing the Locals).

Complete Ode of the Devourer to access the boss. Go to the northern docks in the City of Um and take the gondola next to the Suspicious Stranger's former position; the Gate is above the Sanctum of Rebirth.
Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).

Travel by Kharen's gondola in the north-west of the City of Um. This can be reached by running north from the City of Um lodestone, or by running south from the Ed's Boatyard station of the ferry system.
Use By activating the Teleportation device in the Spirit Grove, directly east from the Anachronia base camp, then running all the way east until arriving at the Rex Matriarch lair door.
Use By using a War's retreat attuned boss portal, being teleported right in front of the Rex Matriarch lair door.
Complete the quest Impressing the Locals to access the dungeon.
Teleport to Port Sarim and travel to the island of Aminishi by talking to Quartermaster Gully. Run to the main gate of the Temple of Aminishi to the north.
Use the Arc journal to teleport to the island of Aminishi and run to the Temple of Aminishi gate.
Use the boss portal in War's Retreat (requires at least one boss kill from the dungeon).
Use the Ring of kinship to teleport to Daemonheim, and then run east to the Fremennik ship (Shadow reef).
Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
Talk to Bryll Thoksdottir on the bridge west of Al Kharid bank to sail to the Daemonheim coast.
Players can enter the dungeon through the cave entrance located in Eastern Taverley, immediately south of Ewean's Grove.
Go to Falador Park in northern Falador and enter the plant roots to descend into the mole lair beneath the city.
The mausoleum is beneath the Slayer Tower in Morytania. It is also accessible from the Myreque memorial north of Canifis.
The temple is accessible during and after Beneath Scabaras' Sands. Go into the Scabarite Cavern outside Pollnivneach and use the old boat to reach the temple.

Abyssal demons can be found in the Slayer Tower, 6 in the south-west part of the top floor and 10 on part of the roof, which is accessible over an Agility shortcut. Twice a day, players can use the mask of the Abyss or helm of Warping to teleport here. It is also possible to use the resource dungeon below the Slayer Tower, but this requires level 100 Dungeoneering. The resource dungeon is usually less crowded, so players will have a lower chance of being crashed.

Morytania Slayer Tower dungeon can only be accessed with level 100 Dungeoneering (rewarding 35,000 Dungeoneering experience on first entry). The Dungeon is located to the east of the Morytania Slayer Tower entrance. There are 8 abyssal demons in both the south-east and south-west rooms. There are 8 imps located in the south-west room (which have a chance to drop imp champion scroll) with the 8 abyssal demons.

Kuradal's Dungeon can only be used while having a task from Kuradal, Morvran, or Laniakea. There are 10 abyssal demons crowded together here, making it easier to fight multiple of them. Players with 85 Agility can use one summer pie to bypass several rooms to make it quicker. Bank runs are somewhat cumbersome, so using Infernal urns and picking up the valuable drops is highly recommended to avoid wasting inventory space or ferocious ring charges. Alternatively, if a player has access to a pack yak familiar, they can use its special move to bank the ashes for a bigger profit. Quick access to here can be gained by the twice-daily teleports from the mask of the Abyss or helm of Warping, a ferocious ring teleport, or a fused full slayer helmet with ferocious ring charges on it.

The Abyssal Area contains several abyssal demons scattered around it. Getting to this area requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen as it can only be reached via the fairy ring code ALR. However, it is also inhabited by abyssal leeches, abyssal guardians and abyssal walkers, all of which are aggressive and can be a nuisance for players. As a result, this area is rarely visited for abyssal demons alone.

A superior locator is very helpful for travelling between elder tree locations, but the destinations are always random, and there is also a chance for it to teleport you to the same elder tree you're currently located at. There are two elder tree locations that superior locator will never teleport players to: the one located south-west of Lletya, and the one located in the Woodcutters' Grove east of Fort Forinthry.
Use the full Nature's sentinel outfit teleport option, all locations can be accessed up to 20 times per day.
Use Archaeology teleport, purchased for 250 chronotes from Ezreal at the Archaeology Guild Shop.
Use Archaeology journal, teleport to the Archaeology Campus then running west, inside the main building, and use the dig sites map table inside to teleport to it directly.
Use Ectophial, teleport to Port Phasmatys then run south.
Use Fairy ring (code ALQ), teleport to the Haunted Woods, run south-east then south.
The mine is between Port Khazard and Yanille. Use the Yanille lodestone and run north-east, or take a charter ship to Port Khazard and run south.
The cape of legends teleports the player directly inside the guild on the ground floor next to the Totem pole, or outside the front gates if toggled by using the cape.
The Quest Cape and master quest cape will also teleport the player to the same location as the Cape of Legends configuration but cannot change the destination.
Fairy ring BLR teleports the player to a point just outside the main gates.
The Sixth-Age circuit teleports to Guthix's Shrine to the west of the guild.
Using a Slayer cape or any of its variants to teleport to Mandrith, who is very close to the mine.
Use Wilderness sword 4 teleport to Wilderness Agility Course, then run northeast.
Use Pull the lever in East Ardougne or Edgeville to teleport to Deserted Keep, run north, then west.
Obelisk (Wilderness) to level 44 Wilderness, north through the gate, then northeast.
The Senntisten asylum can be entered by operating the asylum elevator to the north-east of Senntisten Cathedral.
Teleport directly into the asylum using the Mask of the Abyss or Helm of Warping.
Teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site, then head north to the elevator.
Use the master archaeologist's outfit teleport.
Pontifex shadow ring: Teleport to the cathedral. The cathedral is in the south-eastern Senntisten Dig Site.
Archaeology journal: Teleport to Archaeology Campus, use the dig sites map in Archaeology Guild in the west and select Senntisten. Leads to the eastern Senntisten Dig Site.
Master archaeologist's outfit: While wearing full outfit, right click on master archaeologist's hat, and teleport to Senntisten. Leads to the eastern Senntisten Dig Site.
Gnome glider: Fly to Lemanto Andra, leading just west of the Varrock Dig Site. Walk north-east to the ancient door. Leads to the north-eastern Senntisten Dig Site.
Use a wicked hood or infinity ethereal outfit for unlimited teleportation to the roof of the tower.
Use stardust in the currency pouch to teleport to the floor 2 above ground next to Wizard Rosalina (after talking to her about the stardust).
Use a traveller's necklace to arrive at the entrance of the tower.

Use the code DIS on the fairy ring network to arrive south of the tower. There is also a portal on the floor 2 above ground (eastern portal) of the Wizards' Guild in Yanille offering direct teleportation to the ground floor arriving at the centre of the tower next to the beam.
Use Prifddinas lodestone, walk south and then east.
Use Crystal teleport seed (or its attuned variant) to Trahaearn Clan district and then north-west.

guides.page: Money making guide/Adding herbs to incense sticks
instructions: Making incense sticks is a profitable way to gain Firemaking experience, although slower than usual training methods. Kwuarm incense sticks is useful in PvM when using weapon poison.

27 incense sticks can be made per inventory, and each inventory takes 48.6 seconds. A bank preset of a stack of Accursed acadia incense sticks and 27 Clean kwuarm is recommended to achieve a maximum of close to 972 sticks made per hour.
However, there is not much trading volume and profit margin for whoever makes those, therefore you may find it hard to buy Accursed acadia incense sticks on the Grand Exchange.
travel: Use a convenient bank to withdraw the listed supplies and deposit the results.

guides.page: Money making guide/Blessing extra fine sand
instructions: Blessed sand is extra fine sand that has been blessed by using it on any altar of Saradomin. It is part of the process of making blessed molten glass. It can be blessed by using the "bless" option while standing next to an altar, or by using it on the altar directly. The most convenient place to make blessed sand seems to be at the Lumbridge Church.

The processing time is 2 ticks or 1.2 seconds per sand. This means in an hour (3,600 seconds) you can theoretically process 3,000 sand. The actual amount is closer to 2,800 depending on how AFK you are. Up to 60 blessed sand is made at a time. Knowing it takes 1.2 seconds per sand, you are able to AFK for 72 seconds between actions.
Extra fine sand can be blessed at more Saradomin-aligned altars, including.
Edgeville Monastery.
Lumbridge Church.
guides.location: Any Saradomin altar; the guide suggests Lumbridge Church

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying balls of wool
instructions: Ball of wool is used to train Crafting. There are many shops where one can buy balls of wool, however buying them from Jofridr Mordstatter is the quickest because of her proximity to a bank. Purchasing all the wool takes less than a minute. There are multiple ways of getting to Neitiznot.
Teleport to Rellekka via the Fremennik Province lodestone.
Run north west into town and take the boat to Neitiznot (north-east pier).
Buy the balls of wool from Jofridr and bank them until she is out of stock.
When finished, sell them on the Grand Exchange.
travel: Teleport to Rellekka via the Fremennik Province lodestone.
Run north west into town and take the boat to Neitiznot (north-east pier).

instructions: This method involves buying bear fur from Bareak in Varrock square. He sells the fur for 20 coins but you have to talk to him and buy 1 at a time so this is very click intensive. When you have a full inventory you should head west to the bank to deposit and then repeat. It takes around 2 minutes and 30 seconds to buy a full inventory and bank so you should be able to get 550 bear furs an hour.
It is possible to simplify the process using the number keys, click Bareak and quickly press 2, (SPACE), (SPACE), 1, (SPACE) then click on Bareak again and repeat the process.
