When you have a full inventory you should head west to the bank to deposit and then repeat. It takes around 2 minutes and 30 seconds to buy a full inventory and bank so you should be able to get 550 bear furs an hour.

instructions: Bomb vials are in high demand for use in Herblore, players will pay a premium to get them instantly.
Start by teleporting to the Taverley lodestone.
Run south east to Jatix's Herblore Shop and buy the 100 bomb vials.

If Plague's End quest has been completed, teleport either to the Prifddinas lodestone and run north east to the Meilyr Clan Store or teleport directly to the Meilyr district with (attuned) crystal teleport seed.
Buy the 100 bomb vials.
travel: Use Start by teleporting to the Taverley lodestone.
Run south east to Jatix's Herblore Shop and buy the 100 bomb vials.

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying buckets of milk
instructions: Buy buckets of milk in The Milk Shop, from the milk seller in Falador farm, for 12 coins each. Bank with War's Retreat Teleport, then use the explorer's ring 3 to return.

There are 200 in stock, but this is a non-personalised shop; each world has a separate stock, so you can keep buying them indefinitely with enough worlds to cycle from and no competition. It takes 7 runs to get 196 buckets of milk in a world before hopping. Each world takes about 3 minutes and 45 seconds (225 seconds). That is 16 worlds per hour, or 3136 buckets of milk per hour.
The Milk Shop takes 100 minutes to fully restock, so you need about 27 worlds to do this continuously.
This can be done with no teleports, but would be much slower.

War's Retreat Teleport for banking can be substituted for the slower but practically requirements-free Archaeology journal. Either should only be used if the explorer ring 3 is available, as there are no other practical teleports to the Falador farm.
travel: Use Buy buckets of milk in The Milk Shop, from the milk seller in Falador farm, for 12 coins each. Bank with War's Retreat Teleport, then use the explorer's ring 3 to return.
This can be done with no teleports, but would be much slower.

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying construction materials from Bandit Duty Free
instructions: The Bandit Duty Free shop, located in the Bandit Camp in level 23 Wilderness, sells various construction supplies at much lower than the GE guide price.
Before going to the Bandit Camp, PVP must be enabled to avoid the Bandit Camp NPCs from attacking you. Teleport to the Edgeville lodestone and speak to Vala to opt into PVP.
Next, bank all items except a method to teleport away while in level 23 wilderness if you have it, such as dragonstone teleport jewellery or Wilderness sword 4.
Teleport to the Wilderness Crater lodestone and run northwest until you reach the Bandit Camp.
Or use Portable obelisk to teleport to level 27 wilderness and run south (warning: location is surrounded by Abyssal savages).
travel: The Bandit Duty Free shop, located in the Bandit Camp in level 23 Wilderness, sells various construction supplies at much lower than the GE guide price.
Before going to the Bandit Camp, PVP must be enabled to avoid the Bandit Camp NPCs from attacking you. Teleport to the Edgeville lodestone and speak to Vala to opt into PVP.

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying crossbows from shops
instructions: Crossbows are sometimes used for low level ranging training, but more commonly they are disassembled for components. You can buy more items from each of the shops but due to the small profit margins I have ignored them. It's also worth noting that with less items in your inventory the faster you can complete this moneymaker. The Crossbow Shop (Dwarven Mine) and Crossbow Shop (White Wolf Mountain) share the same stock, with White Wolf Mountain being slightly easier to get to.
A beast of burden will be useful if you have the summoning level for it. Start off by banking all items except, magic notepaper and equip a ring of wealth to travel to Keldagrim.
Teleport to Taverley lodestone and run north to the cave next to the POH portal.
Run west and talk to Holoy at the Crossbow Shop (White Wolf Mountain).
Buy all of the crossbows and note them.
travel: A beast of burden will be useful if you have the summoning level for it. Start off by banking all items except, magic notepaper and equip a ring of wealth to travel to Keldagrim.
Teleport to Taverley lodestone and run north to the cave next to the POH portal.

instructions: Feathers are used in arrow making and fishing, and are always in demand on the Grand Exchange. They are much cheaper in shops than on the GE, so a profit can be made easily by buying feathers from shops and selling on the GE. They are also sold in feather packs by the same merchants.
Teleport to the Lumbridge lodestone, and purchase all 3,500 feathers and 20 feather packs from Lumbridge Fishing Supplies, just northwest of the lodestone.
Teleport to the Catherby lodestone, run south-east and buy 20 feather packs from Harry's Fishing Shop.
Teleport to the Al Kharid lodestone, and run south to the Shantay Pass (or use an Amulet of glory). Buy 3,500 feathers and 20 feather packs from Shantay.
Teleport to the Draynor lodestone and go north into Draynor Manor. Purchase 3,500 feathers and 20 feather packs from Ava (after completing Animal Magnetism).
travel: Teleport to the Lumbridge lodestone, and purchase all 3,500 feathers and 20 feather packs from Lumbridge Fishing Supplies, just northwest of the lodestone.
Teleport to the Catherby lodestone, run south-east and buy 20 feather packs from Harry's Fishing Shop.

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying from the Culinaromancer's Chest
instructions: The Culinaromancer's Chest sells various culinary items. The exact stock depends on how many of the Recipe for Disaster subquests have been completed, but when the entire quest has been completed, all stock will be available. The chest also acts as a bank, so buying and banking the items is relatively quick.
Go to Lumbridge using the lodestone or the Lumbridge Teleport.

Head to the basement and start buying the listed items, closing the shop and banking each time There are other profitable items. Buying a few of each item for the first backpack full will allow more respawns to be bought, increasing the profit slightly. After stocking up on the culinary items, selling them on the Grand Exchange should be easy..
travel: Go to Lumbridge using the lodestone or the Lumbridge Teleport.

Head to the basement and start buying the listed items, closing the shop and banking each time There are other profitable items. After stocking up on the culinary items, selling them on the Grand Exchange should be easy..

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying items from Martin Thwait
instructions: Buying some of the items he sells (lockpick along with most claws, knives and possibly rope) and banking them with Emerald Benedict, who usually wanders around the south-west corner of the Den, can be profitable.

The bronze, iron and black claws, along with the bronze and iron knives, can be harder to re-sell, so they weren't included in the inputs, outputs and profits. It is, of course, not necessary to buy all of the items listed here -- perhaps you just want to buy only the knives (since they stack and require no banking) with the adamant claws, depending on the current prices.

The fastest way to get there is to teleport to house, if the player-owned house located in Taverley, or simply access the Taverley lodestone using the Home Teleport and head east right away. Sell the items on the Grand Exchange when finished.
travel: The fastest way to get there is to teleport to house, if the player-owned house located in Taverley, or simply access the Taverley lodestone using the Home Teleport and head east right away. Sell the items on the Grand Exchange when finished.

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying items from axe shops
instructions: This money making method is quite simple, the aim is to buy every item from both Axe shops and sell the items onto the GE.
Start at Lumbridge lodestone with only magic notepaper in inventory.
Run south to Bob's Brilliant Axes.
Buy all of the items.
Bank everything apart from magic notepaper.
travel: Use Start at Lumbridge lodestone with only magic notepaper in inventory.
Run south to Bob's Brilliant Axes.

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying items from farm shops
instructions: Buying the stackable items means the daily moneymaker can be completed much quicker, there are however more items from the farm shops that return a profit; - compost, requiring to be banked or noted increasing the daily drastically.
Teleport to Canifis lodestone.
Run East to Alice's farm shop and buy the item packs.
Teleport to Taverley lodestone.
Run north to Jones's farming shop and buy the item packs.
travel: Teleport to Canifis lodestone.
Run East to Alice's farm shop and buy the item packs.

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying items from pet shop
instructions: The items from pet shops are used as food for animals within the player-owned farm, with other players often paying above mid price on the GE due to the low volume. The stock is shared between the two stores so it's only worth visiting one per day.
Start by teleporting to the Taverley lodestone.
Run south across the bridge and go into the pet shop.
Buy all of the nuts, flies, and beetle bits.
Sell everything on the Grand Exchange. or.
travel: Use Start by teleporting to the Taverley lodestone.
Run south across the bridge and go into the pet shop.

Go to Fort Forinthry using the lodestone.

Head towards Bill and right-click trade to start buying the Limestone Brick There are other "profitable" items that Bill sells, but just barely. Selling the Limestone Brick's on the Grand Exchange should be easy.

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying meat from Chargurr
instructions: Fresh Meat is a shop owned by Chargurr in Oo'glog. The shop is located just north of the bank in the centre of town. The shop is easily accessible from the Oo'glog lodestone or by teleporting to Chief Tess using the Master archaeologist's outfit. Buying the meat pack, with the archaeologist outfit teleport, makes it a very quick daily activity to complete.

The shop is easily accessible from the Oo'glog lodestone or by teleporting to Chief Tess using the Master archaeologist's outfit. Buying the meat pack, with the archaeologist outfit teleport, makes it a very quick daily activity to complete.

instructions: Every 24 hours you can buy 500 mithril seeds at the Legends' Guild Shop of Useful Items and resell them on the grand exchange for a small daily profit.

instructions: Buy plant cure from Head Farmer Jones's Farming Shop in Taverley for 40 coins each. After buying a full inventory deposit them at the bank to the south or use the War's Retreat Teleport for quick bank access. Then use the explorer's ring 3 to teleport to Sarah's Farming Shop near Falador and buy more plant cure. Home teleport, bank and buy another lot of plant cures at Vanessa's Farming Shop in Catherby. There are 10 in stock in each shop but it only takes about ~60 seconds for them to fully restock. Each trip takes about 2 minutes to get 28 potions. We can make approximately 30 trips per hour, so that gives us 840 potions per hour.

instructions: Many types of runes can be bought from various rune shops for considerably less than their Grand Exchange market value. Many of these shops hold a stock of 7,000 of the basic elemental runes, of which most notably water runes, fire runes, and soul runes yield a notable profit when sold in the Grand Exchange. Upon arriving at a shop, purchase all of the profitable runes (see Outputs above).
Shops restock runes over 1 week so runs can be done more than just once a week, but will have a reduced number available.
Teleport to the Edgeville lodestone, head north to the Mage of Zamorak's shop Battle Runes, if the Abyss miniquest is complete, located in level 5 Wilderness.

Make sure you are opted out of PvP or return to Edgeville and bank all your items. Head south to the ruined building in Edgeville and travel to level 51 Wilderness by pulling the Edgeville teleport lever. Exit the Deserted Keep you find yourself in by cutting through the cobweb blocking the way north, and head west to a small ruined building north of the Mage Arena. Cut through the two cobwebs blocking the way and pull the lever to be transported to the small cave where Lundail runs his Arena-side Rune Shop. This is a safe area that is not considered part of the Wilderness and also contains a bank.
travel: Teleport to the Edgeville lodestone, head north to the Mage of Zamorak's shop Battle Runes, if the Abyss miniquest is complete, located in level 5 Wilderness.

Make sure you are opted out of PvP or return to Edgeville and bank all your items. This is a safe area that is not considered part of the Wilderness and also contains a bank. Players who own the Slayer cape may get here faster by using it to teleport to Mandrith and then running east.

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying shields from Cassie
instructions: Shields are in demand to being essential for combat training as well as being disassembled for Invention components, due to this demand players will often pay the higher price of the GE rather than visiting the shop.

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying supplies from Razmire
instructions: Razmire General Store and Razmire Builders' Merchants are two shops run by Razmire Keelgan in Mort'ton. Buying some of the items he sells (olive oil, limestone bricks, planks and possibly limestone) and banking them in Burgh de Rott can be profitable. Limestone often has a better profit margin than limestone bricks, but they are usually harder to re-sell. It's of course not necessary to buy all of the items listed here -- perhaps you just want to buy the olive oil and the planks, depending on the current prices.

The fastest way to buy items from Razmire is to use drakan's medallion, a reward from The Branches of Darkmeyer quest. This allows you to teleport for free to just south of the Burgh de Rott bank. Otherwise you have to run all the way from Mort'ton to Burgh de Rott to bank. Start off next to the Burgh de Rott bank, run north and jump over the fence. Run further north to the building marked with a general store icon, trade Razmire and buy the items you want -- olive oil is in the general store, but the other items are in the building supplies store. Either teleport or run back to the bank, and repeat. Sell the items on the Grand Exchange when finished.

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying supplies from the Stonemason
instructions: The Keldagrim Stonemason shop run by the Stonemason in Keldagrim supplies a small number of expensive construction materials. One of these, gold leaves is consistently profitable to buy from him and sell on the Grand Exchange. Purchase the items listed in the Outputs section above with non-zero quantities; those listed at zero quantity are either not profitable or do not have a high enough trade volume to support reliable sales.

The easiest way to get to the Stonemason is using the Luck of the Dwarves teleport, which brings the player just north-east of his shop. Alternatively, use the Keldagrim trapdoor in the north-west corner of the Grand Exchange. The Stonemason's shop is located in the southernmost part of Keldagrim West. Buy all of his limestone bricks — this should take 18 trips to the bank, which is found to the north-west. In the past his other stock has occasionally been profitable, but this is often not the case as those items see little use and can be obtained in small amounts at lower costs - either from the Bandit Duty Free shop in the case of marble blocks and gold leaf, or as a rare reward from Menaphite gift offerings for magic stone.

guides.page: Money making guide/Buying vials of water
instructions: Vials of water are used in Herblore, and are always in demand on the Grand Exchange. They are much cheaper in the shops than on the Grand Exchange, so a profit can be made easily by buying vial of water from the shops and selling on the Grand Exchange. With the addition of bomb vials that can be bought from Jatix in Taverley, Lady Meilyr in Prifddinas and Granny Rowan in Fort Forinthry one can significantly increase profit at little to no time cost.
1. Teleport to the Taverley lodestone and head south-east to Jatix.
2. Teleport to the Prifddinas lodestone (must have completed Plague's End) and head north to Lady Meilyr.
3. Use the Lighthouse Teleport (must have completed Horror from the Deep) and head upstairs to Jossik.

4. Use the Juju teleport spiritbag (must have completed Shilo Village) and head west into Shilo Village to Obli (general store). For a faster route, if you have Karamja gloves 3, use its teleport and walk south from the gem mine.
guides.location: Lady Meilyr, Jatix, Jossik, Obli, Granny Rowan
travel: Use 1. Teleport to the Taverley lodestone and head south-east to Jatix.
2. Teleport to the Prifddinas lodestone (must have completed Plague's End) and head north to Lady Meilyr.

guides.page: Money making guide/Casting Bones to Bananas
instructions: Bananas are primarily used in Summoning to create the Fruit bat familiar, and as a cheap source of fruity mush.

The staff of water removes the need of any water runes and the Mud battlestaff (members) removes the need of any water runes and earth runes. If wielding the staff of water set up one of your quick presets to withdraw 26 bones, 1 nature rune and 2 earth runes. For members wielding the Mud battlestaff this would be 27 bones and 1 nature rune. Cast Bones to Bananas, which will cause the bones in your inventory to turn into bananas. Open the bank, click the Quick Preset, and repeat.
The Explorer's ring 4 gives a 50% chance of casting Bones to Bananas for free for up to 10 times per day, somewhat reducing the cost of this money-making method.

The method is most effective in low latency servers at a vacant bank. Use the Quick Preset hotkey "1", positioning mouse at the bank, put Bones to Bananas on keybind "Q" and continuously hold the key. It is possible to cast 2,800 spells per hour. The bank should be clicked immediately as the bank window has closed, and press "1" again immediately when bank is opened. This totals to 72,800 bones converted in an hour wielding a staff of water/earth, and 75,600 bones if wielding the mud battlestaff.
travel: Use a convenient bank to withdraw the listed supplies and deposit the results.

guides.page: Money making guide/Casting High Level Alchemy on ascendri bolts (e)
instructions: This simple money making method is made by casting High Level Alchemy on Ascendri bolts (e). Efficient casting can complete 1200 casts per hour. Usually moving the item in the inventory to line up with the cast High Level Alchemy spell on the normal Spellbook.
This can be done anywhere as there is no need to bank.

guides.page: Money making guide/Casting High Level Alchemy on onyx bolts (e)
instructions: Casting High Level Alchemy on onyx bolts (e) is a low-effort, semi-AFK money making and Magic training method that converts purchased onyx bolts (e) into coins via the High Level Alchemy spell. Because onyx bolts (e) have a high buy limit (11,000 per 4 hours) and a strong alch margin, this is one of the more sustainable high alching targets for stacking up casts without running into Grand Exchange limits.

High Level Alchemy converts an item into coins equal to 60% of its base value, and takes 5 game ticks (3 seconds) to cast, allowing a maximum of 1,200 casts per hour. Equipping a staff of fire or similar fire-providing staff removes the need to supply fire runes, leaving the nature runes as the only consumable cost per cast.

At a Grand Exchange price of 7,233 coins per bolt and a High Alchemy value of 9,000 coins, each cast nets roughly 1,395 coins before the nature rune cost is considered (9,000 − 7,233), with the nature rune (372 coins) bringing per-cast profit to approximately 1,395 coins and an hourly profit of roughly 1.67M coins at maximum cast speed. Profit margins shift constantly with the GE price of both Onyx bolts (e) and nature runes, so check current prices before buying in bulk.
travel: Use a convenient bank to withdraw the listed supplies and deposit the results.

instructions: The Superglass Make lunar spell can instantly turn an inventory full of sand and soda ash into molten glass. Withdraw sand and soda ash from your bank, activate Superglass Make, bank the resulting glass and repeat. On average 1.3 glass will be made for every sand-soda ash pair.
This can be done efficiently by using the same keybind for the bank preset and the spell on an action bar. This way it's possible to cast the spell about 2,000 times an hour.

Another, more click-intensive method is by positioning your camera so when you right click a bank chest or banker the cursor already is over the "Load last Preset from" option, and then almost immediately pressing the keybind for Superglass Make. Utilizing this method allows one cast of Superglass Make every Game tick, or 6,000 casts an hour assuming perfect uninterrupted timing.

The large or grasping rune pouch can be used to store Astral runes and then equipped, meaning you can convert 14 sets of sand and soda ash per cast instead of only 13, increasing the profit per hour by about 7%. The Elemental battlestaff supplies unlimited fire and air runes, further increasing profit.
Note that the buy limit for both buckets of sand and soda ashes on the Grand Exchange is 10,000 every four hours.
travel: Use a convenient bank to withdraw the listed supplies and deposit the results.

instructions: A Fruit Bat scroll (Fruitfall) send the fruit bat foraging for fruit, and produces papayas, oranges, limes, pineapples and bananas.
The most profitable and time-efficient of these is the papaya, which you will be collecting. The papaya is used in the creation of Adrenaline potions which are in high demand from pvmers.
Turn on Area loot in the options for faster and easier looting.
Stand outside a bank with an open area near it - Edgeville and Clan Wars work well.
Summon your fruit bat, withdraw your stack of Fruit Bat scroll (Fruitfall)s, and bring two Summoning potions.

instructions: Avantoe are in high demand to create Super energy and Extreme attacks. It is often profitable to clean the grimy herbs and sell them on the Grand Exchange. Like all methods involving large amounts of buying and selling, it is recommended to test the market first to make sure cleaning avantoe is profitable.

28 herbs can be cleaned per inventory, and each inventory takes 16.8s (28 ticks), so a maximum of around 5,000 herbs can be cleaned per hour. Due to the risk of repetitive strain, it is advised to use make-x to speed up the cleaning process.
Utilising a Herblore cape, presets, and the action bar, it is possible to clean an inventory approximitely every two seconds resulting in up to 50,000 herbs cleaned per hour.
Please note that grimy avantoes have a buying limit of 10,000 every four hours, so you may clean them faster than you can buy them.
guides.location: Grand Exchange or bank chest recommended

guides.page: Money making guide/Cleansing the Gate of Elidinis
instructions: Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

Level 80 Mining is recommended, however this boss does not have any strict mining level requirement. Your speed at killing this boss is related only to your mining damage and knowledge of the mechanics.

Kills using a Gargoyle familiar and scrolls will be faster, the cost of the scrolls far outweighs the increase in speed of kills. Instead, this guide assumes that a mining familiar such as a Lava Titan, or a beast of burden is used. With practice, 20 kills per hour is possible. Refer to the strategy page for more information.

guides.page: Money making guide/Collecting Bik Elder Troves
instructions: Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your upgrades.
It's highly recommended to fully upgrade and overcharge the Pontifex shadow ring, it's possible to obtain 10 Elder Trove (Bik, T3) an hour which will give the best money making possible.

To obtain an Elder trove, xp has to be gained within the range of 6:00 to 12:00 minutes whilst being in the Croesus Front; The time delay will depend on the tier of the player's Pontifex shadow ring. It's possible to leave the Croesus front and return to trigger another Elder trove drop, this is useful if you are training another skill that isn't possible within the Croesus front.

High tier augmented tools do not affect your troves per hour and only increase your assumed xp per hour. If you are training a different skill and using the above method to accumulate Troves, the tools on your Tool Belt are adequate.

It's highly recommended to use the Grace of the Elves to gain Seren spirits and make use of porters. Alternatively Magic notepaper can be used to save on porters, but this will be less afk. Use of the porters isn't required if Fishing and you're using the Fury shark outfit's destroy function.

After completing the quest Dragon Slayer, you may return to Duke Horacio on the floor 1 above ground of Lumbridge Castle at any time to obtain more Anti-dragon shields. The Duke will give you a new shield even if you already have one in your inventory, so the drop trick is not necessary for this method. Speak to the Duke and press the space bar to advance his dialogue, then press the "1" key to select the dialogue option "I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath." Hold the space bar to advance the Duke's dialogue until he gives you a shield, then rinse and repeat. Alternatively, if you unlock your GUI, you can drag the NPC dialogue box so that it overlaps with the Duke. Doing this, you can simply hold down the space bar and click both the Duke and the shield dialogue option without needing to move your mouse.

With high efficiency, you can obtain one shield in about four seconds. You can convert a full inventory of 27 (26 if you already have noted shields in your inventory) Anti-dragon shields into notes at the same time by using a shield on a piece of Magic notepaper. Take care not to left click on the shield, as this will equip it rather than using it.
guides.location: floor 1 above ground of Lumbridge Castle

guides.page: Money making guide/Collecting blue dragon scales
instructions: The better place to collect them is the resource dungeon as they're closer together and there are more of them, but that area requires 60 Dungeoneering to access. Without the resource dungeon, you can collect about 550 scales per hour, compared to 900 inside the resource dungeon. 70 Agility is also recommended to avoid having to traverse Taverley Dungeon, which would require a dusty key. A Beast of Burden like the spirit terrorbird, war tortoise, or pack yak are also very helpful to cut down on banking time.

Teleport to Taverley using the Taverley lodestone and head south to the dungeon entrance. Use Surge to travel faster. Enter the obstacle pipe if you have 70 Agility, or otherwise go the long way around (see for details). Enter the resource dungeon if you're able, and start collecting the dragon scales, being careful not to attack any blue dragons by accident. Pick up all of the scales (they respawn very quickly), storing them in your familiar as needed. Enabling area loot will allow you to pick up multiple scales quickly. When your inventory is full, teleport back to Taverley, bank the scales, and repeat. Grinding the scales is usually not worth the time taken and is not recommended, as the scale dust costs much less than the regular scales.

instructions: The rate assume 625 actions are performed per hour, approximately 23 inventories or 2:35 per cycle. guides.page: Money making guide/Collecting dinosaur eggs from seggregation
instructions: Dinosaur eggs can be collected quickly from the Seggregation activity by collecting eggs from the pile of dinosaur eggs and destroying the good and bad eggs. This allows the dinosaur eggs which are occasionally found during this activity to be obtained rapidly as there is no need to move between stations in order to produce sharp shell shards.
Grapes spawn on the top floor of the Cooks' Guild. Due to the long respawn time, this method requires world switching to gather grapes more quickly.
Each trip takes 7.5 minutes, or 8 trips per hour. This may vary significantly based on how fast world switching can be done.
While there is also a spawn for grapes in the Phoenix Gang Hideout, it is further from a bank.

If you do not want to switch worlds, you can use another method in conjunction, such as Fletching headless arrows, because Fletching doesn't require banking or a lot of inventory spaces. Profit varies depending on the combinations of methods.

Harmonic dust can be obtained by playing harps within the Ithell district of Prifddinas. Harps are a very low effort way of training crafting, and the harmonic dust has many uses. Once you have acquired all of the crystal items you need, the dust can be made into items and sold for profit - this is a nice supplementary income whilst training crafting. If you're planning on staying at harps for many hours, it's worth buying crystal armour seeds or crystal weapon seeds earlier than you need as they can take awhile to buy on the GE. Approximately 750 dust can be obtained an hour without VoS (or artificer's measure) at level 99 Crafting.

Honeycombs are used to make honey badger pouches. They can be extracted from the beehives East of Manor Farm behind the large pen. This requires insect repellent, which can be stored in the toolbelt. Extracting honeycomb is a click-intensive process as you have to right-click and select "Honey" for each one you want, though you can skip the animation of the character collecting the honeycomb by re-clicking the honey option on the same beehive.

Fill your inventory and run to the Manor Farm bank chest and back, and repeat. Use of Surge will decrease the time needed to bank. If the player has access to a Beast of Burden this can be used to further increase the amount of honeycombs that can be gathered per trip.

instructions: Four jangerberries, used to make zamorak brews, can be found on an ogre-infested island north of Gu'Tanoth.

Starting at the Castle Wars lobby with only a rope in your inventory and a ring of duelling equipped, run straight east to the island. Use Surge to either cross the bridge or after the point where the character last turns before the lake to speed up the trip. Then, use the rope on the tree branch, jumping over to the island (this will use up the rope).

The ogres on the island are not aggressive. Run in a circle, continually collecting the berries. When your inventory is full, teleport back to the lobby with your duelling ring, bank, and repeat. A bank preset can be used to speed banking up.

instructions: There are 4 spawns of limpwurt root in the resource dungeon located within Edgeville Dungeon where the Hill Giants are. To access the dungeon efficiently, a brass key is needed to enter the hut just west of Cooks' Guild. Then, head south to the room containing Hill Giants and limpwurt root spawns.

As they are level 26, Hill Giants are aggressive to any player with a combat level of 52 or less, which may be an annoyance to the gathering process. It is therefore recommended to have at least level 53 combat.

On an averagely populated world, each limpwurt root re-spawns at a rate of around 56 seconds. However, as it takes less than 15 seconds to collect all 4 roots, it is recommended to constantly switch between worlds, effectively eliminating the respawn time. Once the inventory is full, head back up the shortcut to Varrock and bank the limpwurt roots at the Grand Exchange. Use of Surge will allow the player to make faster trips.

instructions: Memory shards may be obtained from pickpocketing, checking hunter traps, or planting seeds, when the relevant passive perk (for each method) is active from the Memorial to Guthix. When memory shards are earned, it will prompt the message "You find a small fragment of a memory".
Memory shards can also be obtained in the Hall of Memories while harvesting memories when the buff from getting close to a recollection butterfly is active.

Each time you obtain memory shards the amount varies, so it's possible to get as low as 400 and as high as 800 per hour depending on luck. For this guide 600 memory shards has been used as an average obtained per hour.
Memory shards can be converted into porters, with the best conversation rate being Sign of the porter IV with 1.25 charges per shard.
Profit per hour column is based on converting 600 memory shards.
travel: No fixed destination is specified for this method. Choose a convenient place for the activity.

guides.page: Money making guide/Collecting mort myre fungi
instructions: Collecting mort myre fungi is very profitable as it is the secondary ingredient for making super energy potions. While wearing Morytania legs, players will receive double the amount of fungi when collecting. However, make sure there are at least two inventory spaces when collecting, otherwise players will only receive one fungus. Casting bloom affects rotting objects in the 8 squares around the player and consumes between 10 and 60 prayer points (though if the player only has 1 prayer point left, bloom can still be cast). Players should use a location surrounded by 3 rotting logs to increase the chances of obtaining mort myre fungus. An Ivandis flail or blessed silver sickle can be placed on the action bar to cast bloom with hotkeys. Players should use the three logs south of the Deposit Box as those are the most efficient. Gathering the fungus by prioritising the logs in the order of South-west, west, then East, you can cast bloom as soon as the mushrooms on the east log disappears, even though your character doesn't appear to be in the center yet. If the fungus on the logs disappears, it indicates that your character has reached that point even if it isn't shown. Using this, you will increase your fungus output by a decent amount.
travel: For people that haven't completed Deadliest Catch: first, use the fairy ring network to teleport to BKR. Run west until you see three rotting logs, as shown in the image above. Drink a dose of prayer renewal, stand in the middle of the 3 rotting logs and cast bloom. Mort myre fungi will not spawn every time. Always pick the northern log last because when picked, you will return to the middle, removing the need to click back. After a full inventory, teleport to the TzHaar Fight Cave with the TokKul-Zo to bank and repeat using the fairy ring just north. Alternatively, if you haven't got a TokKul-Zo, use the fairy ring to bank in Zanaris, although this is slightly slower.

Alternatively, players who complete the easy Ardougne achievements (Requires: Biohazard, Gertrude's Cat, Monk's Friend, Plague City, Tower of Life; 15 Fishing, 16 Thieving, 10 Construction), can use the Kandarin monastery Teleport after collecting fungi (but before banking with the TokKul-Zo ) to recharge their prayer point for free. The Kandarin monastery Teleport is a one click teleport spell that isn't interrupted by attacking ghasts unlike the TokKul-Zo. Return with a fairy ring as mentioned above.

guides.page: Money making guide/Collecting swamp tar from the Lady Zay
instructions: The Lady Zay has many barrels of swamp tar on its decks, which can be looted for substantial profit. Start out by using the Lunar Isle lodestone, and run to the docks and board the Lady Zay. Go down the stairs in the southern end of the ship, and you'll see four barrels of swamp tar. Go to one of them and start clicking on it until it's empty. Do the same for the other three barrels -- the amount of tar varies between 1 and at least 15, but it'll average about three per barrel. Head back to the first barrel you looted, waiting for the tar to spawn again, and start the cycle over again. It takes about 22 seconds for the tar to respawn and is not dependent on the population of the world.
The tar of course stacks, so you'll never have to bank. When you're finished, go to the Grand Exchange and sell the swamp tar, which shouldn't be too difficult as it's a high-volume item.

instructions: Swamp toads can be picked up at the swamp northwest of the Grand Tree in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. There are 18 spawns, and it takes approximately 45 seconds for one to respawn on a high-populated world. Because of this, you will have to wait a few seconds after picking up all the toads before you can go through and pick them up again. After you have a full inventory, run east into the Grand Tree and southeast to the central tree with a ladder. There are two banks on the western part of the floor 1 above ground.
The legs can be quickly pulled off on the run from the swamp to the bank. This usually lowers the value, so be sure to check the prices of both.

instructions: Non-stop cutting would result in 1,200 actions per hour as shafts take five ticks to make.
Its highly recommened to only cut the Scruffy zygomites while using crystal knife since it gives a 5% chance to double shafts while fletching and does not degrade when carestyling.
The best Scruffy zygomite to cut is the one closest to the waiting line due to having the shortest animation.
Drying the Scruffy zygomites for experience in Firemaking is not considered as the crystal knife can't be used to boost the output but if you don't have a Crystal knife feel free to do this.
White berries spawn in an isolated area in Isafdar, north of the Tirannwn lodestone and just west of some light animica rocks. They respawn very quickly (about 4-5 seconds) after being picked up.

To get to the white berries area, use the Tirannwn lodestone, and click the red dot to the north on the minimap (your character will need to walk northwest then east to get around the trees). Consult the map above if you're unsure how to get there. It should take about 15 seconds to get to the berries from the lodestone. It's possible you'll take damage from the tripwires on the way, but the damage is generally insignificant and you'll be fully healed by the bank.

Once there, just stand over the white berry spawn, clicking it whenever they spawn. After you've collected 28 of them, use the TokKul-Zo to bank, and repeat. Once you've got enough berries, sell them on the Grand Exchange.
It's also possible to use a Beast of Burden to increase the berries per trip.
As all you need to do is click once every few seconds, you can do other activities like High Level Alchemy or Disassemble on noted items while you wait.

instructions: Utilising area loot and movement abilities, white berries may be collected at a faster volume than those found in Isafdar due to two berries spawning on Red Dragon Isle, though this may require more unlocks and attention.

The Wilderness sword 1, which requires the Easy Wilderness achievements, is used to teleport to the Wilderness herb patch. You should utilise Dive and Surge to travel southeast to the agility shortcut on the southern end of Red Dragon Isle. Two hellhounds spawn near the agility shortcut, meaning you can utilise the Barge ability to path towards them if you are lacking in movement ability unlocks or if said abilities are on cooldown. The red dragons on the isle are not aggressive.

It is highly recommended to assign a keybind to the area loot interface through the controls tab in your settings. By doing this, it is possible to spam the keybind in order to remove the slight delay it will take for the white berries to show in the area loot interface once they spawn, allowing for quicker trips.

It is also highly suggested to stand one tile south of the southern white berries spawn, as this will prevent the nearby burnt bones from appearing in your area loot interface and ensure both spawns of berries will.
travel: The Wilderness sword 1, which requires the Easy Wilderness achievements, is used to teleport to the Wilderness herb patch. You should utilise Dive and Surge to travel southeast to the agility shortcut on the southern end of Red Dragon Isle. Two hellhounds spawn near the agility shortcut, meaning you can utilise the Barge ability to path towards them if you are lacking in movement ability unlocks or if said abilities are on cooldown. The red dragons on the isle are not aggressive.
Once your inventory and familiar are full, teleport to War's Retreat or use the Wilderness sword to teleport to Edgeville. Deposit your berries and return to the Wilderness herb patch once more.

guides.page: Money making guide/Completing the Asuran Arsenal
instructions: Complete the Asuran Arsenal. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.

Complete the Asuran Arsenal while obtaining 500 loot giving 20 common loot and a 1/43.6 chance at a rare item each run. This assumes that tier 4 luck is used to maximise chances of obtaining the Nodon spike harness and Varanus's Mercy. This chance is boosted by a further 1% during Osseous roar.

With level 114 thieving, you can unlock all of the safes within the arsenal and achieve 500 loot by only unlocking the chests and safes downstairs, granted that you do not receive any damage from traps or get caught by The Keeper.

guides.page: Money making guide/Completing the Fight Kiln
instructions: Complete the Fight Kiln. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.

Completing the Fight Kiln gives the player a choice of one of two rewards: the TokHaar-Kal or an uncut onyx. Completing this minigame is the fastest way to earn an uncut onyx and the only guaranteed method.
The other 3 crystals are restoration, invulnerability, and constitution. These crystals can prove very useful in a pinch. The invulnerability crystals prove to be especially useful on wave 36.

guides.page: Money making guide/Completing the Vault of Hereditas
instructions: Complete the Vault of Hereditas. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.

Complete the Vault of Hereditas while obtaining 500 loot giving 20 common loot and a 1/34.92 chance at a rare item each run. This assumes that tier 4 luck is used to maximise chances of obtaining the Gloomfire bow, Legatus's Emberstaff, and Misalionar's death mask.

You may skip the final room, though this does not guarantee you 500 loot, usually ending anywhere from 480 to 500. 480 loot does reduce the chance of a rare to 1/37.4, though skipping the last room does save a notable amount of time, earning around 7 runs per hour if you can achieve a heist time of around 8:30.

guides.page: Money making guide/Completing the Zamorakian collection
instructions: Complete the Zamorakian I collection. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.

Completing the Zamorakian I collection has a high output of chronotes. This assumes that you complete a collection in an hour (could take more or less time depending on stats/gear). Profit assumes buying the remaining materials, estimated at half of the total cost of materials (more than half for some of the more rare mats to obtain while collecting artefacts, and less than half for some of the more common). Profit will be higher or lower depending on level/gear/materials obtained per artefact.
After turning in your first set of artefacts to Isaura, all subsequent sets should be turned in to the museum for maximum chronotes.

Using the War's Retreat Teleport to bank, then teleporting to Lunar Island with Moonclan Teleport is the optimal way to craft astral runes. Players can do approximately 100 runs per hour via this method by using surge and dive during runs. Without teleporting, the number of runs per hour drops significantly, to approximately 60.

With the infinity ethereal outfit, an abyssal titan summoned, small through massive pouches and a powerburst of sorcery, players can hold up to 102 essence per trip. Players should put the runes needed for Moonclan Teleport in a large rune pouch to save inventory space.

Create a preset with all the required items for your trips. Pouches can be filled by loading the preset. After filling your pouches and ethereal set, run outside the Lunar Isle wall, south then east past the suqahs. Once at the astral altar, craft your runes and then teleport to War's Retreat. Fill your pouches again, then cast Moonclan Teleport and begin anew.

If you do not have an War's Retreat Teleport, you could cast Moonclan Teleport and use the Lunar Isle bank; however this is slightly slower. The lodestone teleport is also an option, however this is not recommended due to the large delay when casting it.

instructions: Battlestaves and their respective orbs have a buy limit of 5,000 per 4 hours; it is recommended to leave an offer in over time to gather them, or to buy them in bulk from other players.

It's recommended to use a bank preset for this method to reduce banking time, as inventories only take around 15 seconds to complete. 2,500 battlestaves can be made per hour; this can be higher or lower depending on banking time. instructions: Using the TokKul-Zo and fairy rings, you can make about 50 trips to the cosmic altar per hour. With 59 Runecrafting (giving double cosmic runes) and especially 75 Runecrafting (giving access to the giant pouch), this can be highly profitable.

Start out at the TzHaar Fight Cave bank in TzHaar City. Unload pure essence and store it in your pouches, then take out essence for your inventory. Run north and use the fairy ring to teleport to Zanaris. From there, run south to the agility shortcut -- if you have 66 Agility, go through both of them, although you may get stuck and take a small amount of damage before passing through. Run further south and enter the mysterious ruins, and then go directly to the altar. Craft your essence in your inventory and pouches, and then teleport back to the Fight Cave with your TokKul-Zo. If you are unwilling or unable to complete The Elder Kiln to gain the TokKul-Zo, it is possible to use the Wilderness Sword, starting at the Edgeville Bank and running across the river to the fairy ring there. This method is likely to be a little less efficient.
With this method you can craft about 2700 essence per hour, but without the giant pouch that will drop to about 2150.

After buying the required soft clay, use a portable crafter to craft any type of unfired decorated urns with a brooch of the gods equipped. After all the unfired urns are created, you can now begin firing them using the Fire urn spell from the Lunar spellbook. An Elemental battlestaff can cover the cost of the elemental runes, which only leaves the astral runes that need to be procured. For both steps (crafting and firing), bank presets are highly recommended. Once the portable crafter has been used once, any further crafting in the area will gain the bonus without needing to click the portable again.

If you don't have access to portable crafters, you can also try this method using the pottery wheels in the Ithell district of Prifddinas or the Crafting Guild. instructions: The first process of this method requires combining gold bars and emeralds in a furnace. The Lumbridge furnace is one of the fastest ones to use. You should make a preset with 28 emeralds for faster efficiency. Withdraw your preset from the bank, run over to the furnace, start crafting the emerald amulets and then repeat.
It should take you around 64 seconds per run and 28 amulets will be made.
When done you should make another preset with 14 unstrung emerald amulets and 14 ball of wool. It should take you 10 seconds per inventory including banking time.
You should be on a world with low ping for better efficiency.

instructions: The first process of this method requires combining gold bars and emeralds in a furnace to make unstrung emerald amulets. The Lumbridge furnace is one of the fastest ones to use. You should make a preset with 28 emeralds for faster efficiency. Withdraw your preset from the bank, run over to the furnace, start crafting the emerald amulets and then repeat.
It should take you around 64 seconds per run and 28 amulets will be made.

Upon completion of all of these unstrung amulets, proceed to string all of them using balls of wool. The stringing should not take nearly as long as either of the two other processes. The player should make a preset with 14 unstrung emerald amulets and 14 ball of wool. It should take around 10 seconds per inventory.

The final step in this method is to enchant the amulets by using the Lvl-2 Enchant spell in your standard spellbook. It's recommended to move this spell to your action bar for better efficiency. Wielding a staff of air will remove the need for any air runes and save you a lot of money in the long run. The player should make a preset with 27 cosmic runes and 27 emerald amulets. This action takes around 34 seconds.

instructions: At average speed, one can do about 94 trips to the nature altar via the Abyss per hour, using the Wilderness sword or Amulet of Glory to teleport back to Edgeville. Up to 150 trips per hour is achievable using expansive pouch, the Infinity etheral outfit, and the Abyssal Titan, while taking advantage of perks such as Mobile, Double Surge, and the Nexus Mod relic.
With optimised dives and surges, one can expect around 120–150 trips an hour, while without using any mobility abilities, one can expect 94–112 trips an hour.

The Pouch Protector relic can be used if the expansive pouch is not owned. Alternatively, the combined catalyst fragment and infinity ethereal outfit together also prevent pouches from degrading completely.

If you don't have 100% pouch degradation reduction, make sure to regularly repair the pouches as the giant pouch degrades after 12 uses. You can repair your pouches for free at the Dark mage in the centre of the Abyss. Alternatively you can cast Repair rune pouch on your pouches, making them last five times as long. guides.page: Money making guide/Crafting nature runes with spirit graahk
instructions: The spirit graahk's teleport function will take you to a hunter area west of the Nature Altar. Using that along with the TokKul-Zo allows round trips of crafting nature runes to take about 40 seconds, totalling around 90 trips per hour. To start, fill your pouches with pure essence, then fill the remaining open inventory slots with pure essence via a quick preset "2" that contains filled pouches and a filled inventory of pure essence. Quickly interact with your familiar by placing the Familiar Options that has left click options set to interact in the action bar and key binding to 2. Then teleport with the graahk by hitting 2 twice. Then run east until you reach the Nature Altar, go inside, and craft the runes, essence inside pouches would also be used automatically. Teleport to The Fight Kiln by placing the TokKul-Zo ring in the action bar and key binding it to 4, pressing 4 twice, and then you can bank. After initial setup of the action bar you simply fill your pouches, spam 2 until you teleport to the hunter area with your Spirit graahk, run to the altar, craft the runes, spam 4 until you return to the bank, and repeat.

instructions: Ruby rings are made by combining a gold bar and a cut ruby. It is highly recommended you make a bank preset with 28 rubies.

Smith all of the bars using your 28 ore (60 if you wearing smelting gauntlets), then use the rubies preset to craft the rings. Wearing Varrock armour 2 gives a chance to smelt 2 bars at once; the medium New Varrock achievements also have to be completed for this to apply at a portable forge or Lumbridge furnace.

The process is fairly click intensive, and very tedious. The crafting can be done at the Lumbridge furnace, across the street from the Lumbridge Market bank chest. It takes 9 seconds to travel between the bank and furnace.

instructions: The empty capacitors will need to be charged via combat or skilling before becoming tradeable. It assumes that you manufacture and charge one capacitor per hour.

Divine charges are used to train Invention, and they are always in high demand. Divine charges must be used to refill one's charge pack to continue training Invention, and because of this, creating divine charges can be quite profitable.

Disassembling items into simple parts is a mostly-AFK activity, making this method great for when you do not want to pay much attention to the game while still turning a profit. Maple logs disassemble into simple parts at a rate of 49%. This method will be more effective with higher junk chance reduction levels, unlocked by training the Invention skill. An auto disassembler or auto disassembler mk. II can be used to increase the flow of simple parts.

Keep in mind that the buy limit on each divine energy type is 25,000. This means that, without help from friends or alternate accounts, using different energy types, or buying them while doing other activities, you may only use this method once per four hours. It is recommended that you check the current GE prices for energy if you would like to use another energy type, as it may be more profitable or allow more charges to be made per four hours.
Gold bars, harralander tar, and acadia logs can be acceptable substitutes for maple logs as they provide simple parts at a 66%, 76%, and 95% rate, respectively.
travel: No fixed destination is specified for this method. Choose a convenient place for the activity.

guides.page: Money making guide/Creating empty divine charges
instructions: This method synergises well with the use of Auto disassembler mk. II to create padded parts.
See divine charge for a detailed breakdown of obtaining simple parts for charges.
They are crafted in batches of 50, a maximum of 20 crafts an hour will be possible.

guides.page: Money making guide/Creating small classic and large historic crates
instructions: Using the bare minimum: Elder rune mattock and precision upgrade No. 2, while being AFK (99% activity time). Depending on your equipment and upgrades, can increase the artefacts per hour.
Buy 1,120 of each material from the GE. Use the Restore calc to determine how much you need depending on how many artefacts you gain per hour.
Disassemble the green dragonhide bodies (with Invention master cape worn or on the skillcape stand) by yourself, or put them in an Auto disassembler mk. II for idle components (larger quantities).
Excavate Venator remains to obtain artefacts.
Once you have obtained at least 80 in total, go to the workbench and restore them.
travel: Use a convenient bank to withdraw the listed supplies and deposit the results.

instructions: Spirit mementos are needed for greater communion rituals in Necromancy. The main limiting factor of this money making method is the buy limit of 1,000 fragile mementos every 4 hours.
The player should make a bank preset of 90 vibrant energy and 27 fragile mementos. A full inventory can be converted in approximately 20 seconds.
travel: Use a convenient bank to withdraw the listed supplies and deposit the results.

guides.page: Money making guide/Crushing desert goat horns
instructions: Goat horn dust is an ingredient in the Combat potion and is the tertiary ingredient in infusing Smoke devil pouches. It is often profitable to crush the horns and sell them on the Grand Exchange. Like all methods involving large amounts of buying and selling, it is recommended to test the market first to make sure crushing the horns is profitable. Note that the Desert goat horn will often buy at under market price and the dust will occasionally sell at over market, so actual profits may be higher.

28 horns can be crushed per inventory, and each inventory can take from 16.8 to 20 seconds. Desert goat horns are crushed at 0.6 seconds per horn, so a maximum of around 5,000 horn can be ground per hour. Your rates may vary.
Please note that Desert goat horns have a buying limit of 10,000 every four hours.
travel: Use a convenient bank to withdraw the listed supplies and deposit the results.

guides.page: Money making guide/Cultivating hydrangea bushes at Het's Oasis
instructions: Using ultracompost will speed up harvesting which will allow up to 20 harvests an hour. There is a moneymaking guide on how do this here.

The drop rate for golden roses is 1/7 per harvest (tested with 100 harvests). Using these rates, and assuming the median of 2 golden roses per cultivation, 5 golden roses is an accurate estimate of profits.
Four acadia trees are located in the VIP skilling area. The logs may then be deposited into the bank chest located nearby only when a full inventory of logs has been collected.

Optionally, the players could use signs of the porter to deposit the logs, making this a little more AFK, but cutting into the profits. Considering the close proximity of the bank chest, this is discouraged.
travel: Four acadia trees are located in the VIP skilling area. The logs may then be deposited into the bank chest located nearby only when a full inventory of logs has been collected.

instructions: Equip a usable hatchet and cut the acadia trees west of Het's Oasis. Bank the logs when you need more backpack space, then return to the trees.
Using Elder wood spirits for extra profit.

Elder trees take 5 minutes to cut down and 10 minutes to regrow, which means that the player has to select 3 elder tree locations and move between them. It is advised to bring equipment such as amulets to teleport to a bank, to store all logs held when moving to the next tree. Around 14 - 20 logs will be acquired on average per tree (per 5 minutes). Using an elder wood box will remove the need to bank.
There is a method that does not require any amulets to teleport.
Start at the elder tree in Yanille.
Cut the elder tree in Varrock.
guides.location: Rotate between elder trees in Yanille, Varrock and Edgeville, or Varrock and the two Draynor-area trees.
travel: The guide suggests starting at the Yanille elder tree, then cutting at Varrock, then teleporting to Edgeville to cut and bank. Repeat that rotation.
Another source route uses Varrock and the elder trees north and south of Draynor Village, banking at Draynor. Tree depletion and regrowth times determine when you move.

guides.page: Money making guide/Cutting eternal magic logs
instructions: Eternal magic logs can be cut from the eternal magic trees which are located in Piscatoris Hunter area. When cutting trees occasionally a ray of light and falling leaves will appear on one side of the tree. Moving to this side will give a 30-second Lumberjack's Intuition buff, giving an increased chance to perform a Perfect Cut which guarantees that logs will be obtained. The buff also increases the chance to obtain bird's nests and a chance to obtain enchanted bird's nests, which may contain valuable rewards. The buff is enhanced with at least level 104 Woodcutting. The experience gained from woodcutting scales with the player's Woodcutting level. The trees last for five minutes before they are cut down, making this a low intensity money maker.
The perfect juju woodcutting potion grants a 5% boost to logs gained and 1 dose is used per hour.
The Perfect plus potion grants the same buffs as the perfect juju woodcutting potion but lasts for 4 hours instead.

instructions: Granite is the tertiary ingredient for granite lobster familiars, and while any size granite can be used for this, the 500 gram pieces are the cheapest and most in demand. Buy some Granite (2kg) on the Grand Exchange (they are sometimes difficult to purchase), and withdraw seven of them at a time. Craft the granite into 500 gram pieces, bank, and repeat. Each load takes about 12 seconds, so cutting around 2,000 pieces of granite per hour can be expected. Using a bank preset can speed up the process drastically and is recommended.

An uncut jade can be cut with a chisel by a player with level 13 Crafting, and grants the player 20 Crafting experience. However, there is a chance that the player will accidentally crush it to form a crushed gem, which gives only 5 Crafting experience. This chance decreases with a higher Crafting level, and stops completely at level 50.
The Grand Exchange buy limit is 5,000, so if a player plans on doing the activity for multiple hours continuously they will need to buy more in advance.
travel: No fixed destination is specified for this method. Choose a convenient place for the activity.

instructions: Many trees may be found to the west of the Port Sarim docks, near the lodestone. Cutting the logs and banking them at the deposit box next to the monk of Entrana can be a fairly profitable way to make money with low skills.

Teleport to Port Sarim lodestone and start chopping all of the regular trees in the area. When your inventory is full, run north-east onto the docks and bank the logs. This should take about three minutes per load of 28 logs with a decent Woodcutting level, so you may be able to cut more than 500 logs per hour. When finished, sell the logs on the Grand Exchange. Any seer's headband will double logs received from cutting a tree, and double your profit.

Guam incense sticks, which give the player a 10-40% chance of cutting an extra log depending on the incense stick's potency, are recommended. Cadantine incense sticks, which have a base 2.5% chance of not exhausting a tree, could be a useful secondary incense effect.

The evil tree buff temporarily removes the need to bank logs and makes trees last longer, although it may be better spent on higher level trees such as mahogany or acadia, which would provide much better experience with a medium decrease in profit.

instructions: One mahogany tree is located on the southwestern part of Ape Atoll next to the beach. Collect mahogany logs here, and run east to the bank deposit chest to bank the logs. The tree spawns unusually quickly, so it is worth waiting for it to respawn and gathering a full inventory rather than running all the way to the deposit chest after the tree falls.

Jungle spiders, poisonous jungle snakes and poisonous scorpions found throughout the jungle. Wearing a monkey greegree will keep the monsters from attacking, but it also takes up an inventory space for your hatchet unless the hatchet is stored on the tool belt. These monsters can be completely avoided if you run along the southern edge of the island in a direct line from the mahogany tree to the deposit chest.

There is approximately a 2.5% chance that you will cut a Special mahogany log. You can use two of these to convert an inventory of mahogany logs into mahogany planks, saving 19,500 coins per special log. On average you will get about ten of these per hour, which means you can convert 130 logs for free by talking to the sawmill operator. It takes about 40 seconds to turn a batch of logs into planks, which can be done at any time after amassing enough special mahogany logs.

A completed nature's sentinel outfit boosts woodcutting speed by 7% and also offers 20 daily teleports to tree locations.

instructions: Several oaks are located east of Draynor bank. Logs should optimally be cut from the closest two, and only go further if both are felled. The logs may then be deposited into the bank deposit box once a full inventory of logs has been collected. A full load of 28 takes approximately 90 seconds with a decent Woodcutting level, so about 1000 logs may easily be cut per hour. Oak wood box or higher can store more logs to reduce banking needed.

Another great spot to cut oak logs is directly south of the Draynor lodestone! In the southwest corner of the nearby crossroads, 4 oak trees are located in close proximity to one another. It is very easy to rotate from one tree to another while stumps regenerate without needing to move more than a couple of steps at a time. The player should bank at War's Retreat (combat level 60 required) optionally using the associated Teleport (not crucial as it is already quite close), deposit their logs, and exit via the portal to Draynor. After exiting, click on the intersecting paths of the crossroads, and Surge as you round the corner and face south in order to quickly return to the four trees and resume cutting.

guides.page: Money making guide/Cutting willow and oak logs
instructions: Cutting willow and oak logs in Varrock by using the wood box.
An experiment, on a F2P ironman character.

It took 25 minutes, using a rune hatchet, including teleporting to and fro from Burthorpe to Varrock lodestone, to fill the wood box (being able to hold 160 logs at 70 woodcutting) and inventory on each 3 tries. 9 Woodcutting Urns were also used.
fill wood box, willow logs: 14 minutes.
fill wood box, oak logs: 10 minutes.

instructions: Five willows are located southwest of Draynor bank. A full load of 28 takes approximately 120 seconds at 90+ Woodcutting.

Willow logs are in high demand due to being raw materials for spirit weed incense sticks. While that is members-only, free players can make willow incense sticks. This requires 30 Firemaking and gives 36 Firemaking xp per stick (which consumes 2 logs each). Since sticks are stackable, this negates the need for banking, helpful if using any spot other than Draynor.
travel: Five willows are located southwest of Draynor bank. A full load of 28 takes approximately 120 seconds at 90+ Woodcutting.

instructions: It also assumes that you hit the maximum contribution threshold to receive 12 lootpiles. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed, drops and failures.
More information on defeating Croesus, please refer to the strategy guide for Croesus.

It also assumes that you hit the maximum contribution threshold to receive 12 lootpiles. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed, drops and failures. Duo is more profitable than 4-person because players are able to get 12 kills per hour with the maximum contribution, instead of 9. The reasoning behind this method is you are able to hit 420 contribution in less time, negating the need to wait for 2nd mid fungus.
The Hunter & Woodcutter will always start the fight and starts at Hunt. Miner & Fisher starts at Mining. The Hunter should always have Extreme Hunter potion active whilst gathering.

Your optimal goal is to deplete both your nodes before going to the energy fungus; however, this won't always be possible due to luck. This is per player decision making. Go to the energy fungus when you feel like you should. It's not necessary to do the whole energy fungus - around 15% of it is sufficient.
Gather at Mining / Hunter until depleted and you have 15 materials, rot any excess and keep it with you.
Go 1 quadrant anticlockwise and deposit the 15 materials into the statue.
Ascendri bolts (e) have a relatively high High Alchemy price and a high trade volume, so many players put them in the Alchemiser mk. II for passive profit.

The Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Ascendri) spell enchants 10 bolts at a time, using one cosmic rune, one death rune and 20 fire runes. Use a staff of fire for free fire runes. Click the Enchant Crossbow Bolt magic spell, which opens a menu to enchant bolts. 60 sets of 10 bolts can be made using the menu, taking approximately 142 seconds. This gives a theoretical upper limit of 15,000 enchanted Ascendri bolts per hour. As all inputs and outputs are stackable, there is no requirement to bank and this technique can be done anywhere.

If you prefer a more active method, it is possible using Tick manipulation to quadruple your profit and magic XP, by clicking on the Enchant Crossbow Bolt spell each Game tick, and confirming each click with your space bar. This method is high-intensity and is only maintanable over short periods of time, however it can be useful for clearing through your GE limit of bolts to fill Alchemiser mk. II.
The bolt market is fairly volatile, so test the profit of one set of bolts before you buy the runes and bolts in bulk.
travel: Use a convenient bank to withdraw the listed supplies and deposit the results.

instructions: It takes roughly just under 7 minutes (6.8) to make 1,000 enchanted bolts and this guide assumes it takes 7 minutes to allow leeway.
The issue with this money making method is that the Bakriminel bolts GE buy limit is only 1,000 so you'll need to buy from other players or slow buy over days.
Players can use a Portable fletcher when tipping the bolts to save roughly 10% (20% with Brooch of the Gods) of the Bakriminel bolts.

Its recommended to do a small test to see its profitability before investing into a single bolt due to some bolts having a low demand since they are not used much in PvM; Diamond, Onyx and Hydrix are typically the most used.
Check the calculator below to see the most profitable Bakriminel bolts to make.

travel: Use a convenient bank to withdraw the listed supplies and deposit the results.

instructions: Castra debris are found south of the entrance in Kharid-et Dig Site. Just next to the prison door.
Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your drop rates, and intensity.

The main difference between Excavating Venator remains and this method is utilising the Kharid-et Dig Site's close proximity to materials cart for depositing the materials and filling the archaeological soil box with ancient gravel. Making the player spend less time travelling to the bank, which is located outside the dig site entrance, and more time gathering.
travel: The main difference between Excavating Venator remains and this method is utilising the Kharid-et Dig Site's close proximity to materials cart for depositing the materials and filling the archaeological soil box with ancient gravel. Making the player spend less time travelling to the bank, which is located outside the dig site entrance, and more time gathering.

instructions: Excavate Tsutsaroth remains and destroy artefacts while selling all material gained. Only need to click about once every 7 minutes if you have the 10 minutes auto logout so that it starts a new artefact. Profit could be increased using anything that makes you use fewer signs of the porter, an XP capacitor, or a waterfiend familiar if desired. Did not calculate for charge usage, but it is fairly low for this method. You will want honed 6 on your mattock to get 1000+ materials per hour at 120 arch. If you click the next artefact quickly you can get more than 1000 materials per hour - this is a conservative estimate. 116 Archaeology required, but 120 will yield more material as will using Ring of Whispers to boost Arch level. On the recommended items list, each item missing will mean fewer materials per hour. Guide is calculated based on having all those items except for the waterfiend.
guides.location: Tsutsaroth remains, Infernal Source Dig Site

instructions: Venator remains are found just east of Al Kharid. This assumes level 20 Archaeology and following time sprites.
This is similar to excavating Third Age iron, which is usually more profitable, but venator remains cannot be depleted and there is no competition between players.
Screening ancient gravel can be very profitable, but is less so in free-to-play due to various limitations.

Excavate Xolo remains and destroy artefacts while selling all material gained. You only need to click about once every 7.5 minutes if you have the 10 minutes auto logout so that it starts a new artefact. Profit could be increased using anything that makes you use less signs of the porter, an XP Capacitor 5000, or a waterfiend familiar if desired. Did not calculate for charge usage, but it is fairly low for this method and is also partially offset if you use the perk Imp Souled. You will want Honed 6 on your mattock to get 1100+ materials per hour at 120 arch. If you click the next artefact quickly, you can acquire more than 1100 materials per hour. This is a conservative estimate. 116 Archaeology required, but 120 will yield more material as will using Ring of Whispers to boost Archaeology level. On the recommended items list each item missing will mean less materials per hour. Guide is calculated based on having all those items except for the waterfiend.
travel: Use a convenient bank to withdraw the listed supplies and deposit the results.

guides.page: Money making guide/Excavating material cache (Blood of Orcus)
instructions: Travel to and excavate the material cache (Blood of Orcus) located on the floor 2 above ground of the Slayer Tower in Canifis. The Canifis lodestone is located nearby. There are 3 material caches that you can excavate from: you can also hop worlds if you deplete all the caches before they respawn.

Profits will be affected by the level of mattock used. To increase profit further players can use a mattock with perks such as Honed and Fortune. Using perks such as Imp Souled or Refined may reduce the usage of porter charges and the need to world hop. If owned the master archaeologist's outfit grants a 7% increased excavation rate; a ring of Whispers can invisibly boost Archaeology by 3 levels to increase excavation rate and the waterfiend familiar has the effect of doubling resources 5% of the time when gathering.
guides.location: Kharid-Et Dig Site- Chapel Excavation Site
travel: Travel to and excavate the material cache (Blood of Orcus) located on the floor 2 above ground of the Slayer Tower in Canifis. The Canifis lodestone is located nearby. There are 3 material caches that you can excavate from: you can also hop worlds if you deplete all the caches before they respawn.

guides.page: Money making guide/Excavating material cache (Stormguard steel)
instructions: Excavation rates are based on near minimum level and non-augmented dragon mattock. Upgrades may significantly increase profit.

Stormguard steel can be excavated from material cache (Stormguard steel). There is a materials cart close by in the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site. Assuming you have unlocked 250 capacity for the archaeological soil box, it takes about 100 minutes for a full trip. World hopping is necessary as the caches deplete faster than they respawn (2 minutes).

guides.page: Money making guide/Excavating material cache (Third Age iron)
instructions: Third Age iron can be excavated from material cache (Third Age iron), with 3 caches north-east of the Archaeology Campus. With a bank a short distance to the west, each trip of 28 materials takes around 6 minutes on an empty world. Each cache usually gives multiples of the material before depleting, and it is shared among players.

guides.page: Money making guide/Excavating material cache (cadmium red)
instructions: Excavate the material cache (cadmium red) in the Star Lodge cellar at the Infernal Source Dig Site until it is depleted, hopping worlds each time it does so until the backpack is full. Bank it in the bank chest above the dig site and repeat.
It is highly recommended to use a soil box so as to increase the amount of cadmium red that can be excavated in a single inventory.
To increase the profit further, there are a number of additional items that are suggested.
An augmented mattock with perks such as Honed & Fortune. Using perks such as Imp Souled or Refined may reduce either the need to repeatedly bank or world hop.
Ring of Whispers can invisibly boost gathering rates by 3%.
guides.location: Star Lodge cellar, Infernal Source Dig Site

guides.page: Money making guide/Excavating material cache (cobalt blue)
instructions: Excavate material cache (cobalt blue) at the Everlight Dig Site until it is depleted, hopping worlds each time it does so until the backpack is full. Deposit materials at the materials cart near the cache and repeat.
It is highly recommended to use a soil box so as to increase the amount of cobalt blue that can be excavated in a single inventory.
To increase the profit further, there are a number of additional items that are suggested.
An augmented mattock with perks such as Honed & Fortune. Using perks such as Imp Souled or Refined may reduce either the need to repeatedly bank or world hop.
Ring of Whispers can invisibly boost gathering rates by 3%.

guides.page: Money making guide/Exchanging agility arena tickets for pirate hook
instructions: Refer to Brimhaven Agility Arena on methods to get there and the different types of methods you will face.
A Pirate hook costs 800 tickets, this is the only method that can obtain this item.
Note that the pirate hook has a very low trade volume and may take a while to sell.
Farming arbuck can be a very profitable way to spend a few minutes at a time.
Magic secateurs from A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains, which boosts crop yield by 10%.
Juju farming potion from Herblore Habitat, which gives a 33% chance of picking double herbs, effectively increasing crop yield by 33%.

instructions: As a tertiary ingredient used in the Summoning skill, marigolds are always in demand. And with Farming being almost the only source of marigolds, the demand is not always met. Farming marigolds can thus be somewhat profitable for low-level players, as it requires only level 2 Farming and is even available to non-members.

Members have access to four farming patches in which marigolds can be farmed - one near Falador, one near Port Phasmatys, one in Catherby and one at the Manor Farm. Only the one near Falador is available to free players, so if you're not a member you'll make roughly one quarter of the profits listed here. Apart from membership, none of these patches have any requirements to access, but the one by Port Phasmatys can be time-consuming to get to without the ectophial or a modified farmer's hat (the latter of which can only be used three times a day) - the easiest way to get there without either of those is teleporting to the Canifis lodestone, though skipping the patch might be a better option. The Falador patch also takes a little bit of time to reach without the Explorer's ring 3 or the South Falador Teleport spell, although the Draynor Village lodestone is reasonably close by. The Manor Farm and Catherby patches are easy to reach with the lodestone Network, and should always be used.
