When you expect the marigolds to be fully grown (roughly 20 minutes after planting), head to each of the patches you used and pick the marigolds. If they died, clear the patch instead. If they are alive but diseased, the nearby farmers sell plant cure for 25 coins if you talk to them - you won't get any marigolds this time around, but it saves you a seed. Once you have picked the flowers or cleared the patch, plant another marigold seed. You may want to add compost or supercompost before planting the seed. Then head to the next patch if there are any left, or a bank or the Grand Exchange when you're finished with all the patches.

instructions: There are three mushroom patches. Start at the mushroom patch west of Canifis. The simplest way to get to the patch is by using the fairy ring CKS, which teleports you steps from the patch. Once you're there, harvest the mushrooms and plant new ones. Next teleport to the Isafdar patch directly with the Tirannwn quiver 3 or use the Tirannwn lodestone and go west through the dense forest then run south to the Isafdar mushroom patch. Harvest and replant the mushrooms. Finally, if you have 80 Necromancy, teleport to the City of Um using the Underworld Grimoire (Um smithy) and go west to the mushroom patch. Harvest, and replant the mushrooms there. Alternatively, if the Passing bracelet is obtained, players can rub the bracelet and choose the first option (City of Um: Hanging Gardens) The patches have a growing time of 240 minutes - reduced to 200 if the spores are planted with a Sunburst bracelet equipped.

The Morytania achievements help immensely for growing morchella mushrooms -- after completing the Medium achievements, the Morytania patch will be immune from disease, so no supercompost is necessary. However, it is advised to use supercompost on the Isafdar patch as this may become diseased. Also, the Pharm Ecology relic power protects the mushroom patches, laying off the need for supercompost.

guides.page: Money making guide/Finding mjolnirs by enchanted key
instructions: The number of runs per hour may be higher or lower depending on the teleports available to you, whether you have (Bladed) Dive/Mobile, how much attention you pay to the game, and whether you are using The Light Within trick.

Mjolnirs can be hunted for again after completion of the enchanted key lore activity. To be eligible, the player must not own any mjolnirs or the enchanted key. There are two ways that can be achieved: using the drop trick to trick Jorral into thinking we aren't in possession of any mjolnirs, or by starting The Light Within and not completing the section that requires you to use the enchanted key because it allows you to obtain a key even if you already have a mjolnir. The order of mjolnirs is always the same (Guthix, Saradomin, then Zamorak).
(Guthix) Archaeology journal teleport, run south-west.
(Saradomin) Teleport to the Skills necklace north of Crafting Guild, go north-east.
(Zamorak) Teleport to Het's Oasis via a ring of duelling (1), go north-west.
travel: The number of runs per hour may be higher or lower depending on the teleports available to you, whether you have (Bladed) Dive/Mobile, how much attention you pay to the game, and whether you are using The Light Within trick.
Use (Guthix) Archaeology journal teleport, run south-west.

instructions: Money making guide/Cutting elder logs is an example of a high-level Woodcutting money making method with higher profit, but less complexity and effort.

Bakriminel bolts are made at level 93 Fletching by combining two untradeable resources - bakriminel bolt tips which are sold by Mami Rimba in Edgeville, and bakriminel bolt shafts carved from the logs of rare bloodwood trees. Bloodwood trees can be cut every six hours with level 85 Woodcutting for a small number of logs. Once you have cut the logs, carve them into bolt shafts and attach bolt tips to them to make bakriminel bolts. If the logs or bolt shafts are taken further than a few steps from the tree before being made into bolts they will be destroyed! Thus you have to bring bakriminel bolt tips when cutting the trees, or you will receive nothing.

Three bloodwood trees are located in the Wilderness, and five outside. The five outside the Wilderness have relatively difficult quest requirements. The ones located inside the Wilderness do feature the additional risk of aggressive monsters.
Wilderness sword 4 to the Wilderness Agility Course.
Wilderness obelisks to level 44 Wilderness.

guides.page: Money making guide/Fletching elder headless arrows
instructions: Always make sure to check prices before you invest heavily into the method.
Cut the Elder logs into Elder arrow shafts, then combine them with Feathers to create Elder headless arrows.

Using a Fletching cape provides a 0.75% chance to make extra arrows. Using a Portable fletcher provides a 10% chance to save arrowheads and headless arrows when making arrows. A tier 2 Ranger's Workroom has a 1% chance to fletch an extra bundle of these arrow shafts and headless arrows. Crystal knife provides a 5% double these arrow shafts.

Due to the buy limit of Feathers being 100,000 (compared to the buy limit of Elder logs being 25,000), it is suggested to put in a large order of Feathers so they buy slowly while you cut the Elder logs into Elder arrow shafts. Be warned that prices can fluctuate over a long period of time, so profitability may increase or decrease depending on the costs.
travel: No fixed destination is specified for this method. Choose a convenient place for the activity.

instructions: Headless arrows are made by using feathers on arrow shafts, and they are used in Fletching to create arrows for quick experience gains. Because most fletchers will not create the headless arrows on their own, there is an opportunity for low-level players to make a fair amount of profit (and decent experience) by fletching headless arrows.

To start with, test the profit of making one headless arrow -- buy one feather and one arrow shaft from the Grand Exchange, make a headless arrow, and sell it. If the profit is less than 10, there may be better options to make money. If it is higher, buy up feathers and arrow shafts in bulk. It may be more profitable to purchase or even chop logs to make the shafts, however that would also require additional time.

To create headless arrows you need the arrow shafts and feathers in your inventory. Left click on the arrow shafts, then click "Fletch" (or space bar) to make 60 sets of 15 arrow shafts automatically, taking about 72 seconds. You can make 45,000 headless arrows an hour if you have enough materials. However, feathers and arrow shafts have a buying limit of 100,000 every four hours, so you can only buy about 130 minutes worth of headless arrow materials per four hours.
travel: To find the current location of a Portable fletcher, ask in the "portables" Friends chat.

instructions: The perk from the Fletching cape and the tier 2 and 3 of the Ranger's Workroom grant 0.75% and 1% chance to make an extra bundle of headless dinarrows with every action, respectively. However, a portable fletcher doesn't provide any benefit when making headless dinarrows.

Even though headless dinarrows don't use feathers, the "Headless Chicken" perk from having hens placed in a pen in the player-owned farm grants 3% to 5% chance to save half of the dinosaur 'propellant' used with each action. This can help save up to 1,200 dinosaur 'propellant' out of 45,000 normally used per hour, increasing hourly profit.
Due to the buy limit of the ingredients being lower than what you can produce in an hour, you may need to buy from other players or leave in GE offers overnight or longer.
travel: The perk from the Fletching cape and the tier 2 and 3 of the Ranger's Workroom grant 0.75% and 1% chance to make an extra bundle of headless dinarrows with every action, respectively. However, a portable fletcher doesn't provide any benefit when making headless dinarrows.

instructions: Buy immaculate alloy bars and fold them 1001 times. This takes 20 minutes per bar so 3 can be made in an hour.
guides.location: Any anvil; Artisans' Workshop is one option

guides.page: Money making guide/Gathering golden roses with Rapid Growth
instructions: Rapid Growth can be used once (twice with the full master farmer outfit) every day on all four flower patches in Het's Oasis, making them instantly harvestable. When you harvest flowers at Het's Oasis, you get a chance to harvest golden roses. Using compost on the plant before cultivating it increases this chance, with better compost giving a higher chance. These roses can be used to catch dazzling whirligigs, whose shells can be ground into powder of penance.

guides.page: Money making guide/Generating compost with a compost mound familiar
instructions: It's recommended to complete this method in Taverley, just north of the Player-owned house portal, where the Tool leprechaun stands right next to the compost bin. The tool leprechaun at this location will also never move from his position. Each use of the scroll requires 12 special move points, which regenerate back normally in slightly less than 22 seconds, allowing the player to use approximately 167 scrolls per hour without the use of any special move boosting effects. A compost mound familiar lasts 36 minutes without any extensions.

Buckets All the Way Down upgrade allows players to draw compost from the compost bin without requiring any buckets, and is therefore ultimately required for maximum profit and uptime. This can be bought at Sydekix's Shop of Balance for 10,000 Crux Eqal favour.

When the special move bar is regenerating, you should take compost from the bin and right-click 'Exchange' with the tool leprechaun to store all the compost with him, you may then right click the stored buckets to withdraw them in noted form at any point. The compost bin will hold a maximum of 1000 processed compost of each type, so it is not possible to do an entire hour without drawing any buckets from the bin.

guides.page: Money making guide/Grinding sandstone into extra fine sand
instructions: This method requires you to grind 10kg blocks of sandstone into extra fine sand. Including banking time, a full inventory should take about 36 seconds and yield an average of 28 extra fine sand.

Although the Crafting experience gained is minimal, it can be boosted by wearing the artisan's outfit and wise perk, and experience can be nearly doubled by using a magic carpet pet and Shadow-touched training set.

Extra fine sand is an item used in the creation of the Orthen furnace core and blessed sand, the latter of which is used during the creation of an artificer's measure or a blessed flask. Because of this, there is moderate demand for this item.
guides.location: Any location with a bank/bank chest nearby

instructions: Elder energy is usually in demand for those who want the extra Divination experience from converting memories with energy or to be used to create nightmare muspah and Nihil familiars. 75 Divination, and completion of Fate of the Gods is required to harvest elder energy. 81 Summoning for a Nightmare muspah familiar will also increase the amount of energy and sharply reduce trips to the rift for convertion, while the Divine Conversion power allows you to instantly convert an inventory of memories. Remember that in order for an enriched wisp to spawn, players must empower the rift with the elder chronicles that they collect, which grant their normal experience reward while doing so. Harvest the enriched wisp for a guaranteed supply of enriched memories. Enriched memories can be converted to twice the energy that normal memories can.

For maximum profit, convert all memories into energy (option one). Converting memories to energy produces energies at approximately 16,000 per hour with a Muspah. If better experience gain is desired, players can convert their memories into experience (option two) instead.
Without a Nightmare Muspah, energy per hour is down to only 14,900.

Incandescent energy is in high demand by all players; being the highest levelled energy players may harvest, it requires the least amount of energy to create augmentors, and divine charges for Invention training. They are also required to create Sign of the porter VII, which are in high demand for Archaeology training.
95 Divination is required to harvest incandescent energy, but having a higher Divination level will increase the energies per hour.
Without any of the recommended equipment, approximately 8,000 energies per hour can be gathered.
The incandescent wisps are located south of the Poison Waste.
The elder divination outfit colony teleport.
travel: The incandescent wisps are located south of the Poison Waste.
Use the elder divination outfit colony teleport.

For maximum profit, convert all memories into energy (the first option). Converting memories to energy produces energies at approximately 2,273 per hour.

99 Divination.

With level 98 Archaeology and 86 Invention, the player can unlock the Divine Conversion relic, which allows the conversion of a whole inventory of memories in one go.

guides.page: Money making guide/Havenhythe Big Game Hunter
instructions: Giant chinchompas take slightly longer to kill, however the meat obtained is more valuable potentially offering larger profits. The quantities of apex hide and raw giant chinchompa meat stated here assume that giant golden chinchompas are hunted.

Start the encounter by consuming one Azurite moth jar to assist with finding the optimal moth or poison to hunt the creatures. Once this is found it will not change for the hour meaning that only the Calcite and Sugilite moths need to be up-kept beyond this.

guides.page: Money making guide/Havenhythe Big Game Hunter
instructions: Giant kebbits can be hunted faster than their chinchompa counterparts allowing for more meat and hides to be gathered in the same amount of time. The quantities of apex hide and raw giant kebbit meat stated here assume that giant dashing kebbits are hunted.

Start the encounter by consuming one Azurite moth jar to assist with finding the optimal moth or poison to hunt the creatures. Once this is found it will not change for the hour meaning that only the Calcite and Sugilite moths need to be up-kept beyond this.

guides.page: Money making guide/High level player-owned farm run
instructions: Black dragon eggs can be bought from the Grand Exchange and can reliably be sold to other players at the adolescent stage for 400,000-450,000 coins, Unchecked zygomites can be bought from the Grand Exchange and can reliably be sold to other players at the adolescent stage for 200,000-250,000 coins, unchecked crystal chinchompas can be bought from the Grand Exchange and can reliably be sold to other players at the adolescent stage for 70,000-90,000 coins.
The output can be other types of zygomites and chinchompas.

These animals are removed from the pen and replaced with an egg/child/sporeling at the adolescent age due to the quantity of beans received from selling each animal to its individual NPC buyer. The quantity is highest at this age, so players looking to buy animals to exchange for beans will be more likely to buy the best return on their own investment.

In order to reduce investment costs, players may choose to spend a little extra time at the Manor Farm on a populated and/or trade dedicated world and buy "checked" versions of first stage animals from other players for a much lower price than "(unchecked)" counterparts via the Grand Exchange. Keeping in mind that once checked, farm animals do not stack in the bank. Purchasing the storm barn and subsequent extensions allows for up to 60 checked animals to be stored outside of the bank.
Vials of water are often in high demand because they must be used with a herb in order to make an unfinished potion. Players often buy them in bulk.

One can cast Humidify on an inventory of vials. Use astral runes and equip a steam battlestaff to maximise profit and efficiency. Set up one of your "Quick Presets" to Withdraw 27 vials and an astral rune, cast the Humidify spell, which will cause the whole inventory to fill vials with water, open the bank, click the quick preset and repeat. When playing at maximum efficiency, up to 400 spells can be cast per hour, for 10,800 vials of water.

Vials have a buy limit of 10,000 every 4 hours and it is not often that they will buy for 1 coin. Decanting plenty of potions is a fast way of obtaining vials. To decant, bring as many 3 or 4 dose potions to Bob Barter and select "Decant" and select "1 dose" (make sure there are no empty vials). He will charge 2 coins for each vial. Then select the "Decant" option from him and he will turn back all the potions to "4 dose" then bank the excess vials. Repeat the same process as many times as possible. It is recommended to buy cheaper potions if you do not own plenty of potions.
travel: Use a convenient bank to withdraw the listed supplies and deposit the results.

instructions: Azure skillchompas can be caught using box traps at the Rellekka Hunter area, which is found north-east of Rellekka. To access the area where azure skillchompas are located, climb the north-eastern most ladder in the area, then travel north-east again and climb a second ladder. Players can wear polar camo outfit or Kyatt outfit to increase their success rate in catching creatures while hunting in this area. Once trapped, azure skillchompas become stackable items, so players may hunt them for long periods of time without needing to bank.
However, the amount caught per trap scales with Agility level; from level 81 Agility, this amount will be from 2 up to 6.

instructions: Black salamanders are in high demand as they are often used as a disposable weapon to augment then Disassemble to train Invention.

The Boneyard Hunter area is in level 18 - 20 Wilderness - Make sure to have pvp turned off by talking to Vala in Edgeville. Most teleports will work as long as you don't go into level 21. Ring of duelling or Wilderness sword 1 or greater are recommended for quick banking, the Wilderness sword 3 can teleport anywhere under 30 wilderness so is the best choice for teleporting out. TokKul-Zo is not recommended as black salamanders will be kept over it. To reach the area, the Wilderness Crater lodestone can teleport players to south of the Wilderness Crater without cost or requirements. Carrallangar Teleport brings you closer and is faster (takes ~30 seconds to reach the area from start of teleport, versus 1 minute) but requires 84 Magic and completion of Desert Treasure and costs 2 soul runes and 2 law runes.

There is a level 44 Hill Giant in the area that is aggressive to players under level 88. Green dragons are found slightly north, but are not aggressive. Turn left click attack off in combat options to avoid accidentally attacking any of them.

Small fishing nets and ropes are cheap but might not be always available on the Grand Exchange. Nicholas Angle's Fishing Shop (northeast of Taverley lodestone) and Shantay Pass Shop (south of broomstick teleport after exiting from fountain) are convenient sources of them respectively.

instructions: This area can be accessed by travelling south-west from the Barbarian Outpost or by using the shortcut north of the Grand Tree within the Tree Gnome Stronghold (requiring level 19) Agility.
Once trapped, they become stackable items, so players may hunt them for long periods of time without needing to bank.
However, the amount caught per trap scales with Agility level; from level 42 Agility, this amount will be from 2 up to 6. At 50 Agility, the average is around 4.1.
travel: This area can be accessed by travelling south-west from the Barbarian Outpost or by using the shortcut north of the Grand Tree within the Tree Gnome Stronghold (requiring level 19) Agility.

instructions: Crimson skillchompas can be caught using box traps at the Desert Quarry Hunter area, which is found south of the Desert Quarry. As this Hunter area is located in the desert, players should bring waterskins or an enchanted water tiara to avoid taking damage from the desert heat. Wearing desert camouflage gear or graahk hunter gear may increase the success rate in catching crimson skillchompas while hunting in this area. Once trapped, crimson skillchompas become stackable items, so players may hunt them for long periods of time without needing to bank.
However, the amount caught per trap scales with Agility level; from level 94 Agility, this amount will be from 2 up to 6.

instructions: Box trap hunt the crystal skillchompas north of Tyras camp. You can catch ~2600 skillchompas an hour based on intensity and whether or not you have access to the volcanic trapper outfit and hunter skillcape perk. Agility level 99 is not required, but it gives a guarantee that you catch multiple skillchompas per trap.
However, the amount caught per trap scales with Agility level; from level 99 Agility, this amount will be from 2 up to 6.

Green salamanders can be caught using a net trap in the Mort Myre Swamp south-east of Canifis. The hunting spot closest to the Canifis bank is just south-west of the Werewolf Agility Arena. This spot has 4 young trees close together, allowing you to set up 4 traps at once with 60 Hunter, using 4 small fishing nets and 4 ropes. To maximise the amount of lizards you bank per trip, you can leave your traps set up as you run to the bank rather than pick them all up and carry them with you. They will have fallen by the time you get back, so you will have to pick up the ropes and nets and reset the traps. Note: There is a chance the ropes and nets will disappear if you take too long. It is important to stay focused when using this method.

Green salamanders can be difficult to catch at lower levels, therefore it is recommended to use a familiar that invisibly boosts your hunter level, such as a spirit larupia (level 57 Summoning) or an arctic bear (level 71 Summoning).

instructions: You can use Anticipation or Freedom to avoid pavosaurus rex's stuns. Set up your traps, checking and relaying them as grenwalls are caught. With completion of the Medium Tirannwn achievements bait is not required to trap grenwalls. Level 80 Hunter is recommended as it allows five box traps to be placed at the same time. The arctic bear familiar gives an invisible +7 boost to Hunter and scentless flasks give a slight improvement to catch rate.
This guide is based on 200 grenwall catches per hour and an average of 19.5 grenwall spikes per catch. At level 99 Hunter, it's possible to achieve up to 370 catches per hour.

The bonecrusher, seedicide, and herbicide can be used to clean up drops from the grenwalls to conserve inventory space. Wielding the Hunter's Catalyst fragment or Combined Catalyst Fragment will automatically reset the player's box traps when they are triggered but fail to catch a creature. The catalyst fragments require completion of Sliske's Endgame to obtain. If owned, use of the volcanic trapper outfit is highly recommended as it gives a 7% increased success chance, 10% chance of double loot, allows 6 box traps to be placed at once, and gives a 30% chance to instantly deploy/pick up traps. A super hunter or extreme hunter potion could also be used to boost your Hunter level.
guides.location: Anachronia: north-east of the pavosaurus rex clearing, or south-east of the scimitops clearing.

instructions: The value is estimated at 50% of the value of a juju farming potion (3), not taking scroll of cleansing and portable well procs into account.
To hunt them in the Herblore Habitat the required environment for catching them consists of a blue vine blossom, a lergberry bush, a thermal vent, and an orange tree.
On Anachronia, they can be found near the north-west of the Anachronia base camp, or in the northwest of Anachronia Swamp Fortress in the southeast of the island.
Should you choose to hunt them on Anachronia the required hunter level is 84.
Using scentless potion, trapper outfit and arctic bear familiar, it's possible to achieve over 600 catches per hour at level 99 Hunter.
travel: On Anachronia, they can be found near the north-west of the Anachronia base camp, or in the northwest of Anachronia Swamp Fortress in the southeast of the island.

instructions: The outputs are approximate.

Puro-Puro is the choice spot to hunt implings as you are guaranteed to see large numbers of them at any given time. The most effective strategy involves snaring the target impling with a Bind spell then catching it while it is rendered immobile. The bind spell can only be cast when next to the target unless you are wielding a mainhand magic weapon. This will require you to swap to a staff/wand to snare then back to your net to catch the impling. To keep the rarer implings spawning, be sure to catch all implings that are higher-level than nature implings, including nature implings themselves.

Expect for the majority of the implings you see to be nature implings; magpies and zombies are approximately the same rarity; ninjas and pirates are significantly rarer. Dragon and Kingly implings are the rarest (thus the most valuable) appearing about 1 - 2 times an hour; it is possible to see more than 2 or none at all with no guarantees on appearances.

Wielding a magic butterfly net increases the catch rate on implings by 15%. As it is considered a magic weapon, it can be used to cast spells. Implings can only be bound by spells from the normal spellbook; ice does not work. Entangle, a level 79 spell, requires 3 nature runes to bind the target for 24 seconds.

Polar kebbit hunting is one of the best money making method for a level 1 hunter until level 29, when one can hunt green salamanders. This method is just as effective at level 1 as at level 99, and only depends on the familiarity of the player with the routes of the kebbit, so it is worth the time to take time to read through this whole guide for tips if you are unfamiliar with hunting Polar kebbits.

About 105 kebbits may be hunted in one hour by using the Hunting Area in Taverley. On banking runs, it is recommended to use the lodestone teleport to save 1 or two seconds on the run from the bank to the hunting area, and also giving you time to rest. Each inventory should consist of 26 Polar kebbit fur as each kill will give 3 drops, meaning you will be forced to drop items to make the kill. Bones should be buried in pairs instead of after every kill as 2 bones can be buried in one animation. The raw beast meat should be dropped while examining one of the rocks to save time as it holds no true monetary value.
To start each route, search one of the 2 burrows ("hole") located at the north and south ends of the hunting area. Tracks will appear, which will lead to set places.
travel: About 105 kebbits may be hunted in one hour by using the Hunting Area in Taverley. On banking runs, it is recommended to use the lodestone teleport to save 1 or two seconds on the run from the bank to the hunting area, and also giving you time to rest. To start each route, search one of the 2 burrows ("hole") located at the north and south ends of the hunting area. Tracks will appear, which will lead to set places. Click on a rock close to the end of the tracks that you speculate the next set of track will lead to. Without memorizing every pattern, there are several ways to easily identify/narrow down the rocks the kebbit passes by. :1. The kebbit track will never cross over the original tracks like a + sign. It may overlap, but never crosses over. :2. After the second set of tracks has been found, the next tracks will have to lead to a snow drift, and only the two on the east and western side of the hunting area. :3. The tracks don't double back. :4. The rocks that will have fur on them will always be close to the end of the tracks.

instructions: Ruby harvests are the lowest level-requirement butterflies; however, they are also the highest in demand due to their use as the tertiary ingredient in a Forge regent pouch. At lower levels, it may be slightly difficult to catch any of these creatures; however at levels beyond 30, the catch rate is near 100%. With little input and short bank trips — which are even faster if the player invests in Phoenix Lair Teleports — ruby harvests provide for high hourly profit rates.

Viridian skillchompas can be caught using box traps at the Port Phasmatys Hunter area, which is found south of Port Phasmatys. Once trapped, viridian skillchompas become stackable items, so players may hunt them for long periods of time without needing to bank.
However, the amount caught per trap scales with Agility level; from level 64 Agility, this amount will be from 2 up to 6.

guides.page: Money making guide/Imbuing eternal magic weapons
instructions: The steps for each of the magic weapons are as follows.
Craft eternal magic logs to create an inert form of the chosen weapon.
With rune essence or pure essence, travel to the highest elemental (+2 to progress) or catalytic (+3 to progress) runecrafting altar.
Select the altar's Imbue weapons option.
Repeat the imbuing process until the weapon is in a saturated state. Beware of upgrading to ascended as this will destroy the weapon.
travel: With rune essence or pure essence, travel to the highest elemental (+2 to progress) or catalytic (+3 to progress) runecrafting altar.

guides.page: Money making guide/Killing The Barrows Brothers (High-Level)
instructions: High level Barrows. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

With the right skills and equipment, high-level players can loot nearly 18 Barrows chests per hour, resulting in a sizable profit. At higher levels one may use any combat style, although most of the brothers are weak to magic. For best results, a Barrows amulet should be used on the tomb of Akrisae. For faster chests at the cost of lower ROI, Barrows amulets can also be used on Karil and Ahrim.
travel: The starting room of the tunnels has only one operational door. Find this door, and navigate through the tunnels. There is no need to kill any of the creatures in the tunnel since killing all 7 brothers is enough to maximum your reward potential. The chest is located in the centre of the tunnels, and only one of the four adjacent rooms may be used to enter the centre room. It is recommended to run through the passageways connecting corner rooms until finding a door with an "open" option leading into the central room. This door will be locked by a puzzle, and incorrectly answering the puzzle will cause the door to lock and require you to navigate the tunnels again to find a new door.

While running through the tunnels, any of the brothers which have not been killed may spawn when a door is opened. If the brother is not Akrisae, kill him when he spawns, and continue through the maze. It is recommended that prayer renewal be active when running through the tunnels so that Soul Split may be used when killing this brother. Upon opening the chest, the brother whose tunnel you are in will spawn if he has not yet been killed. If this brother is Akrisae, do not fight him. Otherwise, kill this brother. Loot the chest, and teleport out using Drakan's medallion. This teleport cannot be used when in combat, so it is recommended to run behind the chest if being attacked by Akrisae or a crypt monster. Alternatively the War's Retreat Teleport spell can be used to leave, with a boss portal attuned to the Barrows providing a quick way to return.

Starting by killing the southernmost one and going north until you've killed all 7 and picked up their drops, then go back to the southern end when the first would be about to respawn. Killing all of them twice fills the inventory, then use the Lodestone Network to teleport to Taverley and bank.

instructions: Kill black unicorns. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
The best place to kill them is in low-level Wilderness.

The unicorns are found north of Edgeville, in level 18-20 Wilderness. Walk north from Edgeville to reach them, and start attacking -- they only have 1,200 life points so they should only take a couple hits to kill, another option would be to teleport to the Wilderness Crater lodestone, which is very close to the black unicorn area. Pick up the unicorn horns, repeating until you have 28 total. The unicorns may do a small amount of damage to you unarmoured, but not enough to require food. When your inventory is full, teleport back to Edgeville using either the Edgeville lodestone or an amulet of glory, and repeat.

instructions: Kill Crystal Shapeshifters. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.

This guide uses an estimate of 400 kills per hour. It's possible to exceed these numbers with good equipment, but this number falls drastically as equipment worsens. While tier 90+ weaponry, attuned crystal armour, Malevolence and Greater Fury are not all required, players missing several of them may find themselves unable to safely fight more than three or four shapeshifters at once, which significantly reduces kill speeds and thus revenue.

Crystal shapeshifters drop significant amounts of rune salvage and their guaranteed drop of Tarddian crystals are also worth a decent bit of money, and under the right circumstances they can be killed very quickly.
travel: When placed in the rooms in the Sunken Pyramid, crystal shapeshifters will always spawn in their melee form. They can change form, but they will usually only change to the form you are the weakest to, unless you're using protection prayers to defend against that style. By wearing crystal armour, which is hybrid armour (as well as providing some useful effects when fighting the shapeshifters) along with a single piece of mid-level ranged equipment you can ensure they will not change from their melee form without penalising your accuracy too much and allowing access to invention perks such as Scavenging, Biting, or Crackling. This not only means they will walk up to you so you can reach them without having to move, but also makes them use their special attack less frequently, reducing the damage taken and the risk of dying. Depending on the equipment used in other equipment slots, you may need to use higher tier ranged armour to make sure your melee defence is your lowest defence.
A strategy guide for crystal shapeshifters can be found here.

The aggression ability can be used to speed up kills by grouping more easily. You will run to the far end of the arena, activate aggression, then run back to the barrier.

guides.page: Money making guide/Killing exiled kalphite paragons
instructions: Kill exiled kalphite paragons. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
This guide is written assuming 230 kills per hour with level 85 Smithing.
travel: Chitin scraps can be used to repair the tier-90 drygore weapons. They are created by using damaged chitin on an anvil, and the amount of scraps received from each chitin scales with your Smithing level, up to 40 at level 99. Damaged chitin are received as a 100% drop from all exiled kalphite, of which the paragon is easiest to kill en masse. They are weak to arrows but are taken down just as easily with Magic. When killing kalphites, focus on one at a time using multi-target abilities when available. The kalphite paragons do not do a great deal of damage; however, this damage adds up. It is advisable to use Soul Split to help offset this damage. Quickly pick up the damaged chitin and store them in your familiar. When both yours and your familiar's inventories are full, teleport to a location with an anvil (such as Varrock, where an anvil lies near the teleport locations just south of the west bank) and use the damaged chitin on the anvil; empty your familiar's inventory and repeat. When finished, use the Bandit Camp lodestone teleport then run south to the hive. Another alternative is to use magic note paper to note the chitin as you collect them.

The optimal spot for killing kalphites is in the room next to the entrance to the Kalphite King's room. Getting to there from the lodestone takes approximately 60 seconds. The kalphite paragons take around 10 seconds to kill, meaning you can get 50 kills in 10 minutes when you include some time to pick up the drops. It takes less than 20 seconds to get to an anvil; from there, it takes about 60 seconds to smith all the chitin into scraps. This results in an average of 13 minute trips for 50 kills, or about 4.6 trips an hour, giving a total of 230 kills an hour.

Fungal mages are weak to air spells and have few life points, so it is recommended to simply use air spells from the standard spellbook.

Teleport to Varrock using the lodestone, and head north towards the palace. Attack the guards using whatever style is best, although they are weak to air spells. Each guard takes a little less than 60 seconds to respawn, and you should be able to kill all six easily within that period. At higher combat levels, it's also possible to cycle between two worlds using the "Join" function on the Friends List, letting you kill about twice as many guards per hour. The guards drop three grapes about 20% of the time. When your inventory is full, head to the bank located just south west of the palace. The automatic healing inside the bank will negate any need for food. When you're finished, sell the grapes on the Grand Exchange.

Even with use of Protect/Deflect Range alongside devotion, an Enhanced Excalibur, and Vampyrism, expect to still need to eat. Bring a Blood reaver (familiar) with Blood Reaver scroll (Blood Siphon) to stay for longer periods of time.
Kill luminous snagglers. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.
Even with use of Protect/Deflect Magic alongside devotion, an Enhanced Excalibur, and Vampyrism, expect to still need to eat. Bring a pack yak to stay for longer periods of time.
Kill mature grotworms. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

Mature grotworms drop adamant and rune very often. It's best to use High Level Alchemy on these drops to avoid banking too often. Alternatively, players can bring a spring cleaner. They also drop royal dragonhide and varying herbs and seeds uncommonly. If you pick up all these items, you'll generally have to bank about once per hour.
travel: Mature grotworms are found in the bottom level of the Grotworm Lair, which can be accessed by either a long trek through the cave, or a shortcut requiring 50 Agility. Alternatively, players can teleport directly to the grotworms using Remora's necklace teleport after completing Song from the Depths. The grotworms are level 98 and have 12500 life points, so they are much harder to kill than they used to be. They are weak to bolts so it may be worth it to use Ranged against them, but a Magic weapon above level 70 (such as a Staff of light or Polypore staff) is also fairly effective. Consider using Soul Split or a bunyip, but the grotworms also drop two un-noted sharks commonly.

instructions: Kill mithril dragons. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.
travel: They are located on the upper level of the Ancient Cavern, which requires Barbarian Training to access. The area is multicombat and the dragons are aggressive. Drink your super antifire, pray Soul Split and possibly Torment, and start attacking one of them with basic abilities, using the thresholds Wild Magic and Asphyxiate when available. Pick up the mithril salvage, dragon bones and any other items worth keeping, and repeat. When your inventory and your war tortoise or pack yak are full, use the TokKul-Zo to teleport next to the TzHaar Fight Cave, and bank your loot. Run north to the fairy ring and use the code BJQ to return to the Ancient Cavern.

instructions: Kill moss golems (Off Task). Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed. With Greater Chain unlocked followed by use of Tuska's Wrath, Detonate, and other thresholds, over 750 kph can be obtained.

Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed. Profit or loss from creating pouches from spines is not included.

Force muspah, bladed muspah, and throwing muspah are unlocked after completing Fate of the Gods. They are found in the Cradle in Freneskae where they were originally encountered during the quest. The fastest means of reaching the world gate to enter Freneskae is by teleporting with a Sixth-Age circuit after having this teleport added by the Guthixian High Druid.

instructions: Kill nechryael. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
Your actual profits may be higher or lower depending on your speed and luck.

With the Death Note relic, ashes are automatically noted, making banking unnecessary and increasing kills per hour significantly. Using an aggression potion with this combination results in a very AFK moneymaking method.
travel: Level 80 Slayer is required to harm and are reasonably weak for their level. Approximately 386 can be killed per hour at higher levels (counting banking times, assuming a ring of slaying is used for teleporting to the Slayer tower and the desert amulet or TokKul-zo is used for banking). With AoE attacks, they can be easily killed with little attention paid. Strong melee armour is advised, and for low level players it is recommended to take food for healing. Higher level players may wish to use Turmoil and/or Soul Split for healing which will drastically increase the number of kills per hour. If using the desert amulet to bank, there is an altar close to the teleport location to recharge Prayer points.

It is also possible to obtain a Slayer contract from Markus, located just outside of the Slayer Tower entrance. By completing a contract of 180 kills, he will reward you 109,000 coins. Alternatively, it is possible to claim experience rewards from Markus instead of coins.

instructions: Kill nightmares. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

To prevent the common, unstackable muspah spine drops from cluttering up your inventory if using area loot, you can auto-bank them using signs of the porter or a grace of the elves. If banked, they can later be placed into an alchemiser mk. The profit calculation does not take the spines into account.
Kill pyrefiends. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.

Without Greater Chain coupled with Caroming 4, this method nets around 1700-1900 kp/h; also Caroming 4 Ruthless 1(or Demon Slayer) + Aftershock 4 Equilibrium 2 are the BiS perks for this method BUT do not effect the KC dramatically as long as you have Caroming 4.
Crackling helps but is not required to gain 2300+ KC.
Kill rabbits. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
travel: Two colonies of 7 rabbits can be found in Burthorpe, one south of the bank and one to the east. They respawn roughly 2 seconds after being killed, making them very suitable for obtaining raw rabbits. It is recommended to bind all of the following to the action bar for efficiency: the weapons staff of air, chargebow, the magic abilities Chain and Dragon Breath, the ranged abilities Ricochet and Bombardment. Setting up a keybind for cycling target (found in settings under Gameplay->Combat->Targeting->Target Cycling Keybinds), is also recommended. Area loot should be used for picking up drops.

instructions: Kill ravenous ghouls. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
Actual profits may be higher or lower depending on speed and luck. With best-in-slot gear, you can expect upwards of ~1400 kills per hour.

Ravenous ghouls are permanently aggressive when the player has a Blood essence equipped. Ravenous ghouls will drop a lot of sharks and monkfish, which are useful for emergency food in case of low life points.
Kill red dragons. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.

The only non-Wilderness location to kill red dragons is in the Brimhaven Dungeon. Access it using either the Karamja lodestone, a Brimhaven tablet, a charter ship to Brimhaven, or an amulet of glory. Entrance to the dungeon costs 875 coins, unless the Hard Karamja Tasks have been completed. Take the long path south and use the shortcut to enter the area. See for more information. Alternatively, if Karamja gloves 4 are worn, the shortcut near the dungeon entrance can be used to get to them much faster.

For those willing to take the risk of high level wilderness, Red Dragon Isle potentially offers the advantage of a nearby banker, William, who wanders both inside and outside of the gates. Alternately, those who have the Wilderness sword can use it to teleport to the Wilderness herb patch, which allows for quick returns from regular banks outside the Wilderness.

instructions: Kill revenants. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.

Alongside this, drop rates are so rare that you will not get an even distribution of each drop per hour, and going multiple hours without any rare drops at all is common. Your actual profit will be higher or lower depending on your luck and how fast you kill them.

The chance to receive drops can be increased with the completion of the Wilderness achievements and having a revenant drop enhancer in the inventory while killing revenants. Completion of the wilderness achievements increases the amount of drops by ~5.25% and the revenant drop enhancer increases it by ~11.11%.

Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your kill speed.

Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

Members of the Order of Ascension are killed for their ascension keystone drops. Rorarii are the best targets for large quantities of kills owing to their low life points and high population. With high end gear, upwards of 620 kills can be attained per hour.

Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

Rune dragons are the strongest metal dragons in the game. They have a combat level of 127 and 68,250 lifepoints. Accuracy will be an issue if not using Jas dragonbane arrows, which will result in significantly lower kills per hour.
Kill salawa akhs. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
Your actual profits may be higher or lower depending on your speed and luck.

Salawa akhs are a slayer monster that can be found within the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon. This method can be used as a fully AFK money making method, however more input may be required with lower-tiered equipment. You must be using protect from melee or deflect melee from melee to survive, and a scrimshaw of vampyrism to heal.

instructions: Kill seekers. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.

Around 400 kills per hour is the average when within the Stalker dungeon. Alternatively a player-owned Slayer dungeon could be used with 99 Slayer, but the kill per hour here is only around 300 due to the lower amount of seekers and the inability to use a cannon.

Most of the profit from this method comes from obtaining seeker's charms. You may get a decent amount of drops from the rare drop table which depending on luck can add an extra 1m+ per hour. An additional benefit is that killing seekers is one of the only methods to gain Dungeoneering tokens that is fully AFK.

instructions: Kill skeletal wyverns. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
Without the Bonecrusher upgrade and without the Death note relic your kills per hour may be much less. Overloads can increase kills per hour too, but are not needed.
Players who do not have 89 Herblore may use the Elemental shield instead however this will greatly reduce kills per hour.
Kill spellwisps. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
Actual profit may be higher or lower depending on kill speed and drop rates.

Six level 18 spellwisps are found north-west of Wizard's Tower. While they are weak to Ranged, other combat skills could also kill them with ease due to their low health. They drop various items such as impious ashes (which is a 100% drop), water talismans, and a variety of runes.
Kill spiritual mages. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
Actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your gear setup. Higher level players may get up to around 600 kills an hour.
Their staff, salvage and dragon armour drops are not noted, so it is recommended to use magic notepaper to bank them. All other drops are noted or stackable.
guides.location: God Wars Dungeon is one option for these monsters

instructions: Kill spiritual warriors. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed. Over 1000 kills per hour is possible with fully optimised gear and an Inquisitor staff, at the expense of AFK time.

The main priority of this setup is boosting damage and accuracy against the warriors to maximise drops. To this end, the Undead Slayer perk, Salve amulet (e), and 3 pieces of ghost hunter equipment provide a total 37% bonus damage against the warriors, drastically increasing kills per hour (with the ghost hunter equipment also providing an extra 10% experience per hour).
guides.location: God Wars Dungeon is one option for these monsters

Steel dragons can be found in Brimhaven Dungeon (and its resource dungeon), at Ghorrock and in Kuradal's Dungeon (while on a slayer task).

Profit is massively reduced if you die during a kill, as you will lose items, and likely lose all of your uniques.

The rate of uniques is given by the calculator, which is 1.0372 cores per streak and 1.6422 of each of scriptures and artefacts. The expected number of nilas drops per streak is 2, but the quantity dropped ranges from 2 to 42, depending on when in the streak it drops, for an average of 44 per streak.

instructions: Kill the King Black Dragon (Free-to-play). Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
The loot shown averages the minimum and maximum possible of each individual common drop, and assumes equal drop rates between all of them.
travel: Please refer to the strategy guide for information on the recommended gear. Players should create a private instance with spawn speed set to the fastest. Use the following prayers - Incredible Reflexes, Ultimate Strength, Steel Skin, and Protect from Magic. After each kill players can teleport to War's Retreat and restore prayer with the Altar of War. Your actual profits may be higher or lower depending on your speed and luck.

With an Ardougne cloak, the unicows have a chance of dropping noted unicorn horns instead, saving inventory space. Due to an update, this noted effect is permanently enabled and there is no way to disable it in order to guaranteed un-noted drops. However noted unicorn horn can be un-noted one at a time by either a right-click option on the Altar, or 'use' the horn on the Altar. With one unicorn horn and a war tortoise and inventory full of cowhides, it is possible to create and kill up to 45 unicows per trip. This will usually generate about 90 unicorn horns. Banking may be done via the fairy ring (code DJP). Returning to the Tower of Life may be done via the fairy ring once more or using the Ardougne cloak teleport to the Kandarin Monastery. Six or more trips per hour are feasible.

instructions: Kill vyrelords and vyreladies. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
A good spot to AFK for suitably geared players is between the tree and west of the building, which is south of the bank.

Alching all the dragon spears and splitbark drops will help keep you from banking. The splitbark helms can be used to drop on the ground, and using area loot, can pick up drops. Making use of a legendary pet to pick up drops is also convenient.
Kill warped bats. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.
travel: The warped bats in the Lumbridge Catacombs drop batwing about 25% of the time. They are quite easy to kill fast, as they only have 600 life points and respawn almost instantly. Using a two-handed weapon to maximise the initial auto-attack, use basic abilities like Wrack or Piercing Shot to kill them if the first hit isn't enough. Pick up any batwing, and teleport back with the Lumbridge lodestone, bank, and repeat.

instructions: Kill warped tortoises. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.

Accessing the dungeon requires completion of The Path of Glouphrie, and it can be reached by using the spirit tree to go to the mountains east of the Poison Waste. Inside the dungeon, there are two good places to kill warped tortoises. The first is directly up the stairs from the entrance. Because it is very easy to get to, it is also occupied more often. The second location takes about a minute to get to and goes past aggressive warped terrorbirds that can do significant damage on the way there, but the Tirannwn quiver 1 will let you use the Elven Crystal at the start of the dungeon, which shortens the trip significantly. Both locations have two spawns. The quiver will also cause some of the shells to be noted when they drop.

The tortoises only have 5200 life points so they can be defeated very quickly. Kill the other one, and wait for the first to respawn. On very popular worlds this will only take around 11 or 12 seconds, while on normal worlds it might be closer to 20 seconds. Damage taken is negligible with decent armour, so on an average world, you can kill about 300 tortoises per hour.
Kill wyverns. Collect the drops listed in Outputs and restock supplies between trips.

Note, however, that the longest possible slayer task is 75 kills (assignment from Mandrith to be killed in the wilderness), or even only 65 (when taking a task from Laniakea, The Raptor or Morvran). Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your kill speed.
Warm: Wyvern poison damage increased up to 900 per 4-5 ticks.
Your profit rate may be higher or lower depending on speed.
This Shifting Tombs guide focuses on stockpiling Feathers of Ma'at and going after the Off-hand khopesh of the Kharidian by only focusing on looting chests and the urns on the way to chests.

Each Shifting Tombs run takes 5 seconds to start, allows up to 5 minutes to complete, and approximately 5 seconds to start again. By only going after chests, each run including start and end time takes around 2 minutes and 15 seconds to complete on average.

Before starting Shifting Tombs, disable all experience rewards and only select the coins option. This method will not gain you coins or reputation at the end of your run. This is made up for by the significant increase in tombs per hour, chests looted per hour, Feathers of Ma'at obtained, and chances at the off-hand khopesh of the Kharidian. You will need level 90 in each required skill to do tier 3 Shifting Tombs.

To maximize tombs per hour, players should be prepared to teleport out instead of getting to the exit rope if the pathing is unfavorable. The best method for resetting at shifting tombs are as follows from best to worst.

instructions: Your profit rate may be higher or lower depending on speed.

Shifting Tombs is an activity that can be used to stockpile Feathers of Ma'at which are used to kill corrupted creatures and soul devourers. It is also the only source to obtain the off-hand khopesh of the Kharidian, a tier 82 off-hand stabbing weapon which may be upgraded with drops from The Magister to turn it into the tier 92 Khopesh of Elidinis.

Before starting Shifting Tombs, disable all experience rewards and only select the coins option. This will ensure that when you leave the tomb, you will be given a hefty sum of coins instead of experience in various skills. It's also recommended to have level 90 in the skills required so the highest tier can be accessed.
Shifting Tombs has three major requirements in order to obtain maximum reward potential: looting sarcophagi, treasure chests, and removing corruption from the tomb within 5 minutes.

Sarcophagi can be found at the fringes of the tomb, or generally slightly off a branching path. In order to be opened and looted the player needs to follow the sequence the sarcophagus releases onto one of the six Desert Pantheon deities. Sarcophagi do not guarantee loot, but there is a 1/200 chance to loot a soul talisman.
travel: Sarcophagi can be found at the fringes of the tomb, or generally slightly off a branching path. instructions: The botanist's amulet is in high demand because when the amulet is worn, there is approximately a 5% chance to brew a 4-dose potion instead of a 3-dose potion while training Herblore. The first step of this method requires combining silver bars and jades in a furnace. instructions: To create ghostly ink, the player should create a preset with 260 of the corresponding necroplasm, 13 vials of water, and 13 ashes. guides.page: Money making guide/Making large historic component crates
instructions: You can use Calculator:Archaeology/Hotspot to figure out how many artefacts per hour you can dig up. Disable "Hide low level excavations?" so you can see the venator remains hotspot and enable "Stats for Nerds" to see the artefacts rate. Multiply by 50 or 60 to give yourself 10 minutes to restore artefacts, disassemble items and create the crates.

In this method you create signs of the porter in an amount sufficient for upkeep of an hour, gathering of artefacts from venator remains in the Kharid-et Dig Site (starting from level 5). Then repair the artefacts and disassemble them, followed by disassembling items for protective components and padded parts, to create a large crate (historic components).

This method uses Excavating Venator remains as a basis, however instead of selling the materials, you will be repairing the artefacts venator dagger and venator light crossbow to get historical, classic, timeworn, and vintage components from their disassembly.

The auto-screener v1.080 will automatically turn all potential ancient gravel into Third Age iron and Zarosian insignia with a 50/50 chance. This will often increase your monetary yield compared to sifting the ancient gravel, as it can also award many other items - see Money making guide/Screening ancient gravel for comparison.

Potion flasks are popular because they can hold 2 more doses per inventory space over vials. Once daily, you can mine up to 75 red sandstone (or 50 if you have not completed the Elite Desert Tasks) which can be turned into potion flasks.

The first location for red sandstone is just outside of Oo'glog. This location can be mined for 50 sand stone a day and is right near the Robust glass machine. Mine a full inventory and then crawl through the adjacent hole into Oo'glog. Run west to the robust glass machine and left click it to convert all your red sandstone to robust glass. After that, blow the glass into flasks and then bank them. Return to the rock outside of Oo'glog and mine the rest of your daily red sandstone, turning those into flasks as well.
Alternatively after Plague's End, the sandstone can be banked using signs of the porter and later turned into glass using the machine in Prifddinas, which is closer to a bank.

If you have completed the Elite Desert Tasks, there is another sandstone rock east of Sophanem that can be mined for extra 25 red sandstone a day. The fastest way to get here is with a Pharaoh's sceptre or a Sceptre of the Gods. A Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport tablet is almost as fast.

instructions: Sacred oil is used to make pyre logs, used to cremate vyre corpses for rewards. Players are often unwilling to create it, as the process is slow and complicated. Sacred oil is made by using olive oil on the pyre at the Flamtaer temple in Mort'ton during the Shades of Mort'ton minigame. The temple needs to be repaired, and nearby shades need to be kept in check. Both of these actions generate sanctity, which is then spent to create the sacred oil and is individual to the player. Each 4-dose vial of olive oil requires 3.6 sanctity to sanctify, and no oil can be sanctified unless you have at least 10 sanctity.

On world 88, the official world for this activity, there will usually be players maintaining the temple. If this is the case, you can focus almost entirely on killing the nearby loar shades as quickly as possible. Using a halberd with multi-target abilities such as two handed Adaptive Strike and Hurricane, you can kill shades very quickly. However, using ranged or magic lets you target the shades from further away, which is useful if you have to compete with other players for kills.
Each shade has 4000 life points, and grants 2 sanctity when killed. With 100 sanctity you will be able to sanctify 26 vials of olive oil, after which you will have roughly 6 sanctity left.
travel: Once you have a full load of sacred oil, you should head to a bank. If you have unlocked the War's Retreat teleport and have defeated the Barrows Brothers at least once, teleporting to War's Retreat, then returning via a boss portal attuned to the Barrows is by far the fastest way to bank.

Alternatively, if you have completed Desert Treasure and have unlocked the shortcut between Canifis and Mort'ton by playing Temple Trekking, using a bank teleport to get to a bank, then returning using Kharyrll Teleport or the Canifis lodestone is also quick.

instructions: The listed rates assumes 2000 potion making attempts per hour with the modified botanist mask and scroll of cleansing. The experience rate assumes the usage of a portable well, maximum potency torstol incense sticks, maximum advanced pulse core boost, and the maximum clan avatar boost.

Please note that the portable well 10% extra chance to duplicate a potion does not apply to combination potions. As such, the only cost-saving boosts are the modified botanist mask and the scroll of cleansing.

When you have all your supplies, head to world 84 Fort Forinthry if you're not using your own portable wells. It is possible to further boost your potions made per hour by using a beast of burden such as a pack yak along with presets.

After all your potions are made, head to any decanting NPC such as War in War's Retreat or Bob Barter (herbs) in the Grand Exchange and have him decant your super saradomin brew (3) into super saradomin brew flasks.

guides.page: Money making guide/Making torstol incense sticks
instructions: Torstol incense sticks are used by wealthy players for their global experience boost. While it would technically be faster to use infernal magic incense sticks in the process, there is no profit margin for whoever makes those, and as such they will hardly ever be found on the Grand Exchange. It takes 5 ticks to apply the ashes to the sticks, then 6 ticks to apply the herb to the ashed sticks. Accounting for some extra time for banking, 500 ashed and herbed incense sticks per hour is a reasonable expectation.

The Prayer experience from ashing the magic incense sticks is identical to the experience from scattering the infernal ashes, but unlike typical Prayer and Firemaking training methods, incense turns the logs and ashes into a sellable product rather than simply being destroyed, making it a rare method of training either skill that can actually make money in the process. It is slower Prayer XP than scattering the ashes due to the time required per ash and about half the time being taken up with applying the herb instead, to say nothing of using altars for Prayer training, but it is Prayer XP at a profit nonetheless.
travel: Use a convenient bank to withdraw the listed supplies and deposit the results.

instructions: With Infernus pyroclasts tradeable on the Grand Exchange, ultracompost production is no longer limited by the manure dropping rate of dragons at the Anachronia dinosaur farm. There are 7 compost bins, allowing for 105 buckets of ultracompost roughly every 90 minutes, effectively 70 buckets an hour. Compost bin locations: Manor Farm, Catherby, Taverley, South Falador, East of Canifis, Herblore Habitat, and Prifddinas.
guides.location: Compost bins; Manor Farm is one option

instructions: With the release of Garden of Kharid, the process for making compost has been streamlined.
Deposit 1,000 noted infernus pyroclasts into any compost bin.
Return after about 28 hours to collect the ultracompost and deposit it to a tool leprechaun until the compost bin is empty.
A quick way to do this while avoiding the UI is to "use" the ultracompost on the leprechaun, typing in any number 28 or above (99 works) into the prompt and hitting enter.
Withdraw the ultracompost from the tool leprechaun in noted form (via the "Noted-X" option in the storage interface) and sell it.
guides.location: Compost bins; Manor Farm is one option

guides.page: Money making guide/Making unfinished avantoe potions
instructions: Avantoe potion (unfinished) are used to create super energy potions. Because these are often used to train Herblore, and adding clean avantoe to a vial of water gives little experience, many players avoid the tedium of making unfinished potions and buy them directly from the Grand Exchange.

Using portable wells gives a 5% chance of making an extra potion and the scroll of cleansing gives a permanent 10% chance of not using up an ingredient when making potions. The bonuses of these two items increase the number of unfinished potions you can make, and the portable well also makes the process less click-intensive. With a portable well placed next to a bank chest, click on the bank chest and deposit your inventory and withdraw 14 herbs and 14 vials of water by using a bank preset, and repeat.

There is usually a portable well placed and maintained by someone else next to the bank chest in the Lumbridge Market in world 84. However, if there isn't one and no-one else provides one within a reasonable amount of time, you may have to use your own wells.

instructions: Weapon poison++ is made by using cave nightshade on a vial of coconut milk and poison ivy berries. Cave nightshade only spawns inside the Skavid caves under Gu'Tanoth, east of Castle Wars, and is untradeable, so the spawn time of the nightshade is the limiting factor in how fast weapon poison++ can be made.

The easiest way to get there is by teleporting to the Yanille lodestone and walking to the most northern cave entrance marked on the map to the right. A skavid map is required to enter. A light source is required to prevent damage from swarming insects. Armoured gloves are required to pick cave nightshades. Cave nightshades can be noted with magic notepaper by using the nightshade on the paper, but not vice versa. Signs of the porter may also be used to bank the harvest.

It takes approximately 30 seconds for each of the plants to respawn (with a small amount of randomness), and both caves contain 7 plants. You can gather more quickly by hopping world rather than waiting for respawns.
The varanusaur envenomed perk gives a 10% chance to make 4 doses instead of 3 doses when mixing these potions.

It takes 42 seconds to process 28 yew logs, so a full load of 2000 will take at least 3024 seconds, or 50 minutes.

The guide specifically outlines 12 individual shop moneymakers and offers an efficient way of completing all of them in a single run. Moreover, it provides a list of items and alternatives that enable players to benefit from the guide, along with tips and tricks for optimizing profits through effective routing and inventory management. instructions: Adamantite ore is an item that often sells for a high price, as it can be smelted in a furnace with a luminite ore to form an adamant bar, requiring level 40 Smithing.
There are several locations to mine adamantite, but one of the best places to mine adamantite is at the Rimmington mine (see page for banking details).

First, go to the ore locations and start mining. Once the player have a full inventory, go to the nearest bank, deposit the ores, return to the ore location, and repeat. The player may also find sedimentary geode while mining, which can increase the profit slightly. The player should also keep their stamina up, and mine any rockertunity the player may encounter, as it can increase the profit.
For a close approximation of ore mined per hour (of pure mining) based on your levels and gear see the mining rate calculator.
Mining luminite ore in the dwarven mines gives you more mining experience per hour and might be more profitable. Here's a table over experience gained and profit while mining luminite.

This is an excellent way to mine fairly AFK for a long period of time, and the metamorphic geode does provide some additional income over time, but it is highly dependent on luck and having the Refined perk. Alternatively, the player can use the Fortune perk to occasionally mine an extra ore. Stone spirit and ore prices fluctuate significantly on the Grand Exchange, so be sure to test prices before heavily investing in materials. For a close approximation of ore mined per hour (of pure mining) based on your levels and gear, see the mining rate calculator.

A grace of the elves allows Seren spirits to spawn, which reward the player with an item from the rare drop table. It can also be charged with signs of the porter to bank items. However, be aware that the grace of the elves has a high upfront cost as it becomes permanently untradeable once equipped for the first time.
Having a Luck of the Dwarves equipped allows the player to obtain the best drops from Seren spirits and also increases the chance of getting metamorphic geodes.
Tagga's corehammer gives the player +10% critical strike chance and +35 critical strike damage. It also has a 8.5% chance of producing deathspore arrow tips.
Light and Dark animica are high level tier 90 ores, used to make Elder rune bars.

When the hour begins, drink a sip of perfect juju mining potion, summon a lava titan, and if on legacy mode, use dragon battleaxe's special. You will want to find a world with two of the same rocks close to each other, so a rockertunity will spawn next to you. Click these for extra experience and more damage, meaning faster rocks. You can also 4 tick to keep your stamina up and mine faster.

If you do not have Grace of the elves or signs of the porter, a bank and a furnace are reasonably close. An elder rune box can initially hold up to 100 ore, and level 95 Mining and completion of the Everything Is Oresome achievement each increase the capacity by 20, up to a total maximum of 140 ore. Igneous and metamorphic geodes have a chance to appear in your inventory, while metamorphic geodes are quite rare, you can expect between 0-5 (4-5 rare) for 1 hour of mining animica.

Profit could be further increased with a Tagga's corehammer as it gives the player +10% critical strike chance and +35 critical strike damage, and also has a 8.5% chance of producing deathspore arrow tips.
guides.location: Trahaearn runite mine, Prifddinas, during Trahaearn Voice of Seren

guides.page: Money making guide/Mining common gem rocks in Al Kharid mine
instructions: Using the Dungeoneering cape, Dungeoneering master cape, or the Hoardstalker ring, teleport to Al Kharid resource dungeon, but do not enter the dungeon. Mine any one of several common gem rocks available. With a full inventory, teleport close to a bank, such as Edgeville lodestone, and repeat. guides.page: Money making guide/Mining concentrated coal rocks
instructions: Coal can be mined from concentrated coal deposits in the Living Rock Caverns. Unlike regular coal rocks, concentrated coal deposits yield five pieces of coal at once.
Note that the coal obtained in the above example requires 4-ticking. Afk methods will produce around 6000 ore.

It is recommended to use a lava titan, requiring 83 Summoning, to give an extra 10 mining damage to increase the speed at which the coal is mined. The golden mining suit gives a 5% increase to experience when worn, but it does not increase the rate that the coal is mined. A full decorated mining urn can be teleported for 625 mining experience, but it does not affect the rate of obtaining coal and it cannot be sold. For the purpose of money making, it is not recommended to use urns as they take up inventory space and provide no benefit to the amount of coal earned. For a close approximation of coal mined per hour (of pure mining) based on your levels and gear see the mining rate calculator.
Be sure to assign an action bar slot for your ore box if not using signs of the porter, to avoid wasting extra time depositing coal.
travel: Once your inventory and your ore box is full, you'll need to run back towards the Pulley lift at the entrance of the Living Rock Caverns. Simply use your Orebox on the Pulley to deposit all of your ore, then click deposit on the Pulley and right click and deposit all of the ore in your inventory. Be careful when depositing your inventory of ore, not to deposit your Orebox.

Granite is an item in demand for its use as tertiary ingredient in making granite lobster pouches. It can be mined from granite rocks in the Desert Quarry. As the Desert Quarry is located far from a bank, collecting granite can be difficult. However a player can use a sign of the porter IV, or better, to send granite to their bank as it is mined. Signs of the porter are untradeable and must be created by the player. A sign of the porter IV is created from an emerald necklace and 45 vibrant energy. Players can use lower level signs of the porter, but, as lower level signs of the porter are able to send fewer items to the bank before being used up, they will be able to use this method for less time before needing to bank to get more signs of the porter. As granite can only be mined in the Kharidian desert, an enchanted water tiara or completion of Crocodile Tears is needed to avoid taking damage from the desert heat. Players may also wish to wear Varrock armour 2 or better to have a chance of mining two pieces of granite at once. Mining granite could be combined with cutting granite to make additional profit.

instructions: With the release of Fort Forinthry, limestone has gone up in price. guides.page: Money making guide/Mining red and crystal sandstone
instructions: Crystal flasks are used for Herblore potions. To get these flasks, mine the rock, turn the sandstone into glass and blow the glass into flasks (which are tradeable). You can use a Beast of Burden to store the sandstone.
The above output is assuming 110 Mining, 110 Strength, and using a primal pickaxe + 5.
Mine 28 crystal-flecked sandstone from the Ithell crystal sandstone rock.
Run to the nearby robust glass machine and create 28 crystal glass.
Click on the crystal glass and create 28 crystal flasks.
travel: Run to the nearby robust glass machine and create 28 crystal glass.
Bank the crystal flasks and run back to the crystal-flecked sandstone rock.

Level 92 Farming is required to raise dragons and have royal dragons in the large pens. Each pile of red dragon manure can be mucked to fill one bucket. Climb into the stile, hover over a pile of red dragon manure, and click "Muck out Dragon manure" to fill a bucket. instructions: Alchemist's keys have a buy limit of only 1,000 per 4 hours. They may need to be purchased ahead of time to open chests without running out.

Utilising either bladed dive or dive with mobile will greatly speed up the processing rate. instructions: The closed chest, located in the Yanille Agility dungeon, always rewards nine herbs when opened: three grimy ranarr, two grimy harralander, and one each of grimy torstol, grimy irit, grimy avantoe and grimy kwuarm. Opening the chest requires a sinister key, and the key is used up when the chest is opened. Depending on the price difference between the keys and the herbs, it can be very profitable to buy sinister keys, open the chest, and sell the resulting herbs.

Start out by summoning your best Beast of Burden; a war tortoise or pack yak is recommended. Wear a slashing weapon of any kind, and withdraw two law runes, along with 5 sinister keys (war tortoise) or 6 sinister keys (pack yak). Teleport to the Watchtower, go down the ladder, and run east to the dungeon entrance. Slash the web, go down the stairs, and across the agility ledge. Enter the obstacle pipe immediately next to you and open the chest at the end of the room. You will be poisoned, but this only hits for about 15 damage and can safely be ignored. Keep opening the chest (it takes about 8 seconds each), storing the herbs in your Beast of Burden as needed. Depending on the price of the grimy harralander, it may be worthwhile to drop them so you can use more keys per load.

instructions: Located in the centre of the Lava Maze, the muddy chest contains various rewards. Opening it consumes a muddy key. Muddy keys have a buying limit of 100 on the Grand Exchange, but they are relatively easy to buy since they have a high trade volume.

Make your way to the Lava Maze with 28 muddy keys in your inventory either by running, using teleports, or using the canoe. Slash the webs apart and avoid the hellhounds (or turn on Protect from Melee), and make your way to the muddy chest at the end. Run to the nearest cape seller/banker to the west of the Lava Maze and refill your inventory with keys using a preset. Sometimes a roaming banker will be within sight when you leave the maze so use this bank when possible.

Free players will either get 5000 or 15000 coins from the chest, with an estimated average of 7500 per opening. This means only one inventory space is required for all the loot. Use Surge to optimise your running time.

instructions: Located in the centre of the Lava Maze, the muddy chest contains various rewards. Opening it consumes a muddy key. Muddy keys have a buying limit of 100 on the Grand Exchange, but they are relatively easy to buy since they have a high trade volume.

Starting your run, fill your inventory with muddy keys. Teleport to the level 44 obelisk using an obelisk shard or the portable obelisk. Make your way through the maze, slashing the webs apart and avoiding the hellhounds. Having a kitchen built in Fort Forinthry gives a 100% success rate in slashing spider webs. Reach the muddy chest at the end. Avoid the aggressive ripper demons inside the muddy chest area or turn on Protect from Melee/Deflect Melee. When finished, teleport out of the maze. Bank, heal if necessary, and refill your inventory with keys using a preset. Rinse and repeat.

Be wary as your first used key can drop items on the floor. Dive and Mobile can be used to optimise your running time. Out of the three ripper demons at the end of the maze, only the westernmost one is in aggro range of the chest. The best way to deal with it is to lure it north, outside of the fence, then east and directly south, on top of the earth staff spawn. Then teleport out so it doesn't follow you.
