guides.page: Money making guide/Operating high capacity plank maker
instructions: Make sure you're actually using the high capacity plank maker, instead of the regular plank maker. If you do not, the profit gained from this activity will be lower than shown on this page.

You will first need to have built a plank maker, then create the high capacity plank maker. You can build a high capacity plank maker in the Invention Guild with 117 Invention. If provided with machine charges, this machine will convert logs into planks. It can hold up to 7,500 items at once, and thus can be left to run for about a week without any required input.

With a jumbo generator, up to two high capacity plank makers can be run at a time, potentially resulting in doubled profit, at the expense of being limited in terms of what other machines can be used. Additionally, with a fully upgraded Workshop in Fort Forinthry, three can be used, but there will be no power left for any other machines. To allow profit to be easily calculated for any combination of machines, this page calculates profit on a per-machine basis.

With the introduction of a new Construction training method of reconstructing various building within Fort Forinthry, processing planks into refined planks and frames in the Workshop may provide an increased profit.

guides.page: Money making guide/Operating partial potion producer DX
instructions: Make sure you're actually using the partial potion producer DX, instead of the regular potion producer. If you do not, the profit gained from this activity will be lower than shown on this page. For more detailed information on which herb to select, see the §Potion prices section below.
Unfinished potions are always in high demand because of their use in the Herblore skill.

You will first need to have built a partial potion producer, then create the partial potion producer DX. You can build a partial potion producer DX in the Invention Guild with 114 Invention. If provided with machine charge, this machine will turn clean herbs and vials of water into their respective unfinished potion. It can hold up to 13,000 items at once, and can be left to run just short of two weeks without any required input.

With a jumbo generator, up to three partial potion producers DX can be run at a time, potentially resulting in tripled profit, at the expense of not being able to run any other type of machine. To allow profit to be easily calculated for any combination of machines, this page calculates profit on a per-machine basis.
The input capacity and processing time for each type of invention machine (alchemiser, potion producer, disassembler etc) varies. See below for examples.

guides.page: Money making guide/Operating the Alchemiser mk. II
instructions: Make sure you're actually using the alchemiser mk. II, instead of the regular alchemiser. If you do not, the profit gained from this activity will be lower than shown on this page as that machine also requires fire runes and processes fewer items every day. For more detailed information on which item to select, see the Item prices section below.

You will first need to have built a regular alchemiser, then create the alchemiser mk. II. You can build a alchemiser mk. II in the Invention Guild with 108 Invention. If provided with machine charge, this machine will cast the High level Alchemy spell on the provided items. The machine will alchemise 600 items daily. It can hold up to 5,000 items at once, and thus can be left to run just over 8 days without any required input.

It is possible to boost your Invention level with an extreme invention potion by 17 levels, allowing you to build the alchemiser Mk. II and a jumbo generator at level 91 Invention. Once you have boosted, you must go to the inventor's workbench and research the blueprint.
The buy limit for dragon items is either 10 every four hours (60 per day) or 100 every four hours (600 per day), depending on the item. As the alchemiser mk.

guides.page: Money making guide/Performing manifest ectoplasm rituals
instructions: At level 95 Necromancy, players can perform Manifest ectoplasm rituals to create ectoplasm, an important ingredient used in Necromancy combat. The limiting factor of this money making method is gathering buckets of slime, which are untradable. It is currently not possible to use the notepaper on the buckets, but you can use the bucket on the notepaper to convert the buckets into bank notes.

A cheaper way to gather buckets of slime (without Magic notepaper) is to use Morytania legs 2, Morytania legs 3, or Morytania legs 4 which grant 5, 10, or unlimited free daily teleports to the Ectofuntus slime pool, respectively.
Wear an Alteration necklace.

instructions: Put War's Retreat Teleport on your main skilling/non-combat action bar and have that as your primary bar. Right click on your (equipped) explorer's ring 3, cabbage-port, then start plucking in organised fashion so you can always walk two steps over to the next cabbage. Going across rows each time is advised. Once your inventory is full, teleport to War's Retreat and go to the bank chest. Hit 3 to bank-all and Esc to exit with your cursor already on your explorer's ring. Repeat.
As an alternative for free players without the War's Retreat Teleport, the Skull of Remembrance from the quest The Death of Chivalry can be used to teleport close to a bank chest.
Low-level players should beware Goblin Raids spawning on the cabbage patch, although Goblin Raiders are not aggressive.

instructions: Cadava berries are valuable as ingredients in Necromancy potions. They can be picked from cadava bushes south of Varrock. There are 3 of them with 2 berries each, or 6 in total.
Due to the long respawn time, this method requires world switching to gather berries more quickly. The gathering speed would depend on how fast world switching can be done.

After 5 worlds, you should have 28 berries. Banking is fastest with War's Retreat Teleport, then use Archaeology journal to teleport back. If you have not unlocked War's Retreat Teleport, you can bank with the journal. 25 runs are possible in 1 hour.
Cadava berries are in high demand and the bushes are not instanced, so there might be occasional competition making it take longer to gather berries.

instructions: 240 Coins are needed only for the charter ship; the Karamja lodestone is no cost. Juju teleport spiritbag cost can be eliminated using the witchdoctor mask. Coconuts grow on palm trees, and they're used to make coconut milk, used in high-level Herblore. They're also used to pay farmers to look after magic trees. Once a palm tree has grown fully, it can be harvested repeatedly, with a coconut growing back every 45 minutes for a maximum of six. Harvest the coconuts and note them with the tool leprechaun at any patch if inventory becomes full.
Enter the maze by following Elkoy, use the spirit tree to get to the Tree Gnome Stronghold patch, above the agility course.
Teleport to Castle wars using a ring of duelling, use Fairy ring code CIQ, or the Yanille lodestone for the fruit tree patch near Tree Gnome Village, west of the maze.
Charter a ship to Brimhaven, use a brimhaven tablet, or take the Karamja lodestone to get to the patch, south of the docks.
Teleport to Catherby lodestone and run south-east to the tree patch.

instructions: Picking up glowing fungus and dropping it turns it into ashes, highly valued for Necromancy as an ingredient of ghostly ink. The Underworld Grimoire is required as it automatically banks any ashes picked up and the glowing fungus is very remote. Once you have picked up a piece of the fungus, drag and drop it onto your action bar. Once it is bound to a key, you can hold that key indefinitely and any fungus you hold and further pick would automatically be dropped. Click the dropped ashes to open the loot interface, then you can use space to loot and bank all ashes on the ground at once. One inventory can be banked in about 36 seconds, or 100 loads in 1 hour (although you don't have to bank 28 ashes exactly every time). Glowing fungus regrows almost instantly.

Papaya fruits grow on papaya trees, and they're used in Summoning, Hunter and Farming. Once a papaya tree has grown fully, it can be harvested repeatedly, with a papaya growing back every 45 minutes for a maximum of six.

instructions: Raw potatoes are the base ingredient for all types of potatoes with toppings. There is a consistent demand for raw potatoes on the Grand Exchange, and someone has to pick them!

Potatoes can be found in potato fields, and the best free-to-play location is north of the Lumbridge cow pen. Starting off at the Varrock lodestone, walk the road south, going through the fence. The potato field is directly to the south east. Use of Surge can reduce travel time.

Pick the potatoes - travelling diagonally along the rows is most effective. Members can store potatoes in sacks to reduce the amount of time spent banking, and increase profit earned per hour. Potato seeds are sometimes obtained from picking potatoes on members worlds; it is therefore recommended to do this method on a free to play world.
Teleport to the Burthorpe lodestone and bank there. Teleport back to the Varrock lodestone and run back to the potato field to continue picking potatoes.

Teleport to the Burthorpe lodestone and bank there. Teleport back to the Varrock lodestone and run back to the potato field to continue picking potatoes.

instructions: See also primal fruit pulp for info on fruit. Harvesting primal fruit allows a player to get farming XP while collecting valuable fruit. Once a plant has fully grown, fruit can be collected regularly without additional input. Higher level fruit gives more experience, more pulp and often more profit. The master farmer gives a 10% chance to get an additional piece of fruit at the bush or fruit tree patches. Unlocking Bountiful Harvest 2 from the Garden of Kharid gives a 7% chance of an additional item upon each harvest.
A primal fruit run consists of 3 parts.
For the bush patches a wolpertinger doubles yield and XP. The bush can be clicked once per tick for faster harvesting. The patches are at.
Champion's guild, reachable from the Combat bracelet or Varrock lodestone.
Rimmington, reachable from a (modified) Teleport to house or Port Sarim lodestone.
guides.location: 4 × cactus patches, 8 × fruit tree patches, 5 × bush patches
travel: Use Champion's guild, reachable from the Combat bracelet or Varrock lodestone.
Use Rimmington, reachable from a (modified) Teleport to house or Port Sarim lodestone.

guides.page: Money making guide/Picking up eggs at Fred's Farm
instructions: Pick up eggs at Fred's Farm. Once you enter the farm, close the gate behind you and kill all the chickens outside the gate using cheap ranged/magic weapons (such as a chargebow or air staff). Chickens will then only respawn and spawn eggs inside the gate. Stay at the centre of the farm, and area loot as eggs shows up. It is recommended to keybind area loot to make picking up eggs easier.
The archaeology professor is located inside the Exam Centre.

Pickpocketing success chance decays over time (1% per 7.2 seconds after initial bonus success pickpockets), so stacking more buffs will allow the player a longer period before their success chance decreases below 100%. instructions: Priffdinnas clan workers function slightly differently from standard pickpocketing targets. Instead of doing damage upon catching the player, they have a three strike system where getting caught three times will prevent the player from getting pickpocketing the same clan for 20 minutes (15 minutes with the Totem of Crystal). While the system was designed so that players rotate between three or more clans, the changes to pickpocketing mechanics allow players to pickpocket the same clan indefinitely as long as they refresh their pickpocketing =before being caught. A sound cue will play when the pickpocketing success chance drops below 100%; players should switch to another worker when this happens. Alternatively, players who maintain a 5 minute 100% success time with the Crystal Mask strategy will naturally refresh their buff when recasting the spell at the 5 minute mark.

Pickpocketing success chance decays over time (1% per 7.2 seconds after initial bonus success pickpockets), so stacking more buffs will allow the player a longer period before their success chance decreases below 100%. travel: Workers from all clans have at least one uncommon item on their loot table that is not stackable, so the Thieving cape is recommended for this activity. Players without the Thieving cape can use the banks in Prifddinas and should prioritize the clans which have them (Ithell, Trahaern, Hefin, Meilyr), unless they have an attuned crystal teleport seed, in which case they can quickly teleport to Ithell or Trahaern bank. Players may also choose to drop the unstackable items as they tend to be low value.

While the system was designed so that players rotate between three or more clans, the changes to pickpocketing mechanics allow players to pickpocket the same clan indefinitely as long as they refresh their pickpocketing =before being caught. A sound cue will play when the pickpocketing success chance drops below 100%; players should switch to another worker when this happens. Alternatively, players who maintain a 5 minute 100% success time with the Crystal Mask strategy will naturally refresh their buff when recasting the spell at the 5 minute mark.

Pickpocketing success chance decays over time (1% per 7.2 seconds after initial bonus success pickpockets), so stacking more buffs will allow the player a longer period before their success chance decreases below 100%. Players should generally aim for a 100% success time of 5 minutes, which is the time that the Crystal Mask spell lasts. Refreshing the spell also refreshes the player's success chance.
travel: Workers from all clans have at least one uncommon item on their loot table that is not stackable, so the Thieving cape is recommended for this activity. Players without the Thieving cape can use the banks in Prifddinas and should prioritize the clans which have them (Ithell, Trahaern, Hefin, Meilyr), unless they have an attuned crystal teleport seed, in which case they can quickly teleport to Ithell or Trahaern bank. Players may also choose to drop the unstackable items as they tend to be low value.

instructions: Paladins are a more accessible NPC for pickpocketing money making with two distinct advantages.
Their only loot is coins and chaos runes, the latter of which is relatively price stable. This means that players will not need to bank their loot or require the Thieving cape to note it.

This can be increased significantly with levels and/or the finger discount unlocks, providing players with a significant amount of AFK time without having to meet the higher requirements of Crystal Mask.

guides.page: Money making guide/Raising black dragons to adolescent
instructions: Black dragon eggs can be bought from the Grand Exchange and can reliably be sold to other players at the adolescent stage for a profit. This is done through direct trade to other players that are looking to sell these for beans.

Bottled dinosaur roars are used in high level potions (for example vulnerability bombs). Raising rex dinosaurs with the goal of getting these roars can be profitable while also giving a lot of farming experience. With an optimal setup, seven animals can be growing at all time on average, using a single breeding pair in the breeding pen. Higher level dinosaurs give more experience and resources.
The strategy for this method is as follows.
Go to the Anachronia Dinosaur Farm. It can be reached from a Max Guild garden skilling portal (including through grace of the elves), or the mystical tree upstairs in the Manor Farm.

Check the large pens and breeding pen. Any animals should be health checked, and any non-breeding elder animals should be removed. Make sure the troughs have enough food to last until your next visit.
Check the breeding pen. If the large pens have space, move non-breeding animals to large pens.

guides.page: Money making guide/Running the Anachronia Agility Course for codex pages
instructions: Each lap at the Anachronia Agility Course gives a guaranteed 10 codex pages. An additional 1-3 codex pages can be randomly received when completing any obstacle. By having at least tier three luck (such as a ring of fortune or a charged collector's insignia), players can improve their chances of gaining additional codex pages when completing obstacles. With tier 3 luck, each lap will grant a total of 12 codex pages on average.

The course is spread out with open areas between obstacles. Using Bladed Dive or Dive and Surge, along with the Mobile perk will allow for faster laps (up to an additional lap per hour). Powerbursts of acceleration can also be used to quickly surge and dive on parts of the course, further saving time. With double surge, dive, mobile, and an optimised route, players can expect lap times of around 6 minutes, allowing for 9 to 10 laps per hour. Double surge is highly recommended; without it, each lap will take 6:30 to 7 minutes or even longer, which hurts the profit rate significantly.
Once per day, a god banner can also be used to boost the player's Agility level by 5 for 30 minutes (roughly 4 laps).

Killing any enemy while having the Scavenging perk equipped has a chance to award uncommon or rare components. Since the health of the enemy does not affect the chances, it is recommended to kill as many low-level enemies as possible, such as skeletons in the Lumbridge Catacombs. With high enough gear it is possible to get over 5,000 kills per hour.
See Guide for Scavenging for a detailed explanation of how to maximise kills per hour, what equipment to wear, and what abilities to use on your revolution bar.
This method will also award other components, however only the most valuable are shown here.

guides.page: Money making guide/Screening soil using Sift Soil
instructions: The materials gained are approximations based on the listed drop rates in each soils' page and may be different depending on your Archaeology level.

Note that the buy limit of each soil is 5,000 per 4 hours; you can get around this limit by cycling the type of soil you choose to sift. It is also possible to work around the limit by letting the order fill while doing other activities, directly trading with other players, or by using alternate accounts. Be warned that each soil has different profit margins.

Wearing the full Master archaeologist's outfit and casting Sift Soil allows soil to be screened at a rate of 1 soil per tick, or a theoretical maximum rate of roughly 5,680 soil per hour. In addition, the Sift Soil spell removes the need for a screening station, allowing soil to be sifted right next to a bank.

The fastest way to start screening soil with Sift Soil is by casting the spell while holding down the spacebar. Sift Soil can sift up to 100 soil (or, more likely, until your inventory fills up) without needing to be recast, but each soil screened will consume only one Astral rune as long as you have a Elemental Battlestaff equipped for the other rune cost.
travel: Just like a screening station, Sift Soil can screen soil directly from a soil box. As such, you should store soil in the soil box to minimise banking time. The fastest way to store materials without banking the soil box itself is to use a Material storage container. However, you also need a bank nearby from which to refill your soil box. The closest Material storage container to a bank is located at the Archaeology Guild campus, north of the Mysterious monolith or in the Workshop (Fort Forinthry).

guides.page: Money making guide/Shear Sheep To Balls Of Wool
instructions: Start by teleporting to Burthorpe. Walk south until you hit the sheep pen (across from the cows near Burthorpe mine. Shear the sheep until your inventory is full. Walk straight to the spinning wheel (north of the cow pen) and turn it into balls of wool. Walk north to the bank chest and deposit it. The whole process takes about 2:29. Rinse and repeat for as long as you like. Once you're ready, teleport to the Exchange and sell them.
Each trip takes 2.5 minutes, or 24 trips per hour, with a full backpack of 28 balls of wool per trip.

Rinse and repeat for as long as you like. Once you're ready, teleport to the Exchange and sell them.

instructions: The sheep pen near Taverley is the best location to collect wool due to how close it is to the bank in Burthorpe. Simply click on a sheep that has wool until your inventory is full, then bank and repeat. Each trip can be done in 100 seconds, assuming you have the pen to yourself.

It should take around 52 seconds to make an inventory of adamant bars, deposit them into your metal bank and then start the process over again.

The profits listed for this guide are assuming most recommended items are used. If these are not unlocked, then your profit should be similar to the ones listed at the free-to-play guide. In particular, the Superheat Form prayer has a large impact on the bars processed each hour, as it decreases the time to smelt each bar from 1.8 to 1.2 seconds. With the smelting gauntlets equipped and superheat form active, it should take around 73 seconds to make 60 adamant bars. This makes it possible to smelt 2,950 bars an hour without any additional buffs.
Level 47 Smithing gives a 10% chance to double bars.
Wearing a Varrock armour 2 gives a 2% chance to double bars. This requires completion of the medium Varrock achievements.
Completion of the Hard New Varrock achievements doubles the bonus of the Varrock armour 2.

instructions: Very strong smithable tier 90 melee power armour which is also used to repair trimmed masterwork armour.

It takes around 6 hours with all possible boosts to fully smith a set of masterwork armour, using a total of 12 glorious bars, 12 steel bars and 12 leathers, so the quantities and profit in this guide are an extrapolation.

Use of the world 70, which is themed around the Artisan's workshop, is recommended as it's more likely for there to be luminite injectors active, which allow for +2 additional progress to be achieved per hammer strike on an unfinished smithing item.

For a more AFK process if you are not using the Orthen furnace core, superheat form can be used alongside an (advanced) smithing autoheater to restore heat up to 60% every time it runs out, grace of the elves to reduce the prayer drain of superheat form and an ancient elven ritual shard to restore prayer every 5 minutes for free. Otherwise, a super prayer renewal potion can be used instead.
The Orthen furnace core eliminates prayer drain entirely on its own and is the best current method bar none when used in conjunction with the (advanced) smithing autoheater for a more AFK process.

guides.page: Money making guide/Smithing adamant dart tips
instructions: Although adamant dart tips can be smithed by a current free player, they must have previously completed The Tourist Trap, a members-only quest.

Use any anvil to forge adamant bars into dart tips. Noted adamant bars can be added to the metal bank and then withdrawn, as adamant dart tips are stackable there is no need to bank. You can queue up smithing multiple sets of adamant dart tips by right clicking the anvil, choosing "open smithing interface" and selecting adamant dart tips until you have a full inventory of unfinished smithing items. You will then start to smith the dart tips, automatically starting to smith the next unfinished item as each is completed. Maintain high heat by using a forge to progress in creating nails at the fastest rate.

Although smithing adamant dart tips only requires level 40 Smithing, level 49 Smithing is recommended in order to create each unfinished smithing item with the highest possible heat available, maximising the number of dart tips smithed per hour.

guides.page: Money making guide/Smithing elder rune + 5 items
instructions: It is highly recommended that the player is at least level 99 Smithing to do this method since the player can smith elder rune items 10% faster at level 99. It is also highly recommended to use the Superheat Form Seren prayer, as this allows smithing for longer before needing to reheat the item. If owned, wearing a grace of the elves halves the prayer point drain of Superheat Form. (While having high requirements, equipping an Orthen furnace core will stop Superheat Form from draining prayer at all.) Players can use ancient elven ritual shard and/or super prayer renewals to restore prayer points.
Players being on World 70 with active luminite injectors also helps increase the amount produced per hour.
Players can gain 6% more experience with the full blacksmith's outfit.
Players can receive the benefits of Varrock armour 4 without wearing the armour by completing the easy New Varrock achievements.
Players can gain Artisans' Workshop respect while doing this method.
guides.location: Artisans' Workshop (highly recommended) or anywhere with an anvil

guides.page: Money making guide/Smithing elder rune shields
instructions: Use any anvil to forge elder rune bars into shields. Noted elder rune bars can be added to the metal bank and then withdrawn. You can queue up smithing multiple shields by right clicking the anvil, choosing "open smithing interface" and selecting elder rune shields until you have a full inventory of unfinished smithing items. You will then start to smith the shields, automatically starting to smith the next unfinished item as each is completed. Maintain high heat by using a forge to progress in creating shields at the fastest rate.

If owned, it is recommended to use an orthen furnace core and Superheat Form to maintain high heat and produce shields faster. This requires completion of The Light Within and level 99 Smithing and 102 Archaeology to create the orthen furnace core. In one hour you can make about 32-33 shields using this method.

instructions: Glorious bars are used in the creation of masterwork equipment. This method involves creating glorious bars from scratch, which can be done at any anvil except the anvil in Ashdale.
Create 50 concentrated alloy bars using 1 of each of the bars listed above per alloy bar.
Use the concentrated alloy bars to create 10 enriched alloy bars.
Use the enriched alloy bars to create 1 immaculate alloy bar.
Start folding the immaculate alloy bar into a glorious bar. A partially folded alloy bar must be folded 1,001 times to produce. It takes about 2,004 ticks, or 20 minutes, to produce one glorious bar.

instructions: It is highly recommended that you make a bank preset with 25 flax, 5 astral runes, and 10 nature runes.

The best method for free-to-play players is to use the spinning wheel on the floor 1 above ground of Lumbridge Castle, and to bank on the floor 2 above ground. You should use a preset with flax in your inventory to speed up the process. Alternative, if you pick the flax yourself in Taverly, use the spinning wheel just north, near Jack Oval and bank in Burthorpe.

In members the closest spinning wheel to a bank is in Neitiznot, which requires completion of The Fremennik Isles to access. Another good option is Seers' Village if you have completed the medium Seers' Village achievements. You can then equip the Seer's headband 2, which has the benefit of spinning the flax 33% faster. If the Ranger's Workroom is constructed in Fort Forinthry, this unlocks a spinning wheel with a bank chest right beside it.

guides.page: Money making guide/Spinning starbloom flowers into cloth
instructions: First, spin starbloom flower into starbloom thread at a spinning wheel.
The spinning wheel in the Ranger's Workroom (at least tier 1) in Fort Forinthry is right next to a bank, so it's an optimal location for this.
Next, weave starbloom thread into starbloom cloth at any loom.

Both starbloom thread and starbloom cloth are stackable, so it's wise to process all of your starbloom flower into starbloom thread first, and then process all of that starbloom thread into starbloom cloth at once.
guides.location: Ranger's Workroom spinning wheel, Fort Forinthry

instructions: The best possible method is to use the spinning wheel on the floor 1 above ground of Lumbridge Castle, and to bank on the floor 2 above ground. A full load of 28 wool takes approximately 50 seconds to convert into balls of wool. Travel and banking time is ~20 seconds in between loads. You should use a preset with wool in your inventory to speed up the process.

guides.page: Money making guide/Stealing cave goblin wire
instructions: The wire machine can be found in the south-west area of the city, east of a furnace. The wire respawns in 6 seconds after being taken. One trip of 28 wires takes about 5 minutes. It is possible to achieve higher profits (and additional Magic experience) by casting High Level Alchemy on a noted stack of any profitable item while waiting for the wire to spawn. Several casts can be fit into the 6-second respawn period without affecting the rate of wires stolen. Alternatively disassembling items can also be done whilst waiting.

guides.page: Money making guide/Stealing from vegetable stalls
instructions: Vegetable Stalls can be found at the market in Lumbridge. Repeatedly steal from the stall until your inventory is full, and then bank all of your items at the nearby bank chest. It takes slightly over 1 minute to get a full inventory; about 50 runs can be completed per hour.

instructions: It takes around 18 seconds to turn an inventory of 14 unstrung magic longbows and 14 bowstrings into 14 magic longbows. Bank presets are highly recommended for this method. Players can also put the unstrung bow on their action bar and assign a key bind, which can be the same button as the one for their preset. This can make the process even easier. Using a portable fletcher can be useful for this method. It grants a 10% experience boost, as well as a 10% chance to string two bows at once, potentially speeding up the process.

instructions: You can make money by casting Superheat Item on runite ore and luminite, turning it into rune bars. It's highly recommended to set up a bank preset with 13 runite ores, 13 luminite, and 13 nature runes. The preset should then be configured to be one of the two single-keypress buttons (which can be activated by pressing '1' and '2' respectively). With the addition of banks having "Load Last Preset from" by right clicking them, you can do this even more effectively. This allows players to cast superheat item almost continuously. With 57 Smithing there is a 10% chance for gaining 2 bars instead of 1 for the same amount of ore.

While it is possible to superheat over 1,815 bars in an hour, this is an incredibly click-intensive activity. To superheat even 1,716 bars in an hour requires near-undivided attention. Server latency/lag also has a significant impact on your output, as they impact the speed at which you can bank; use a world with low ping and low population count if possible.
travel: Use a convenient bank to withdraw the listed supplies and deposit the results.

instructions: Catching fish at the Swarm can yield a variety of fish above and below your current Fishing level. The benefits of swarm fishing are that it requires minimal input and is right next to a magical net which can be used for banking.

guides.page: Money making guide/Taking eggs from larder
instructions: Players can collect a lot of eggs from the larder in a player-owned house in a short period of time. Stand between the sink space and the larder so that the servant always returns to the same location. To collect eggs from the larder.
Hold down "3".
Click the larder every 1 tick (or spam click) until inventory has at least 26 eggs.
Call the servant for the first time (after the first inventory just click on the servant).
Use an egg on the butler and type how many eggs to transfer to your bank.

guides.page: Money making guide/Taking vials of water from a portable well
instructions: Vials of water are often in high demand because they must be used with a herb in order to make an unfinished potion for the Herblore skill. Players often buy them in bulk.

A portable well can be placed next to a bank, and has a right click option to take vials of water. You then need to type the number of vials to be taken. The exact number does not need to be typed and as such typing 111 or 33 may be faster than typing 28 exactly, as any excess over the number of available inventory spaces will simply be ignored.

A bank preset with an empty inventory may be used to speed up collecting as activating the preset by hotkey will both empty the inventory of vials and close the bank interface. Using this method is is possible to obtain an inventory of vials in under 6 seconds, resulting in 16,800 vials of water per hour. This number may be higher with practice.

instructions: Black dragon leather is used to train Crafting, and it is always in high demand. Because black dragonhide must be tanned into leather before it can be crafted, tanning the hides in bulk can be highly profitable. It should be noted that black dragonhide has a buy limit of 10,000 hides every 4 hours. It is also possible to work around the limit by directly trading with other players or by using alternate accounts.

Because the price difference between hides and leather can be fairly small, it is important to buy the hides for a low price and sell the leather for a high price; you can lose out on up to 50% of the profit if you are not patient. Test the profit by buying one black dragonhide and one black dragon leather. If the difference between the two is less than 200, it may be better to tan other dragonhides instead.
It should take you around 10 minutes to tan 10,000 hides.

To tan dragon leather with maximum efficiency, deploy a portable crafter near a bank or bank chest (for example, near the bank chest in Castle Wars), make a preset with 28 black dragonhide, and load it. Then right-click the crafter and choose Tan Leather. Alternatively, you can right-click configure the portable crafter so that the default left-click action is tan hides.
travel: To tan dragon leather with maximum efficiency, deploy a portable crafter near a bank or bank chest (for example, near the bank chest in Castle Wars), make a preset with 28 black dragonhide, and load it. Then right-click the crafter and choose Tan Leather. Alternatively, you can right-click configure the portable crafter so that the default left-click action is tan hides. You can also use portable crafters on the one already deployed to increase its duration by five minutes per crafter. It is also possible to avoid the cost of the portable crafters by using those placed by other players. The Lumbridge Market in World 84 almost always has a portable crafter set up next to the bank chest.
Zoom in and adjust your camera so the portable crafter and the bank would be next to each other.

guides.page: Money making guide/Tanning royal dragonhide with Make Leather
instructions: Royal dragon leather is used to train Crafting, and it is always in high demand. Because Royal dragonhide must be tanned into leather before it can be crafted, tanning the hides in bulk can be highly profitable.

While regular tanning can be quite profitable on its own, using the lunar spell Make Leather (which tans five hides at once) can increase the profit by more than 50% while also giving decent Magic experience. The downside is that Make Leather must be unlocked from Livid Farm, which requires 75,000 produce points.

Because the price difference between hides and leather can be fairly small, it is important to buy the hides for a low price and sell the leather for a high price; you can lose out on much of the profit or even turn a loss if you are not patient. Test the profit by buying one Royal dragonhide and one Royal dragon leather. If the difference between the two is less than 200, it may be worth it to switch to a different hide type. In some cases the profit can be more than 500 coins -- the guide prices on the Grand Exchange are not always indicative of the current trading price.

guides.page: Money making guide/Using the auto disassembler mk. II to make empty divine charge
instructions: II. The profit gained from this activity will be lower than shown on this page if you are using the regular auto disassembler.

You will first need to have built a auto disassembler, then create the auto disassembler mk. II. You can build an auto disassembler mk. II in the Invention Guild with 81 Invention. However, this guide assumes that you have 105 Invention to have researched empty divine charge blueprint and junk chance reduction 9.

26,000 maple logs will be disassembled in 9 days, taking 34 divine charges and producing 15,340 simple parts which will make 767 divine charge (empty). It takes 30 minutes to create the divine charges, and 2 minutes to add the logs and collect the parts.

With a jumbo generator, up to three machines can be run at a time, potentially resulting in multiplying the profit, at the expense of being limited in terms of what other machines can be used. Additionally, with a fully upgraded Workshop in Fort Forinthry, five can be used, but there will be no power left for any other machines.
To allow profit to be easily calculated for any combination of machines, this page calculates profit on a per-machine basis.
